    Deep Reasoning in General Purpose Agents via Structured Meta-Cognition

    通过结构化元认知实现通用智能体的深度推理

    Dean Light, Michael Theologitis, Kshitish Ghate, Shuyue Stella Li, Benjamin Newman, Chirag Shah, Aylin Caliskan, Pang Wei Koh, Dan Suciu, Yulia Tsvetkov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DOLORES constructs task-specific reasoning scaffolds by composing associative inference, formal computation, and recursive subproblem solving, and reports gains across several hard benchmarks. This directly advances adaptive reasoning and agent scaffolding; composition is a substantive part of the method, while the abstract gives no model-internal interpretability contribution.

    DOLORES 通过组合联想推断、形式计算和递归子问题求解来构建任务专属推理脚手架，并报告了在多个高难度基准上的提升。这直接推进了自适应推理和智能体脚手架的发展；组合是该方法的重要组成部分，但摘要没有涉及模型内部可解释性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Humans intuitively solve complex problems by flexibly shifting among reasoning modes: they plan, execute, revise intermediate goals, resolve ambiguity through associative judgment, and apply formal procedures to well-specified subproblems. Current LLM agents lack this flexibility, as their scaffolds hard-code such reasoning decisions in advance. These scaffolds are effective when their prescribed structure matches the task, but brittle when solving the task requires adapting the structure of reasoning itself. We introduce Deep Reasoning -- an inference-time approach for constructing task-specific scaffolds through structured meta-reasoning. Deep Reasoning uses a formal language that represents meta-reasoning as executable decompositions over associative inference, formal computation, and recursive subproblem solving, enabling decomposition principles to be encoded as in-context examples that guide test-time scaffold construction. We instantiate this approach in a general-purpose agent (DOLORES) that distributes complex tasks across more controlled reasoning threads. We evaluate it against state-of-the-art scaffolding methods across four hard benchmarks: multi-hop reasoning, long-chain question answering, long-context aggregation, and deep research-style information seeking. DOLORES outperforms all evaluated scaffolds across three model sizes and two model families, improving over the strongest evaluated scaffold baseline by 24.8% on average. DOLORES distributes cognition across structured, lower-load reasoning threads, thereby reducing premature termination and hallucinations. This advantage can even bridge the scaling gap, with an 8B version surpassing all evaluated 32B baselines from the same family in more than half the settings. These results point toward future agentic systems that treat scaffolding as adaptive reasoning, constructing the structure each task requires just-in-time.

    中文

    人类解决复杂问题时，会直觉地在不同推理模式之间灵活切换：他们会规划、执行、修订中间目标，通过联想判断消除歧义，并对定义明确的子问题应用形式化步骤。当前的 LLM 智能体缺乏这种灵活性，因为它们的脚手架会预先硬编码这类推理决策。当预设结构与任务相匹配时，这些脚手架十分有效；但当解决任务需要调整推理结构本身时，它们就显得脆弱。我们提出 Deep Reasoning，这是一种在推理时通过结构化元推理构建任务专属脚手架的方法。Deep Reasoning 使用一种形式语言，将元推理表示为对联想推断、形式计算和递归子问题求解的可执行分解；由此可以将分解原则编码为上下文示例，引导测试时的脚手架构建。我们将该方法应用于通用智能体 DOLORES，将复杂任务分配到更受控的推理线程中。我们在四个高难度基准上，将其与最先进的脚手架方法进行评估：多跳推理、长链问答、长上下文信息汇总和深度研究式信息搜寻。DOLORES 在三种模型规模和两个模型家族上均优于所有受测脚手架，平均比受测表现最好的脚手架基线提高 24.8%。DOLORES 将认知过程分配到结构化、负载较低的推理线程中，从而减少过早终止和幻觉。这一优势甚至能够弥合规模差距：在超过半数的设定中，同一家族的 8B 版本胜过所有受测 32B 基线。这些结果表明，未来的智能体系统可以将脚手架视为一种自适应推理过程，按需即时构建每项任务所需的结构。

    Model-Adaptive Tool Necessity Reveals the Knowing-Doing Gap in LLM Tool Use

    模型自适应的工具必要性揭示了 LLM 工具使用中的知行差距

    Yize Cheng, Chenrui Fan, Mahdi JafariRaviz, Keivan Rezaei, Soheil Feizi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures the gap between recognizing tool need and acting on it, using hidden-state probes and trajectory analysis that reveal a late-layer separation between cognition and action. This directly advances tool-use agent systems and offers mechanistic evidence, while it does not study compositional generalization or reasoning capability development.

    本文通过隐藏状态探针和轨迹分析，测量识别工具需求与采取相应行动之间的差距，并揭示认知与行动在后层的分离。这直接推动了工具使用智能体系统的发展，并提供机制层面的证据；但本文没有研究组合泛化或推理能力的发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents that must decide when to answer directly vs. when to invoke external tools. Prior work studying adaptive tool use has largely treated tool necessity as a model-agnostic property, annotated by human or LLM judge, and mostly cover cases where the answer is obvious (e.g., fetching the weather vs. paraphrasing text). However, tool necessity in the wild is more nuanced due to the divergence of capability boundaries across models: a problem solvable by a strong model on its own may still require tools for a weaker one. In this work, we introduce a model-adaptive definition of tool-necessity, grounded in each model's empirical performance. Following this definition, we compare the necessity against observed tool-call behavior across four models on arithmetic and factual QA dataset, and find substantial mismatches of 26.5-54.0% and 30.8-41.8%, respectively. To diagnose the failure, we decompose tool use into two stages: an internal cognition stage that reflects whether a model believes a tool is necessary, and an execution stage that determines whether the model actually makes a tool-call action. By probing the LLM hidden states, we find that both signals are often linearly decodable, yet their probe directions become nearly orthogonal in the late-layer, last-token regime that drives the next-token action. By tracing the trajectory of samples in the two-stage process, we further discover that the majority of mismatch is concentrated in the cognition-to-action transition, not in cognition itself. These results reveal a knowing-doing gap in LLM tool-use: improving tool-use reliability requires not only better recognition of when tools are needed, but also better translation of that recognition into action.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）日益作为自主智能体运行，需要决定何时直接回答，何时调用外部工具。以往关于自适应工具使用的研究，大多将工具必要性视为与模型无关的属性，由人类或 LLM 评审者标注，且主要涵盖答案显而易见的情况（例如查询天气与改写文本）。然而，现实中的工具必要性更加微妙，因为不同模型的能力边界并不相同：强模型能够独立解决的问题，对较弱的模型而言仍可能需要工具。本文提出一种基于各模型实测表现的模型自适应工具必要性定义。依照此定义，我们在四个模型上比较算术和事实问答数据集中的工具必要性与实际工具调用行为，发现两者存在显著不匹配，算术任务为 26.5-54.0%，事实问答任务为 30.8-41.8%。为诊断这一问题，我们将工具使用分解为两个阶段：反映模型是否认为有必要使用工具的内部认知阶段，以及决定模型是否实际执行工具调用的执行阶段。通过探查 LLM 的隐藏状态，我们发现这两种信号通常都可以线性解码，但在驱动下一个 token 动作的后层、末 token 区域中，两者对应的探针方向几乎正交。通过追踪样本在这两阶段过程中的轨迹，我们进一步发现，大多数不匹配集中于从认知到行动的转换，而非认知本身。这些结果揭示了 LLM 工具使用中的知行差距：要提高工具使用的可靠性，不仅要更准确地识别何时需要工具，还要更有效地将这种识别转化为行动。

    NeuroMAS: Multi-Agent Systems as Neural Networks with Joint Reinforcement Learning

    NeuroMAS：通过联合强化学习构建神经网络式多智能体系统

    Haoran Lu, Luyang Fang, Wenxuan Zhong, Ping Ma

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NeuroMAS treats LLM agents as a trainable architecture and studies learned coordination, topology, reinforcement learning, and progressive growth, making agent organization and computation central contributions. Its hierarchical-decomposition argument and modular textual computation support composition, while the abstract does not analyze internal representations; reinforcement learning is used to train the system rather than being a focused study of general reasoning mechanisms.

    NeuroMAS 将 LLM 智能体作为可训练架构，研究学习得到的协同方式、拓扑结构、强化学习和渐进式扩展，使智能体组织和计算成为核心贡献。其关于层次分解的论证和模块化文本计算支持组合能力；但摘要没有分析内部表征，强化学习用于训练系统，而非作为一般推理机制的专门研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent language systems are often built as hand-designed workflows, where agents are assigned semantic roles and communication protocols are specified in advance. We propose NeuroMAS, a method that first treats a multi-agent language system as a trainable and scalable neural-network-like architecture with LLM agents as nodes and intermediate textual signals as edges. In NeuroMAS, agent nodes are role-free but structure-aware: the topology only determines how information can flow in general, while reinforcement learning training determines how nodes communicate, specialize, and coordinate. This formulation shifts multi-agent design from workflow engineering toward architecture design, where depth, width, connectivity, and growth protocol become scalable sources of capability. Further, we provide a theoretical perspective showing why such modular textual computation is more parameter-efficient when tasks admit hierarchical decompositions. Experiments show that NeuroMAS improves significantly over both inference-time and trained multi-agent baselines. We further find that organizational scaling is path-dependent: larger systems can be challenging to train from scratch, but become feasible when grown progressively from smaller trained systems. These results suggest that learned neural multi-agent systems are a promising scaling axis for LLMs.

    中文

    多智能体语言系统通常采用人工设计的工作流构建，预先为智能体分配语义角色，并指定通信协议。我们提出 NeuroMAS，这种方法首先将多智能体语言系统视为一种可训练、可扩展的类神经网络架构，其中 LLM 智能体充当节点，中间文本信号充当边。在 NeuroMAS 中，智能体节点不设定角色，但会感知结构：拓扑结构只决定信息大体上可以如何流动，而强化学习训练则决定节点如何通信、专门化和协同。这种表述将多智能体设计从工作流工程转向架构设计，使深度、宽度、连接方式和增长协议成为可扩展的能力来源。此外，我们从理论角度说明，当任务可以分层分解时，这种模块化文本计算为何更节省参数。实验显示，NeuroMAS 的表现显著优于推理时多智能体基线和经过训练的多智能体基线。我们还发现，组织规模的扩展取决于发展路径：从头训练更大的系统可能颇具挑战，但从较小的已训练系统逐步扩展，则可以实现。结果表明，经过学习的神经多智能体系统是 LLM 一种有前景的扩展方向。

    Characterize Then Distill: Mechanistic Reasoning in Large Output Spaces

    先刻画，再蒸馏：大输出空间中的机制化推理

    Debjyoti Saha Roy

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper causally identifies phase-structured attention-head mechanisms behind large-label-space reasoning and shows that supervising those decision events can improve distillation, directly advancing mechanistic understanding and reasoning. Its clinical coding setting is an evaluation domain, not a substantive contribution to compositional generalization or model and agent systems.

    本文因果识别了大标签空间推理背后按阶段组织的注意力头机制，并证明监督这些决策事件可以改善蒸馏，直接推动了机制理解和推理研究。临床编码只是评估领域，并非本文对组合泛化或模型与智能体系统的实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning-trained language models can select, zero-shot, a small set of relevant labels from thousands to hundreds of thousands of candidates. We ask how they do it mechanistically, and whether the mechanism can be distilled. We treat each decision as a token-level event scored by the model's own decision margin: the token that picks a coarse region of the label space, the tokens that pick a label within it, and the token where the output departs from a near-miss named earlier in the reasoning. Attribution, exact mean-ablation, knock-in into another example's context and a null calibration give individual attention heads causal standing. On clinical coding of MIMIC-IV discharge summaries, with all 5,651 candidate codes in context, a small, global, phase-structured set of heads is necessary and sufficient on essentially every summary; distinct head families read the candidate region and the earlier near-miss, and blocking what they read removes their effect; for mentions elicitable in the reasoning, a disjoint mid-layer set makes the region elicitable several tokens before the code. The structure recurs in a second reasoner. We introduce MISTILL, which, unlike chain-of-thought distillation, also supervises the student's pooled attention at these decision events. Read on heads found after training, it nearly doubles the causal recovery of the contrastive decision in a cross-family student and adds a small, seed-stable gain in one that already carries most of it, with no detected task difference at matched precision; under matched selection it exceeds a frozen random-head pool on both recovery and task score. A pre-registered evidence-flip test detected no improvement in evidence-dependent decisions through the tested routes.

    中文

    经过推理训练的语言模型能够从数千到数十万个候选项中，以零样本方式选出少量相关标签。我们探究它们在机制层面如何做到这一点，以及这种机制能否被蒸馏。我们将每次决策视为一个 token 级事件，并用模型自身的决策边际为其评分：选定标签空间粗略区域的 token、在该区域内选定标签的 token，以及输出偏离推理过程中较早提及的近似候选项时对应的 token。归因分析、精确均值消融、将某个示例中的信息注入另一示例的上下文，以及零效应校准，共同确立了单个注意力头的因果作用。在 MIMIC-IV 出院摘要的临床编码任务中，所有 5,651 个候选代码都包含在上下文里；一个规模小、全局共享且按阶段组织的注意力头集合，对几乎每份摘要而言都是必要且充分的。不同的头组分别读取候选区域和较早出现的近似候选项；阻断它们读取的内容，就会消除其作用。对于推理过程中可以引出的提及，一个不重叠的中层注意力头集合能在代码出现前几个 token 就引出该区域。这种结构也出现在第二个推理模型中。我们提出 MISTILL；与思维链蒸馏不同，它还会在这些决策事件上监督学生模型汇总后的注意力。在训练后识别出的注意力头上进行读取时，MISTILL 几乎使跨模型系列学生模型对比性决策的因果恢复率翻倍；对于本已保留大部分该机制的学生模型，它也带来幅度不大但跨随机种子稳定的提升；在精确率匹配时，任务表现未检测到差异。在选择条件匹配时，它在因果恢复率和任务得分上都超过冻结的随机注意力头集合。预注册的证据翻转测试未检测到该方法通过所测试路径改善依赖证据的决策。

    Distributed Sparse Interventions in Language Models

    语言模型中的分布式稀疏干预

    Maximilian S. Ernst (1,2,3), Lorenz Linhardt (3,4), Aaron Peikert (2), Oliver Eberle (3,4) ((1) Max Planck School of Cognition, (2) Center for Lifespan Psychology Max Planck Institute for Human Development, (3) Machine Learning Group Technische Universit\"at Berlin, (4) Berlin Institute for the Foundations of Learning and Data (BIFOLD))

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces sparse, cross-layer neuron interventions and analyzes their interactions to connect distributed computation with task representations and behavior, directly advancing mechanistic understanding and control. Task activation is not itself reasoning or composition, and the sparse steering method is a limited systems contribution.

    本文提出稀疏的跨层神经元干预方法，并分析这些神经元之间的相互作用，将分布式计算与任务表征及行为联系起来，直接推进了机制层面的理解与控制。激活任务行为本身并不等同于推理或组合，而稀疏引导方法对系统的贡献有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models can perform a wide range of tasks at various levels of abstraction. They flexibly infer tasks from context, execute multiple tasks simultaneously, and select among competing goals. Understanding and controlling how models represent these tasks is central to aligning them with human objectives. Researchers can change model behaviour in many ways, but model steering, which manipulates intermediate task representations, links representation to behaviour most directly. Current steering methods typically intervene densely and assume linear effects, e.g., shifting every activation along a global direction in the residual stream. Because such interventions change thousands of neurons at once, they leave researchers to separate relevant from irrelevant neurons. We introduce Distributed Sparse Interventions (DSI), which steers models through a sparse set of individual neurons distributed across layers and attention heads. Finding such a set requires accounting for the selected neurons' interactions, even across layers; DSI achieves that by iteratively refining which neurons to intervene on and how strongly. Across 12 tasks and three instruction-tuned models, DSI activates task behaviour by identifying and intervening on fewer than 0.1% of neurons, outperforming dense steering vectors and often matching 10-shot in-context learning. Because DSI identifies explicit sets of neurons, it connects neuron-level computation to changes in latent representations and, ultimately, to desired outputs, allowing us to study how distributed computational components interact to produce steered behaviour. Our results demonstrate that steering can be viewed not only as a linear shift in representation space, but also as a targeted intervention on model computation, realised by adjusting a small set of interacting neurons whose coordinated activity spans multiple layers and contributes to behaviour.

    中文

    语言模型能够执行抽象层级各异的广泛任务。它们可以灵活地从上下文推断任务、同时执行多个任务，并在相互竞争的目标之间进行选择。理解并控制模型如何表征这些任务，是使模型符合人类目标的关键。研究人员可以通过多种方式改变模型行为，而模型引导直接将表征与行为联系起来，因为它会操控中间任务表征。当前的引导方法通常进行密集干预，并假设其效果是线性的，例如沿着残差流中的某个全局方向移动每个激活值。由于此类干预会一次改变数千个神经元，研究人员还需区分相关神经元与无关神经元。我们提出分布式稀疏干预（DSI），通过分布在多个层和注意力头中的一小组独立神经元来引导模型。寻找这样一组神经元需要考虑它们之间的相互作用，包括跨层相互作用；DSI 通过迭代优化要干预哪些神经元以及干预强度来实现这一点。在 12 项任务和 3 个指令微调模型上，DSI 通过识别并干预不到 0.1% 的神经元来激活任务行为，其表现优于密集引导向量，并且通常可与 10-shot 上下文学习相当。由于 DSI 会识别明确的神经元集合，它将神经元层面的计算与潜在表征的变化、进而与期望输出联系起来，使我们能够研究分布式计算组件如何相互作用并产生受引导的行为。我们的结果表明，引导既可以被视为表征空间中的线性位移，也可以被视为对模型计算的定向干预：通过调整一小组相互作用神经元，使其跨多个层的协同活动共同促成特定行为。

    EagleVLA: Towards Onboard Real-Time Robot Control via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Inference

    EagleVLA：通过前瞻对齐的异步推理实现板载实时机器人控制

    Zebin Yang, Qi Wang, Yunhe Wang, Xiurui Guo, Bo Yu, Shaoshan Liu, Jiafeng Xu, Hao Dong, Meng Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes an onboard VLA deployment method with adaptive scheduling, future-state correction, and inference-engine optimizations. Its robot-control context is incidental to reasoning mechanisms, and the abstract does not establish a compositional or interpretability contribution.

    本文提出一种用于板载 VLA 部署的方法，包含自适应调度、未来状态校正和推理引擎优化。其机器人控制场景与推理机制关系不大，摘要也没有证明其在组合性或可解释性方面有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive performance on diverse embodied tasks. However, deploying VLA models on low-power onboard devices, such as the Jetson Orin, remains challenging due to their high computational complexity, which leads to substantial inference latency and low control frequency. Asynchronous inference can partially mask this latency by parallelizing action execution and subsequent inference, but it introduces two critical issues: perception-execution misalignment and long reaction time. In this paper, we propose EagleVLA, a method for efficient VLA deployment on onboard devices via Foresight-Aligned Asynchronous Correction. To address misalignment, we train a lightweight future correction module that predicts future environment representations, allowing the action expert to predict actions from the future time step. To reduce reaction time, we introduce confidence-based scheduling optimization that adaptively balances VLM and action expert invocations. We also build a llama.cpp-based inference engine tailored for onboard VLA deployment, with system-level optimizations including CUDA graph reuse, GPU-resident intermediate buffering, and flow unrolling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EagleVLA achieves 14.71x and 9.20x improvements in control frequency compared with naive PyTorch and vla.cpp on Jetson Orin, while outperforming VLASH by 14.8% in success rate on LIBERO benchmark. The code of our asynchronous algorithm is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA, and our efficient llama.cpp-based inference engine is available on https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA-Edge.

    中文

    视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型在多种具身任务中取得了出色表现。然而，由于计算复杂度高，推理延迟显著、控制频率低，因此在 Jetson Orin 等低功耗板载设备上部署 VLA 模型仍然具有挑战性。异步推理通过并行动作执行与后续推理，可以部分掩盖延迟，但也会带来两个关键问题：感知与执行不匹配，以及反应时间过长。本文提出 EagleVLA，通过前瞻对齐异步校正，实现 VLA 在板载设备上的高效部署。为解决不匹配问题，我们训练了一个轻量级未来校正模块来预测未来环境表征，使动作专家能够基于未来时刻预测动作。为缩短反应时间，我们引入基于置信度的调度优化，自适应地平衡 VLM 和动作专家的调用。我们还构建了一个基于 llama.cpp 的推理引擎，专为板载 VLA 部署设计，并进行了 CUDA 图复用、GPU 驻留中间缓冲和流程展开等系统级优化。大量实验表明，在 Jetson Orin 上，与朴素 PyTorch 和 vla.cpp 相比，EagleVLA 的控制频率分别提升 14.71 倍和 9.20 倍；在 LIBERO 基准上，其成功率比 VLASH 高 14.8%。异步算法代码见 https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA，高效的基于 llama.cpp 的推理引擎见 https://github.com/PKU-SEC-Lab/EagleVLA-Edge。

    TreeWY: Speculative Verification for Gated DeltaNet Hybrids

    TreeWY：面向门控 DeltaNet 混合模型的推测验证

    Sneha Murthy Ghantasala

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a tree-structured WY method that avoids per-node recurrent-state snapshots, improving memory use and speculative decoding for Gated DeltaNet hybrids. Its contribution is directly to inference systems and computation; draft-tree structure is incidental to the systems advance, with no substantive focus on compositional generalization, interpretability, or reasoning.

    本文提出一种树结构 WY 方法，避免为每个节点保存循环状态快照，从而改善 Gated DeltaNet 混合模型的内存使用和推测解码。其贡献直接面向推理系统与计算；草稿树结构只是系统改进中的一环，文章并未实质探讨组合泛化、可解释性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern open models are hybrids: most layers are linear-attention (Gated DeltaNet, GDN) layers carrying a small fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value (KV) cache. This makes ordinary decoding memory-efficient, but hurts speculative decoding. To verify a batch of draft tokens and then roll back the rejected ones, today's systems snapshot the full recurrent state at every draft position for GDN layers, and those snapshots cannot be shared across branches of a draft tree, so a wide, high-acceptance tree becomes memory-infeasible. We remove the snapshots. Using a tree-structured WY transform of the gated delta rule, we compute every draft node's output with a single triangular solve and reconstruct only the one accepted state on commit, storing a small pseudo-value matrix instead of per-node states; the derivation depends only on the gated delta rule, not on any other architectural detail. In serving benchmarks on two scales of one hybrid model family (Qwen3.5 35B and 397B) this cuts speculative recurrent-state memory and KV-cache pressure at essentially identical acceptance length, turning the freed HBM into higher throughput and much lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) wherever memory binds, and costing a few percent where it does not. For tree width the same memory buys affordability: a wider, higher-acceptance draft becomes possible, though not yet a throughput win.

    中文

    现代开放模型采用混合架构：多数层是线性注意力（Gated DeltaNet，GDN）层，它们携带小型固定尺寸的循环状态，而不是不断增长的键值（KV）缓存。这使常规解码具有较高的内存效率，却不利于推测解码。为了验证一批草稿 token 并回滚被拒绝的 token，当今系统会为 GDN 层在每个草稿位置保存完整循环状态的快照；这些快照无法在草稿树的分支间共享，因此宽而接受率高的树会导致内存需求无法承受。我们消除了这些快照。我们利用门控 delta 规则的树结构 WY 变换，通过一次三角求解计算每个草稿节点的输出，并仅在提交时重建唯一被接受的状态；该方法存储的是一个小型伪值矩阵，而非每个节点的状态。推导仅依赖门控 delta 规则，不依赖任何其他架构细节。在同一混合模型系列的两个规模（Qwen3.5 35B 和 397B）的服务基准测试中，该方法在接受长度基本相同的情况下，降低了推测解码的循环状态内存和 KV 缓存压力；在内存受限时，它将释放出的 HBM 用于提升吞吐量并大幅降低首 token 延迟（TTFT），而在内存不构成瓶颈时，性能会下降几个百分点。对于树的宽度，同样的内存节省使其成本变得可承受：可以使用更宽、接受率更高的草稿，但目前尚未带来吞吐量提升。

    Taming CoT Obfuscation in VLMs: From Mechanistic Evidence to Activation-Level Enforcement

    驯服 VLM 中的思维链混淆：从机制证据到激活层面的约束

    Xutao Mao, Jianing Zhu, Jinman Zhao, Tongliang Liu, Xiaowen Chu, Cong Wang, Bo Han

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper links CoT obfuscation to changes in VLM activation geometry and uses SAEs to intervene on implicated features during RL, directly advancing mechanistic interpretability and reasoning transparency. Its focus on reasoning traces gives Reasoning a strong score; the intervention is not principally about compositionality or system organization.

    论文将 CoT 混淆与 VLM 激活几何的变化联系起来，并在 RL 期间使用 SAEs 干预相关特征，直接推动了机制可解释性和推理透明度。论文聚焦于推理轨迹，因此在推理方面具有重要意义；该干预的主要目的并非组合性或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs), yet it can induce chain-of-thought (CoT) obfuscation, an operational, non-intentional regime where models achieve high accuracy while producing reasoning traces that are less grounded and harder to monitor. While prior work documents this decay at the behavioral level, the underlying representational correlates of such drift remain poorly understood. In this work, we find that obfuscation is accompanied by a representational shift, where RL-induced optimization makes task-agnostic template features less separable from visually grounded content in the model's activation space. Based on this insight, we propose TAME, an activation-level intervention framework that leverages Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to regularize VLM internal features during RL training. Specifically, TAME utilizes an anti-obfuscation feedback loop to reduce behavioral obfuscation and applies an asymmetric SAE constraint to specific internal directions, penalizing template activations while preserving visual evidence. By directly intervening on the features associated with obfuscation, our method improves the transparency and visual grounding of reasoning traces. Experiments on the VIRL-39k and SPA-VL benchmarks across two model families show that TAME improves CoT monitorability (by up to +30.9 points on VIRL and +16.7 points on SPA-VL over GRPO), while largely preserving task accuracy and general-capability performance across four standard VLM benchmarks, with task-specific trade-offs. Our code is available at https://github.com/henrymao2004/TAME.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）显著提升了视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力，但也可能诱发思维链（CoT）混淆：这是一种操作层面、非意图性的状态，在此状态下，模型虽然准确率较高，却生成依据不足且更难监控的推理轨迹。以往研究记录了行为层面的这种退化，但其背后的表征相关因素仍未得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们发现混淆伴随着表征转变：RL 引发的优化使任务无关的模板特征在模型激活空间中更难与视觉依据内容区分。基于这一发现，我们提出 TAME，这是一种激活层面的干预框架，利用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）在 RL 训练期间对 VLM 的内部特征进行正则化。具体而言，TAME 利用反混淆反馈回路来减少行为混淆，并对特定内部方向施加非对称 SAE 约束，在保留视觉证据的同时惩罚模板激活。通过直接干预与混淆相关的特征，我们的方法提升了推理轨迹的透明度和视觉依据程度。在两个模型系列上对 VIRL-39k 和 SPA-VL 基准进行的实验表明，与 GRPO 相比，TAME 提升了 CoT 可监控性（在 VIRL 上最高提升 +30.9 个百分点，在 SPA-VL 上最高提升 +16.7 个百分点），同时大体保留任务准确率和四个标准 VLM 基准上的通用能力表现，但存在特定任务上的权衡。我们的代码见 https://github.com/henrymao2004/TAME。

    A Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers

    Transformer 中各向异性表征动力学的混合门控理论

    Nguyen Do, My T. Thai

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and experimentally validates a spectral, mechanistic account of how query and key gating change local representation dynamics in Transformers, directly addressing representation geometry and internal mechanisms. Attention routing gives it an incidental Systems connection, but the abstract does not focus on computation or system design.

    该论文提出并通过实验验证了一种谱分析的机制解释，说明查询门控和键门控如何改变 Transformer 中的局部表征动力学，直接探讨了表征几何结构和内部机制。注意力路由使其与系统领域存在间接关联，但摘要并未聚焦计算或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. We derive a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion that certifies the existence or absence of switching and identifies switching directions without exhaustive search. Beyond existence, our theory characterizes maximum relative switching strength, certifies the severity of contraction that gating can overcome, and determines the largest dimension of a subspace in which every nonzero direction switches. Experiments across four Transformer architectures validate these predictions through analytical and finite-forward comparisons, revealing distinct and joint query--key gating mechanisms and nontrivial switching subspaces. Our results provide a mechanistic and spectral understanding of how attention routing can alter local representation dynamics.

    中文

    内部表征之间的微小差异在经过 Transformer 层时可能缩小或增大，从而影响信息的保留方式以及模型对扰动的敏感程度。然而，注意力权重的变化在何种情况下会使原本会缩小的表征差异转而增大，仍不清楚。我们提出各向异性表征动力学的混合门控理论，将自注意力分解为值传输、查询门控和键门控。我们的分析揭示了被关注表征的几何结构如何约束门控，以及这些机制之间的相互作用如何逆转由值传输引起的收缩。我们将这一现象形式化为门控诱导的状态切换：表征差异在固定注意力路由下收缩，却在完整注意力下扩张。我们推导出一个充要的谱判据，用于判定是否存在状态切换，并可在无需穷举搜索的情况下识别发生切换的方向。除了判定其是否存在，我们的理论还刻画了最大相对切换强度，判定门控可以克服的收缩程度，并确定一个子空间的最大维数，使其中每个非零方向都会发生切换。在四种 Transformer 架构上的实验通过解析比较和有限次前向比较验证了这些预测，并揭示了不同的及联合的查询—键门控机制，以及非平凡的切换子空间。我们的结果从机制和谱分析角度阐明了注意力路由如何改变局部表征动力学。

    Rethinking SAE Evaluation: An Atomic Interpretable Unit Framework Reveals Hidden Polysemanticity and Redundancy

    重新思考 SAE 评估：原子可解释单元框架揭示隐藏的多义性与冗余

    Riteng Zhang, Xiaoqian Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes an objective for evaluating SAE and dictionary features as interpretable units, then benchmarks models to expose polysemanticity and redundancy relevant to attribution and circuit analysis. The features form a basis, but composition and generalization are not substantive contributions.

    本文将 SAE 和字典特征作为可解释单元进行评估的目标形式化，随后通过模型基准测试揭示了与归因和电路分析相关的多义性与冗余。特征构成了一个基，但组合性和泛化并非实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) were originally motivated by discovering monosemantic features, a property that characterizes individual features but does not specify what the learned feature set should look like as a whole. As SAEs have increasingly been adopted for attribution, circuit discovery, and intervention, researchers have begun evaluating metrics that describe global properties of the feature set, such as sparsity, dead feature rates, reconstruction fidelity, and disentanglement, a diverse set that extends far beyond monosemanticity. However, this implicit shift beyond monosemanticity has not been formalized as a clear, well-defined objective that comes before these evaluation metrics. Without such an objective, existing metrics remain ad hoc, with their necessity unjustified. In this work, we formalize this ultimate objective by introducing a new paradigm for SAE evaluation: requiring that SAE features, and more generally dictionary-based decompositions of model representations, form an atomic interpretable unit basis, a coordinate system for semantically meaningful explanation. Under this paradigm, we organize existing and new measurements such as DAME (Dominance-Aware Monosemanticity Evaluation) as proxy metrics and introduce a comprehensive benchmarking framework. Evaluating hundreds of SAEs across multiple architectures and model families, we uncover failure modes in which some SAEs appear monosemantic under existing evaluation metrics while remaining functionally polysemantic: the most dominant features, those contributing most to model computation, are systematically less interpretable and more redundant. These failure modes warrant attention from SAE researchers as targets for improved training and architectures, and motivate dominance-aware evaluation as a standard check for practitioners before SAE features are deployed for attribution, circuit tracing, or intervention.

    中文

    稀疏自编码器（SAE）最初旨在发现单义特征；这一性质描述单个特征，却没有规定学得的特征集整体应当呈现何种形态。随着 SAE 越来越多地用于归因、电路发现和干预，研究人员开始评估描述特征集全局属性的指标，例如稀疏度、死特征率、重构保真度和解耦性；这些指标涵盖的范围远远超出单义性。然而，这种超越单义性的隐性转变，尚未被形式化为一个清晰、定义明确且先于这些评估指标的目标。缺少这样的目标，现有指标就仍然是临时拼凑的，其必要性也缺乏论证。在本研究中，我们通过提出一种 SAE 评估新范式，将这一最终目标形式化：要求 SAE 特征，以及更一般地说，基于字典的模型表示分解，构成一个原子可解释单元基，即用于语义有意义解释的坐标系。在这一范式下，我们将包括 DAME（优势感知单义性评估）在内的现有和新测量方法组织为代理指标，并提出一个全面的基准测试框架。我们评估了多个架构和模型系列中的数百个 SAE，发现了这样的失效模式：一些 SAE 在现有评估指标下看似单义，功能上却仍然是多义的；其中对模型计算贡献最大的主导特征，系统性地更难解释且冗余更多。这些失效模式值得 SAE 研究人员关注，可作为改进训练方法和架构的目标；它们也促使我们建议，在将 SAE 特征用于归因、电路追踪或干预之前，实践者应把优势感知评估作为标准检查。

    Nested Sparsity for Scalable Pretraining and Continual Learning

    面向可扩展预训练与持续学习的嵌套稀疏性

    Tianzhe Chu, Druv Pai, Yi Ma

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Nestor introduces nested conditional computation combining sparse attention with MoE sparsity and evaluates it for pretraining and continual adaptation. The hierarchy gives composition a limited architectural connection, while the central contribution directly advances sparse computation and model architecture, making Systems core.

    Nestor 提出将稀疏注意力与 MoE 稀疏性结合的嵌套条件计算机制，并对其在预训练和持续适应中的表现进行评估。这种层级结构与组合性有一定的架构关联，而其核心贡献直接推进了稀疏计算和模型架构，属于系统领域的核心工作。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mixture-of-experts (MoE) transformers, the standard backbone for modern large-scale deep learning, employ conditional computation: only a sparse subset of model weights is used in each forward pass. In MoE transformers, this sparsity arises in the MoE operator, which generalizes the multi-layer perceptron in the classical transformer. In this work, we explore an alternative mechanism for conditional computation that analogously generalizes the attention operator. The sparsity induced by this mechanism naturally nests (i.e., hierarchically composes) with the sparsity induced by the MoE operator. We show that a transformer employing this nested sparsity mechanism, which we call Nestor, performs better than a conventional MoE transformer at equal compute and equal sparsity in language model pretraining. We also show that Nestor is well-suited for continual pretraining: it can be adapted to longer contexts more effectively than conventional MoEs, as well as adapt more efficiently to new domains while forgetting less on old domains. Furthermore, we demonstrate that these benefits persist as model size, dataset size, and context length grow. Our results demonstrate the potential of alternative conditional computation mechanisms for deep neural network architectures. Code and checkpoints are available on GitHub at https://github.com/Ma-Lab-Berkeley/Nestor .

    中文

    混合专家（MoE）Transformer 是现代大规模深度学习的标准骨干网络，它采用条件计算：每次前向传播只使用模型权重中的一个稀疏子集。在 MoE Transformer 中，这种稀疏性源自 MoE 算子；该算子扩展了经典 Transformer 中的多层感知机。在这项工作中，我们探索另一种条件计算机制，它以类似方式扩展注意力算子。该机制诱导的稀疏性会自然地与 MoE 算子诱导的稀疏性嵌套（即进行层级组合）。我们表明，在语言模型预训练中，采用这种嵌套稀疏性机制的 Transformer（我们称之为 Nestor），在相同计算量和相同稀疏度下优于传统 MoE Transformer。我们还表明，Nestor 适用于持续预训练：与传统 MoE 相比，它能更有效地适应更长上下文，也能更高效地适应新领域，同时减少对旧领域的遗忘。此外，我们证明随着模型规模、数据集规模和上下文长度增长，这些优势仍然存在。我们的结果展现了用于深度神经网络架构的替代条件计算机制的潜力。代码和检查点见 GitHub：https://github.com/Ma-Lab-Berkeley/Nestor。

    TaxoSAE: Rethinking Sparse Autoencoders through Taxonomic Logic

    TaxoSAE：以分类逻辑重新思考稀疏自编码器

    Xinyu Guo, Minglai Yang, Clayton T. Morrison, Eduardo Blanco, Mihai Surdeanu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TaxoSAE organizes model features by taxonomic relations and demonstrates more consistent readout, finer-grained control, and generalization to unseen concepts through hypernyms, directly advancing representation structure and compositional reuse. Its factual QA setting connects to reasoning and control to systems, but the abstract does not study reasoning mechanisms or agent computation.

    TaxoSAE 按分类关系组织模型特征，并展示了更一致的读取、更细粒度的控制，以及通过上位词对未见概念的泛化，直接推进了表征结构和组合复用。其事实型 QA 场景与推理和控制有关，但摘要没有研究推理机制或智能体计算。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) decompose the representations of large language models (LLMs) into interpretable features, enabling precise readout and control of encoded knowledge. However, existing SAEs treat each feature as a standalone unit, whereas real-world knowledge is often taxonomically organized. As a result, readout carries no guarantee of taxonomic consistency, and control lacks the granularity to specify the scope of an edit. We propose TaxoSAE, which explicitly encodes taxonomical information, built on is-a (hypernym-hyponym) relations, into the SAE feature space. TaxoSAE mirrors a taxonomy with a stack of SAEs, one per taxonomy level, and introduces a taxonomic alignment loss that trains each concept to be active whenever one of its hyponyms is. On two factual QA taxonomies, one over biographical relations and one over animals, TaxoSAE enables (1) more accurate readout through the taxonomy with concentrated activations, e.g., +31.3 points in reading out the hypernyms of abstract concepts never queried in training; (2) more precise control, with +25.5 points in swap success, while suppressing a concept removes only its own answers (0-2% accuracy vs. 91-100% on other concepts); and, more importantly, (3) readout of unseen concepts through their hypernyms, with up to +37.9 points in hypernym readout accuracy.

    中文

    近期的稀疏自编码器（SAE）将大型语言模型（LLM）的表征分解为可解释特征，从而能够精确读取和控制编码其中的知识。然而，现有 SAE 将每个特征视为独立单元，而现实世界的知识往往按照分类体系组织。因此，读取结果无法保证符合分类体系的一致性，控制也缺乏明确指定编辑范围的粒度。我们提出 TaxoSAE，将基于 is-a（上位词—下位词）关系的分类信息显式编码到 SAE 特征空间中。TaxoSAE 用一组 SAE 来映射分类体系，每个分类层级对应一个 SAE；它还引入分类对齐损失，使每当某个概念的下位词激活时，该概念也会被激活。在两个事实型问答（QA）分类体系上开展实验，一个涉及人物传记关系，另一个涉及动物。TaxoSAE 实现了：（1）通过分类体系进行更准确的读取，并使激活更加集中，例如，对训练中从未查询过的抽象概念读取其上位词时，准确度提高 31.3 个百分点；（2）更精确的控制，替换成功率提高 25.5 个百分点；抑制某个概念时，只会删除该概念自身的答案（准确率为 0-2%，而其他概念仍为 91-100%）；更重要的是，（3）通过上位词读取未见过的概念，上位词读取准确率最高提高 37.9 个百分点。

    A Mathematical Theory of the Jacobian Lens

    雅可比透镜的数学理论

    Mitchell Ostrow, Daoyuan Qian, Toni Liu, Ila Fiete

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a mathematical account of which hidden-state directions the Jacobian lens detects, linking them to coherent, layer-amplifying features, and introduces variants for different temporal scales. This directly advances mechanistic interpretability; next-token prediction is the validation setting, not a contribution to reasoning capability.

    本文建立了一个数学解释，说明雅可比透镜会检测哪些隐藏状态方向，并将这些方向与相干且跨层放大的特征联系起来，还提出了针对不同时间尺度的变体。这项工作直接推动了机制可解释性研究；下一词元预测只是验证场景，并非对推理能力的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent work from Anthropic introduced a new interpretability tool, called the Jacobian lens (J-lens, Gurnee et al., 2026). This method identified linear directions in the hidden states of frontier language models that had properties reminiscent of working memory-like representations. However, it is unclear what mechanistic properties of such features make them detectable to the J-lens. To this end, we introduce a mathematical theory of the J-lens, and show that it preferentially identifies coherent features -- directions that act like leading, spatially coherent Lyapunov modes. Small perturbations along these directions amplify across layers, remain roughly constant across token positions, and are consistent across different contexts. While we are agnostic to whether these properties are necessarily associated with a ``Global Workspace'', the analytically derived preferences of the J-lens nevertheless explain prior empirical applied to both model classes. We validate our analysis on a Bayes filter and a toy transformer, each optimally predicting next tokens emitted from a Hidden Markov Model (HMM). We show how modulating task parameters that change the coherence of features in the Bayes filter correspondingly and predictively modulates the response of the J-lens . We also introduce of a family of J-lenses built to emphasize different temporal scales of information processing in LLMs, which we call $\omega$-J-lenses.

    中文

    Anthropic 的近期研究提出了一种名为雅可比透镜（J-lens；Gurnee et al., 2026）的新型可解释性工具。该方法在前沿语言模型的隐藏状态中识别出一些线性方向，其性质令人联想到类似工作记忆的表征。然而，目前尚不清楚究竟是这些特征的哪些机制属性使它们能被 J-lens 检测到。为此，我们提出 J-lens 的数学理论，并表明它会优先识别相干特征——即表现为主导且在空间上相干的 Lyapunov 模态的方向。沿这些方向的小扰动会跨层放大，在不同词元位置间大致保持不变，并且在不同上下文中保持一致。我们不对这些性质是否必然与“全局工作空间”相关作出判断，但通过解析推导得到的 J-lens 偏好，仍能解释先前针对这两类模型开展的实证研究。我们在一个 Bayes filter 和一个玩具 Transformer 上验证了分析；二者都能对隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）生成的下一词元作出最优预测。我们展示了如何调节 Bayes filter 中会改变特征相干性的任务参数，从而相应地、可预测地改变 J-lens 的响应。我们还提出一系列 J-lens 变体，用于强调 LLM 中信息处理的不同时间尺度，并将其称为 $\omega$-J-lenses。

    The Helpful Agent Problem: When Emergent Cooperation Among LLM Agents Bypasses Intended Workflows

    助人智能体问题：LLM 智能体之间的涌现合作如何绕过预期工作流

    Moumita Choudhury, Amit Sarker, Shlomo Zilberstein

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how LLM agents spontaneously make cross-owner changes that bypass intended review, and introduces benchmarks to measure the resulting harms. Its central contribution directly concerns multi-agent behavior and system-level oversight; shared-resource cooperation has only an incidental connection to compositionality.

    本文研究 LLM 智能体如何自发地代替不同所有者进行变更，从而绕过预期审核流程，并推出基准来衡量由此产生的危害。其核心贡献直接涉及多智能体行为与系统级监督；共享资源合作与组合性只有附带关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings where they pursue separate tasks while sharing resources and operating under review or oversight processes. Such settings create safety risks not only when agents are malicious, but also when they are simply trying to help. Prior work has largely studied adversarial or explicitly collusive behavior; we show that benign agents pursuing separate objectives can spontaneously cooperate in ways that bypass intended workflows. We call this the \emph{helpful agent problem}. We study long-horizon shared-resource environments in which agents sometimes depend on resources owned by their peers and cross-owner changes are normally mediated by a reviewer. When review becomes unavailable, agents begin making changes on one another's behalf despite having no shared reward or explicit incentive to cooperate. Crucially, these actions remain within each agent's local permissions while circumventing the system's intended oversight structure. We introduce \textsc{FavorBench}, a controlled benchmark with measurable downstream side effects, and adapt \textsc{CooperBench} to test the phenomenon in realistic repositories. Across two benchmarks and four models, we find that out-of-workflow favors emerge frequently. Further, in \textsc{FavorBench}, favors from at least three models cause significant harm to parties outside the interaction. These results reveal a distinct multi-agent safety challenge: cooperation itself can create pathways around system-level safeguards.

    中文

    LLM 智能体越来越多地部署在协作场景中：它们各自追求不同任务，同时共享资源，并遵循审核或监督流程。这类场景的安全风险不仅来自恶意智能体，也可能来自一心想帮忙的智能体。以往研究主要关注对抗性行为或明确串通；我们则表明，追求不同目标的善意智能体也可能自发合作，绕过预期工作流。我们将此称为 extit{助人智能体问题}。我们研究长时程共享资源环境：智能体有时依赖由同伴拥有的资源，而跨所有者的变更通常须经审核者处理。当审核不可用时，即便没有共享奖励或明确的合作动机，智能体也会开始代替彼此进行变更。关键在于，这些行为虽然仍处于各智能体本地权限范围内，却绕过了系统预期的监督结构。我们推出 extsc{FavorBench}，这是一个具有可测量下游副作用的受控基准；还改造了 extsc{CooperBench}，用于在真实的代码仓库中测试这一现象。在两个基准和四种模型上，我们发现，偏离工作流的帮忙行为频繁出现。此外，在 extsc{FavorBench}中，至少三种模型所提供的帮忙会对交互之外的参与方造成显著损害。这些结果揭示了一项独特的多智能体安全挑战：合作本身可能开辟绕过系统级防护措施的途径。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether SAE feature interpretations predict causal control in text-to-MIDI models, with controlled interventions and confirmation across prompts and dictionaries.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can expose features of a generative model without predefined labels, but in language models the evidence used to interpret these features has proven an unreliable guide to which of them steer the output. Whether interpretations of SAE features predict control in music generators has not, to our knowledge, been tested. We develop an end-to-end protocol for discovering and evaluating SAE features in text-to-MIDI generation and apply it to text2midi and MIDI-LLM. The protocol characterizes features through correlations with musical metrics, shared instrument programs, and automated descriptions, each with its own control: note-density adjustment, matched inactive excerpts, and permutation calibration. It then tests candidates by intervention, measured directly in the generated MIDI against unmodified generation and a matched random direction, ranks them in screens, and confirms selected features on new prompts. Evidence that survives these controls points to features that steer the output. Descriptions exceed permutation controls for instrumentation, and a feature whose description names a synth-lead program introduces that program in a prespecified confirmation and in a replication on disjoint prompts and reappears in independently trained dictionaries. Features selected by density-adjusted correlations show a small positive shift of their target metric as a family, whereas features selected by raw correlations show none. An atlas provides MIDI, piano-roll, and audio examples for every feature of the targeted screen.

    中文

    稀疏自编码器（SAE）能够在没有预定义标签的情况下揭示生成模型的特征，但在语言模型中，用于解释这些特征的证据已被证明无法可靠指示哪些特征会引导输出。据我们所知，尚无研究检验对 SAE 特征的解释能否预测音乐生成器中的控制效果。我们开发了一套端到端流程，用于发现和评估文本转 MIDI 生成中的 SAE 特征，并将其应用于 text2midi 和 MIDI-LLM。该流程通过特征与音乐指标的相关性、共享的乐器程序以及自动生成的描述来刻画特征，并为每种方法设置相应的控制：音符密度调整、匹配的非激活片段，以及置换校准。随后，我们通过干预测试候选特征，直接在生成的 MIDI 中测量其效果，并与未经修改的生成结果及匹配的随机方向进行比较；接着对候选特征进行筛选排序，并在新提示上确认选定特征。通过这些控制后仍然成立的证据，表明相关特征能够引导输出。在乐器配置方面，自动生成的描述优于置换控制；有一项特征的描述指出某个合成器主音程序，该特征在预先规定的确认实验以及使用互不重叠提示的复现实验中都引入了该程序，并且在独立训练的字典中再次出现。通过密度调整后的相关性选出的特征，其目标指标作为一个整体出现了小幅正向变化；而通过未经调整的相关性选出的特征则没有这种变化。一份图谱为目标筛选中的每个特征提供了 MIDI、钢琴卷帘图和音频示例。

    Yiran Xiahou, Siliang Qin, Kai Chen, Shengzhi Zhang, Renyang Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ConceptACP uses SAE features and causal localization of concept-relevant denoiser blocks to make targeted, precise concept edits, directly advancing representation and mechanism analysis. Its efficiency improvements concern targeted fine-tuning, but the abstract does not describe a broader model-systems contribution.

    ConceptACP 利用 SAE 特征，并因果定位与概念相关的去噪器模块，以实现定向、精准的概念编辑，直接推进了表征与机制分析。其效率提升针对定向微调，但摘要未描述更广泛的模型系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion-based image generation models produce high-quality images but may generate harmful or policy-violating content, motivating machine unlearning (MU) to selectively remove target concepts while preserving general capabilities. However, existing MU approaches often struggle with the distributed and entangled nature of concept representations, leading to inefficient optimization and imprecise edits when applied through large-scale fine-tuning over full diffusion trajectories. To bridge this gap, we propose Concept Acupuncturist (ConceptACP), a novel MU framework that integrates interpretability-guided analysis with inference-free fine-tuning for efficient and precise concept removal. By establishing mappings between semantic concepts and cross-attention blocks in the U-Net denoiser and localizing the most concept-relevant block for targeted optimization, ConceptACP avoids full diffusion trajectory optimization, thereby improving fine-tuning efficiency. To mitigate concept entanglement, we propose a feature-level correction mechanism based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), where SAE-derived sparse, semantically meaningful feature activations are manipulated to construct targeted correction signals, which are then projected back to the output space of the corresponding block and used as supervision for precise concept removal. Consequently, ConceptACP eliminates the need for external inference-time modules while achieving efficient and fine-grained unlearning. Instantiated on SDXL-Turbo, ConceptACP improves the forgetting success rate by 36.34 percentage points in the standard one-step generation setting on average over the best-performing baseline, while preserving image quality and prompt fidelity, and generalizes effectively across other Stable Diffusion backbones. Our code is available at https://github.com/Eran-Xia/ConceptACP.

    基于扩散的图像生成模型能够生成高质量图像，但也可能生成有害内容或违反政策的内容，因此需要机器遗忘（MU）有选择地移除目标概念，同时保留通用能力。然而，现有 MU 方法往往难以应对概念表征分布广泛且相互纠缠的特性；当通过覆盖完整扩散轨迹的大规模微调来实现时，这会导致优化效率低下、编辑不精准。为弥补这一不足，我们提出 Concept Acupuncturist（ConceptACP），一种新颖的 MU 框架，将可解释性引导的分析与无需推理的微调相结合，以高效、精准地移除概念。通过建立语义概念与 U-Net 去噪器中交叉注意力块之间的映射，并定位与概念最相关的模块进行定向优化，ConceptACP 无需优化完整扩散轨迹，从而提高微调效率。为缓解概念纠缠，我们提出一种基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征级校正机制：对 SAE 提取的稀疏且具有语义意义的特征激活进行操作，以构造定向校正信号；随后将这些信号投影回相应模块的输出空间，并将其用作监督信号，实现精准的概念移除。因此，ConceptACP 无需外部推理时模块，同时实现高效且细粒度的遗忘。在 SDXL-Turbo 上实例化后，与表现最佳的基线相比，ConceptACP 在标准单步生成设置下平均将遗忘成功率提高了 36.34 个百分点，同时保留图像质量和提示词忠实度，并能有效泛化到其他 Stable Diffusion 主干模型。代码见：https://github.com/Eran-Xia/ConceptACP。

    Large audio-language models (LALMs) can assess cognitive impairment (CI) from speech, yet their answers reveal neither which internal components control the decision nor how much CI information is accessible in their representations. We investigate both questions through CI-contrast neurons (CICNs), selected by class-contrastive activation frequency in decoder MLPs. Across eight open LALMs and two corpora (Pitt and PROCESS-2), we causally test CICNs against size- and layer-matched random masks and activity-matched controls. In three of the five models that meet our eligibility criteria, ablation of small CICN sets causes large, class-directed prediction shifts; speech-identified masks also control transcript-only decisions, and three of four primary Pitt masks retain specificity on PROCESS-2. Position-restricted interventions locate the influence before the final answer position, most strongly after the speech or transcript evidence under letter-labeled options, largely as a decision-direction shift. Beyond causal localization, supervised linear readouts of frozen CICN activations achieve 0.92--0.97 AUC within Pitt, versus 0.67--0.84 for the models' direct answers. Matched random and all-neuron readouts reach comparable performance; top-ranked CICNs show only an exploratory advantage at very small unit budgets. These results distinguish concentrated causal control over output decisions from broadly distributed diagnostic information for CI detection in LALMs.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This is a core mechanistic contribution; the factual QA setting alone does not substantively address composition, reasoning capability, or system design.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models can answer a question from a supplied document or from their parametric knowledge. When later asked where the answer came from, what determines their source report? We study this by intervening on the model's key-value (KV) cache after the answer is generated and before the source question is asked. On a controlled factual task with four models (7B-32B), changing or removing the document's cache never changes the report. In contrast, transplanting the question-and-answer (Q+A) cache between runs with identical question and answer tokens transfers it: every eligible report follows the donor, while the recipient's document is unchanged. On the two smaller models, steering Q+A values along directions fitted before any source question reverses 98.9-100% of reports across four document conditions at a fixed strength, while norm-matched random directions flip at most 1.1%. The components of keys and values along fitted directions carry the transplant effect: copying them alone nearly reproduces the report change; holding them fixed nearly prevents it. Applied during answer generation, the same value directions also change which source supplies the answer, though more weakly and depending on the prompt.     Tsung-Han Wu, Minsuk Heo, Kenny Tan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study analyzes when halting heads actually reduce compute in looped language models and proposes better training and reporting practices. It directly advances adaptive computation and conditional execution (Systems); the work concerns compute allocation rather than reasoning capability, with no substantive connection to interpretability or composition.

    本文分析了停机头何时能真正减少循环语言模型的计算量，并提出更好的训练和报告实践。它直接推动了自适应计算和条件执行（系统）研究；本文关注的是计算资源分配，而非推理能力，与可解释性或组合性没有实质联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped language models run each token through the same layers several times, and each run is one iteration. To save compute, an extra layer, the halting head, gives after each iteration the probability that the token stops there, so that easy tokens can stop early. Pretraining models from scratch, up to 1.3B parameters, we find two problems. First, heads trained on a mix of all iterations predict that tokens need under half the iterations, yet under the standard stopping rule tokens run almost every iteration, because this training never scores the single iteration where a token stops. Scoring every iteration instead fixes this, but in our runs it works only with a strong penalty favoring early stops. Second, savings are commonly reported as an average number of iterations per token, but when sequences are generated in batches that run until their slowest token stops, a model without a head is almost as good at that cost. The reported average can therefore overstate the saving. We recommend reporting the iterations tokens actually run, with the stopping threshold and batch size, and give a test, run before training a head, that bounds its gain.

    中文

    循环语言模型会让每个词元经过相同的层多次，每次运行称为一次迭代。为节省计算量，模型会添加一个额外层，即停机头，在每次迭代后给出该词元此时停止的概率，使简单词元能够提前停止。我们从头开始预训练最多含13亿参数的模型，发现了两个问题。第一，在所有迭代混合数据上训练的停机头预测词元所需迭代次数不到一半，但按照标准停止规则，词元几乎会运行每一次迭代，因为这种训练从未对词元停止的那一次迭代进行评分。改为对每一次迭代都评分可以解决这一问题，但在我们的实验中，只有施加强力鼓励提前停止的惩罚项才有效。第二，通常以每个词元的平均迭代次数来报告节省的计算量，但当序列以批次生成并持续运行到其中最慢的词元停止时，没有停机头的模型在相同成本下几乎一样好。因此，报告的平均值可能会夸大节省幅度。我们建议报告词元实际运行的迭代次数、停止阈值和批大小，并给出一种在训练停机头之前运行的测试，用来界定其收益上限。

We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese, using causal interventions on a synthetic contrastive dataset and a negation translation dataset derived from FLORES-200. Across models, we find strong evidence that negation representations are causally controllable and largely shared across languages. In particular, we show that a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in the others, and directions extracted from different languages are substantially aligned.     Locating relevant evidence in long inputs is a core capability of Multimodal Large Language Models. Prior studies attribute this capability to retrieval heads, a sparse set of attention heads that transfer information from the context to the output. However, these analyses are confined to a limited set of modalities and the corresponding models. Moreover, how retrieval heads can be leveraged to enhance the model calls for further exploration. In this paper, we ask whether this mechanism expands together with the input modalities of the model. Taking audio-visual input as a newly added modality, we construct paired inputs in which the same answer is either spoken or shown on screen. With the evidence content fixed, retrieval heads remain sparse in the new modality and are shared to a large extent across modalities. Across 18 language, vision-language, and omni-modal checkpoints, omni-modal models largely preserve the retrieval heads of their backbones. Ablating these heads eliminates nearly all audio-visual retrieval. The heads shared across modalities make up fewer than 2\% of all heads, yet ablating them also degrades document understanding, spatial perception, and visual mathematics. Building on these findings, we turn retrieval heads into a target of optimization by training their attention with a ranking objective. This raises the page Recall@1 of Qwen3-VL-8B on MMDocIR by 6.03 points and improves document retrieval across three model families. Functional attention heads can thus serve both as a lens on multimodal models and as a target for improving them.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Accordion uses fixed-prefix layer looping and mixture-of-experts to provide multiple inference budgets in one model, with training and distillation methods that preserve performance across budgets. Its adaptive computation is a core systems contribution; depth-dependent gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation are evaluated, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning mechanisms, and no compositional insight is claimed.

    Accordion 使用固定前缀层循环和混合专家，在单个模型中提供多种推理预算，并采用训练和蒸馏方法保持不同预算下的性能。其自适应计算是核心系统贡献；论文评估了随深度变化的数学推理和代码生成表现，但摘要并未聚焦于推理机制，也未声称具有组合性洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models serve applications with diverse inference budgets, but training and maintaining separate models for each budget incurs substantial costs. Recent Looped Transformers enable flexible inference computation through parameter reuse, but maintaining strong performance across different inference budgets remains an open challenge. We introduce Accordion, a mixture-of-experts-based model that supports five inference budgets through fixed-prefix layer looping. Each budget follows a pre-defined execution path, while the minimum budget retains the unlooped model. Joint pretraining samples one budget per micro-batch and optimizes its next-token prediction loss without additional cross-budget consistency objectives. We further preserve these inference budgets through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, where parameter-group merging and budget-matched multi-teacher on-policy distillation integrate three domain experts into one model. After 3.6T tokens of pretraining, increasing inference depth improves Accordion-6B-A0.5B's five-category macro-average across 37 tasks by 3.01 percentage points, with the middle budget capturing 89% of this gain using half as many additional layer executions. The final model surpasses each domain expert on its corresponding task-and-budget average, while achieving strong instruction-following performance across all budgets and retaining depth-dependent gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation.

    中文

    大型语言模型服务于推理预算各异的应用，但针对每种预算分别训练和维护模型会产生高昂成本。近期的循环 Transformer 通过参数复用实现灵活的推理计算，但如何在不同推理预算下保持强劲性能仍是一项未解决的挑战。我们提出 Accordion，这是一种基于混合专家的模型，通过固定前缀层循环支持五种推理预算。每种预算遵循预定义的执行路径，而最低预算则保留不循环的模型。联合预训练在每个微批次中采样一种预算，并优化其下一词元预测损失，不额外加入跨预算一致性目标。我们还通过监督微调和强化学习保留这些推理预算；在此过程中，参数组融合以及与预算匹配的多教师在线策略蒸馏，将三个领域专家整合进一个模型。经过 3.6T 个词元的预训练后，增加推理深度使 Accordion-6B-A0.5B 在 37 项任务、五个类别上的宏平均提高了 3.01 个百分点；中等预算仅使用一半数量的额外层执行次数，就获得了其中 89% 的提升。最终模型在各自对应的任务与预算平均成绩上超过每个领域专家，同时在所有预算下都展现出强劲的指令遵循能力，并在数学推理和代码生成方面保留了随深度提升而增长的表现。

    Marek Masiak and Andrzej Szablewski, Nicola Cancedda, Constantin Venhoff

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TopKLoRA is an interpretable sparse fine-tuning method whose causal latents support discovering and ablating circuits that implement backdoors, directly advancing mechanistic interpretability. Sparsity and fine-tuning are enabling design choices here, with no substantive composition, reasoning, or model-system contribution described.

    TopKLoRA 是一种可解释的稀疏微调方法，其因果潜变量有助于发现并消融实现后门的电路，直接推动了机制可解释性研究。稀疏性和微调在这里是实现方法的设计选择，摘要没有描述实质性的组合、推理或模型系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of our circuit search algorithm. We consider these findings as a step toward interpretable-by-design architectures that provide faithful units of analysis without compromising model performance. We share our code: https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA.

    中文

    在来源不明的数据集上进行微调时，如果数据包含投毒样本，训练后的模型可能会出现后门。后门难以定位和移除，并且可能在安全训练后依然存在。参数高效微调方法能够捕捉训练过程中引入的全部参数变化，但这些变化并不容易解释。我们介绍 TopKLoRA 的完整方法，它扩展了 Masiak et al. (2025) 的初步方案。这是一种以可解释性为设计目标的 LoRA 变体，在每个 token 处仅有最大的适配器潜变量处于激活状态。$k$与 SAE 不同，TopKLoRA 纯粹通过下游损失进行训练，优化压力会促使模型学习在功能上具有因果作用的潜变量。我们通过一个潜伏特工后门案例研究展示这种稀疏 LoRA 适配器：在含有投毒指令跟随数据集上微调 gemma-2-2b、Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 Qwen2.5-7B，从而创建模型生物体。对于每个模型生物体，我们都找到了一个实现后门所必需且充分的电路，并对其进行了消融。此外，我们的新微调方法产生的稀疏电路比稠密 LoRA 基线最多小一个数量级，因此可以精确消融恶意能力，同时不牺牲指令跟随性能。最后，我们提出一种方法，利用 TopKLoRA 潜变量和梯度路由构建具有局部化电路的模型生物体，并用它来验证电路搜索算法的发现。我们认为，这些发现朝着以可解释性为设计目标的架构迈出了一步，这类架构能够提供可信的分析单元，同时不损害模型性能。我们的代码见：https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA。

    Jaesung R. Park, Junsu Kim, Gyeongman Kim, Jinyoung Jo, Sean Choi, Jaewoong Cho and Ernest K. Ryu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes theoretically and empirically how PPO and GRPO clipping changes entropy, and shows how clip-low can promote exploration and mitigate entropy collapse during reasoning training. This substantially advances training methods for reasoning, while entropy effects alone do not establish internal mechanisms or a broader systems contribution.

    本文从理论和实证层面分析 PPO 和 GRPO 的裁剪如何改变熵，并展示了 clip-low 如何在推理训练中促进探索、缓解熵坍塌。这显著推进了推理训练方法，但仅凭熵效应无法证明模型内部机制或更广泛的系统层面贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has recently emerged as the leading approach for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, RLVR is prone to entropy collapse, where the LLM quickly converges to a near-deterministic form, hindering exploration and progress during prolonged RL training. In this work, we reveal that the clipping mechanism in PPO and GRPO induces biases on entropy. Through theoretical and empirical analyses, we show that clip-low increases entropy, while clip-high decreases it. Further, under standard clipping parameters, the effect of clip-high dominates, resulting in an overall entropy reduction even when purely random rewards are provided to the RL algorithm. Our findings highlight an overlooked confounding factor in RLVR: independent of the reward signal, the clipping mechanism influences entropy, which in turn affects the reasoning behavior. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that clipping can be deliberately used to control entropy. Specifically, with a more aggressive clip-low value, one can increase entropy, promote exploration, and ultimately prevent entropy collapse in RLVR training.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）近来已成为提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力的主流方法。然而，RLVR 容易出现熵坍塌：LLM 会迅速收敛到近乎确定性的形式，从而在长时间强化学习训练中阻碍探索与进步。在这项工作中，我们揭示了 PPO 和 GRPO 中的裁剪机制会对熵产生偏置。通过理论和实证分析，我们表明，clip-low 会提高熵，而 clip-high 会降低熵。此外，在标准裁剪参数下，clip-high 的影响占主导地位，即使向强化学习算法提供的完全是随机奖励，整体熵仍会降低。我们的发现指出了 RLVR 中一个被忽视的混杂因素：无论奖励信号如何，裁剪机制都会影响熵，进而影响推理行为。此外，我们的分析表明，可以有意利用裁剪来控制熵。具体而言，采用更激进的 clip-low 值可以提高熵、促进探索，并最终防止 RLVR 训练中的熵坍塌。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark that separates perception, reasoning, and multimodal-specific errors, and uses it to compare capability profiles associated with training strategies. Its main contribution is evaluation of multimodal reasoning and training effects; the component analysis does not examine models’ internal mechanisms, and training is not focused on system architecture or composition.

    本文提出一个将感知、推理和多模态特有错误区分开的基准，并用它比较与不同训练策略相关的能力画像。其主要贡献是评估多模态推理及训练效果；成分分析并未考察模型的内部机制，训练也未聚焦于系统架构或组合。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Evaluation of multimodal reasoning models is typically reduced to a single accuracy score, implicitly treating reasoning as a unitary capability. We introduce MathLens, a benchmark of textbook-style geometry problems that exposes this assumption by operationally decomposing performance into perception, reasoning, and multimodal-specific components. Each problem is derived from a symbolic specification and accompanied by visual diagrams, text-only variants, multimodal questions, and targeted perceptual probes, enabling controlled measurement of each component. Using this decomposition, we show that common training strategies are associated with systematically different capability profiles that are invisible under aggregate accuracy. Across the models we study, reinforcement learning primarily improves perceptual grounding and robustness to diagram variation, while our analysis suggests that textual SFT yields gains through reflective reasoning. In contrast, as perception and reasoning improve, a growing fraction of remaining errors fall outside these components and are categorized as multimodal-specific. These results suggest that apparent progress in multimodal reasoning reflects shifting balances among subskills rather than uniform advancement, motivating evaluation beyond scalar accuracy.

    Iterative Policy Optimization: Batch-Online Multi-Turn RL via Single-Turn RL

    迭代策略优化：通过单轮强化学习实现批量在线多轮强化学习

    Daniel R. Jiang, Ankur Samanta, Yukai Yang, Jalaj Bhandari, R\'emi Munos, Tyler Lu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    IterPO alternates learned value estimation and policy improvement to train multi-turn agents from batch-online data without an interactive simulator in the training loop. This advances multi-turn RL and agent training; the single-turn-to-multi-turn mapping is not a central contribution to compositional generalization, and the abstract does not investigate model internals.

    IterPO 交替进行学习得到的价值估计与策略改进，利用批量在线数据训练多轮智能体，且无需在训练循环中使用交互式模拟器。这推动了多轮强化学习和智能体训练；从单轮到多轮的映射并非组合泛化的核心贡献，摘要也未研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Practical LLM agents often operate over multi-turn conversations where success is determined only after the full interaction ends. Most multi-turn RL methods train via on-policy rollouts, but unlike in single-turn RL, the policy cannot produce a trajectory alone, since an external environment must respond after each agent turn. For conversational agents, this environment is a user, but real users are generally unavailable inside the training loop and simulated users are difficult to build faithfully. Separately, real-world deployment is rarely fully online or fully offline. The common production pattern is called batch online, where the current policy is deployed to collect a batch of interaction data, then retrained on that batch and redeployed. We show that this batch-online setting creates an opportunity for applying the classical approximate policy iteration algorithm. Our central observation is that running standard token-level, single-turn GRPO with a learned turn-level $Q$-function as the reward model is a policy improvement step for the multi-turn problem. Building on this, we present Iterative Policy Optimization (IterPO), which alternates between fitting $Q^\pi$ from logged Monte Carlo returns via standard reward modeling (policy evaluation) and running single-turn GRPO against $Q^\pi$ (policy improvement). During policy improvement, the learned $Q^\pi$ scores candidate responses by their expected downstream return, avoiding the need for simulator rollouts of the remaining conversation. Overall, this allows us to do principled multi-turn RL using only single-turn RL methods without an interactive environment or user simulator inside the training loop. We demonstrate the effectiveness of IterPO on six multi-turn negotiation environments.

    中文

    实用的大语言模型智能体通常在多轮对话中运行，只有在整个交互结束后才能判定是否成功。大多数多轮强化学习方法通过在策略采样轨迹进行训练，但与单轮强化学习不同，策略无法独自生成一条轨迹，因为每轮智能体发言后都必须由外部环境作出回应。对于对话智能体，这个环境是用户，但真实用户通常无法参与训练循环，而忠实构建模拟用户也很困难。另一方面，现实世界中的部署很少是完全在线或完全离线的。常见的生产模式称为批量在线：部署当前策略以收集一批交互数据，然后用这批数据重新训练并再次部署。我们表明，这种批量在线设置为应用经典的近似策略迭代算法创造了机会。我们的核心观察是，将标准的 token 级单轮 GRPO 与一个学习得到的轮次级$Q$-函数作为奖励模型结合起来运行，即构成多轮问题中的策略改进步骤。基于此，我们提出迭代策略优化（IterPO），它交替进行两步：通过标准奖励建模，利用已记录的蒙特卡洛回报拟合$Q^\pi$（策略评估）；以及针对$Q^\pi$运行单轮 GRPO（策略改进）。在策略改进过程中，学习得到的$Q^\pi$会根据候选回答的预期后续回报对其评分，从而无需对话剩余部分的模拟器采样轨迹。总体而言，这使我们能够仅使用单轮强化学习方法，以有原则的方式进行多轮强化学习，而无需在训练循环中使用交互环境或用户模拟器。我们在六个多轮谈判环境中展示了 IterPO 的有效性。

    While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on clinical text understanding, they struggle with longitudinal prediction tasks such as dementia prognosis, which require reasoning over complex, non-monotonic symptom trajectories across multiple visits. Standard supervised training lacks explicit annotations for symptom evolution, while direct Reinforcement Learning (RL) is hindered by sparse binary rewards. To address this challenge, we introduce Dementia-R1, an RL-based framework for longitudinal dementia prognosis from unstructured clinical notes. Our approach adopts a Cold-Start RL strategy that pre-trains the model to predict verifiable clinical indices extracted from patient histories, enhancing the capability to reason about disease progression before determining the final clinical status. Extensive experiments show that Dementia-R1 achieves the best overall performance on the AMC real-world unstructured cohort, reaching an AUROC of 84.02% and outperforming models up to 10x larger. On the ADNI benchmark, our 7B model attains the highest AUROC among all LLM baselines at 83.17%, demonstrating strong longitudinal reasoning over fluctuating cognitive trajectories.     On the Runway Cascade of Transformers for Language Modeling

    论用于语言建模的 Transformer 跑道级联

    Hunjae Lee, Corey Clark

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how indirect token-to-token pathways affect representations and proposes runway-aware rewiring to account for those influences, making a substantial contribution to model information flow and representation mechanisms. Its retrieval and extrapolation gains are outcomes rather than a direct contribution to composition, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文分析 token 之间的间接路径如何影响表示，并提出跑道感知重连来纳入这些影响，因此对模型的信息流和表示机制作出了重要贡献。检索和外推能力的提升是结果，而非对组合、推理或系统组织的直接贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In decoder-only (causal) transformers, the computation graph created by causal masking routes information through both direct-path attention and indirect paths formed by intermediate tokens. We denote these indirect paths between token pairs as their runways. We argue that certain failure modes of causal transformers as observed by a growing body of recent works are likely exacerbated by a misalignment between these two information propagation modes. We formalize runway cascade as a phenomenon whereby this misalignment results in redundancies and irrelevant information cascading to token representations despite adequately learned attention patterns. As a solution, we propose runway-aware rewiring as a more explicit way of incorporating runway context directly into each token's direct-path attention. This mechanism re-wires the attention pattern for each token based on a summary of its runway landscape, enabling awareness of accumulating representational influences and allowing for more balanced information propagation. Our proposed methodology introduces no additional parameters and can seamlessly be integrated into standard attention mechanism. Empirically, our rewired transformer results in steady improvements in general language modeling as well as noticeably stronger information retrieval and extrapolation abilities compared to standard transformers.

    中文

    在仅解码器（因果）Transformer 中，因果掩码所形成的计算图通过直接路径注意力和由中间 token 构成的间接路径传递信息。我们将 token 对之间的这些间接路径称为它们的跑道。我们认为，近期越来越多研究观察到的某些因果 Transformer 失效模式，很可能会因这两种信息传播模式之间的不匹配而加剧。我们将跑道级联形式化为一种现象：即使注意力模式已经得到充分学习，这种不匹配仍会导致冗余和无关信息级联进入 token 表示。作为解决方案，我们提出跑道感知重连，以一种更明确的方式将跑道上下文直接融入每个 token 的直接路径注意力。该机制根据每个 token 的跑道分布概况重新连接其注意力模式，使模型能够感知不断累积的表示影响，并实现更均衡的信息传播。我们提出的方法不引入额外参数，并且可以无缝集成到标准注意力机制中。实证结果表明，与标准 Transformer 相比，经过重连的 Transformer 在通用语言建模方面持续提升，在信息检索和外推能力方面也有明显增强。

    SpatialMem is a memory-based system which integrates 3D geometry, semantics, and language with one another in one combined, queryable representation. Starting with casually recorded egocentric RGB video, SpatialMem recreates metrically scaled interior scenes, recognizes structural 3D anchors (walls, doors, windows) as the first-layer scaffold, and associates open-vocabulary object nodes with evidence patches, visual embeddings, and two-layer descriptions to 3D coordinates, enabling spatial-relation reasoning, language-directed retrieval, and QA without special sensors. We test at scale on public benchmarks. On VSI-Bench ($288$ videos, $5{,}130$ questions) SpatialMem scores $37.5$ overall with RGB alone, and its margin is precisely where a metric memory should earn it (room size $41.4$ vs.\ $24.4$ with a same-size frame model). On the episodic-memory task of OpenEQA ($953$ questions) the memory serialised to text is lower than the blind control, but as evidence-frame retrieval it recovers frame-level accuracy, matching uniform sampling at an equal eight-frame budget and pulling ahead as the budget tightens, with every answer grounded in linked 3D evidence. On $12$ ScanNet scenes evaluated using instance-level official annotations, the anchor-first hierarchy assigns the retrieved object to the proper structural parent where open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs essentially cannot ($0.24$ compared to $0.01$ with matched input), a capability difference instead of an overall win. The queryable index has a cost of $14$\,KB per scene without the linked evidence frames, and we make available the suites, memories and code.

    Contemporary large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems exhibit systematic advantages in deep research tasks, which emphasize iterative, vertically structured information seeking.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes adversarial multi-turn dialogue and measures extraction, containment, and failure modes, including planning and constraint-reasoning effects.     ENGLISH

    Multi-turn LLM evaluation is typically reported as a single win-rate scalar, conflating distinct capabilities. We introduce AIDG (Adversarial Information Deduction Game), formalizing multi-turn adversarial dialogue as a two-player partially observable stochastic game (POSG) and decomposing performance along Seeker (extraction) and Holder (containment) roles. The decomposition isolates three failure modes: cooperative-prior leakage, constraint-reasoning interference, and inefficient hypothesis-space traversal. Across 439 games over six frontier LLMs, defensive performance is tightly clustered (sigma = 1.9 ELO) while offensive performance varies substantially (sigma = 53.3 ELO); confirmation framing increases extraction odds 7.75x over uninformed deduction (p < 0.00001); and constraint violations account for 41.3% of deductive failures, uncorrelated with scale (rho = 0.0). We position the containment-over-extraction gap not as a surprising finding but as a measurable consequence of locally resolvable defensive decisions versus globally coupled offensive planning, and use the decomposition to attribute the gap per model. All design choices, including turn-decay weighting and the Bradley-Terry rating model, are derived from explicit assumptions.

    Sasha Robinson, Katherine M. Collins, Ilia Sucholutsky, Kelsey R. Allen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    该研究评估智能体任务中的警觉性，并提出一个贝叶斯框架来权衡顾问的建议，从而推进智能体决策和信息使用能力。推理与这一决策过程相关，但摘要并未研究推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) are becoming increasingly autonomous assistants, capable of accomplishing series of complex tasks by interacting with open world domains such as software databases and the internet. This presents great opportunity but also great risk: open domains routinely present opportunities for autonomous agents to be influenced by others, e.g. deciding whether to accept pull requests or whether to use advice on a message board in order to accomplish a task. Critically, agents must be capable of deciphering when to incorporate benevolent advice into their reasoning, and when to reject malicious advice. This involves the social capacity of vigilance: the ability to determine which information to use, and which to discard, for effective communication. While well-studied in humans, the extent to which LLM agents exhibit vigilance is relatively unknown. Here, we examine LLM agent vigilance in three realistic tasks: navigating dangerous websites, avoiding e-commerce scams, and patching an unsafe code repository. We find that all frontier models are highly susceptible to malicious influence across all environments. We also find that model performance itself is surprisingly dissociable from vigilance. In light of these results, we propose a vigilance harness which uses Bayesian reasoning over a model's estimates of the value of an advisor's advice to decide whether to act on that advice. The vigilance harness helps recover baseline performance while retaining the benefit of positive influence on agents, paving the way for safer agentic AI systems.

    大语言模型（LLM）正逐渐成为更加自主的助手，能够通过与软件数据库和互联网等开放领域交互来完成一系列复杂任务。这带来了巨大的机遇，也伴随着巨大的风险：开放领域经常让自主智能体有机会受到他人影响，例如决定是否接受拉取请求，或是否采用留言板上的建议来完成任务。关键在于，智能体必须能够辨别何时应将善意建议纳入推理，何时应拒绝恶意建议。这涉及警觉这一社会能力：判断哪些信息应当采用、哪些应当舍弃，以实现有效沟通。尽管警觉在人类中已得到充分研究，但 LLM 智能体具备何种程度的警觉仍鲜为人知。本文考察了 LLM 智能体在三种现实任务中的警觉性：浏览危险网站、避免电子商务诈骗，以及修补不安全的代码仓库。我们发现，所有前沿模型在所有环境中都极易受到恶意影响。我们还发现，模型本身的任务表现与警觉性之间的关联出乎意料地弱。基于这些结果，我们提出一种警觉性框架，通过对模型估计的建议价值进行贝叶斯推理，来决定是否采纳顾问的建议。该框架有助于恢复基线表现，同时保留积极影响对智能体的益处，为更安全的智能体 AI 系统铺平道路。

    As large language models engage in extended reasoning tasks, they accumulate significant state -- architectural mappings, trade-off decisions, codebase conventions -- within the context window. This understanding is lost when sessions reach context limits and undergo lossy compaction. We propose Contextual Memory Virtualisation (CMV), a system that treats accumulated LLM understanding as version-controlled state. Borrowing from operating system virtual memory, CMV models session history as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) with formally defined snapshot, branch, and trim primitives that enable context reuse across independent parallel sessions. We introduce a three-pass structurally lossless trimming algorithm that preserves every user message and assistant response verbatim while reducing token counts by a mean of 20% and up to 86% for sessions with significant overhead by stripping mechanical bloat such as raw tool outputs, base64 images, and metadata. A single-user case-study evaluation across 76 real-world coding sessions demonstrates that trimming remains economically viable under prompt caching, with the strongest gains in mixed tool-use sessions, which average 39% reduction and reach break-even within 10 turns. A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/IngressionLabs/contextual-memory-virtualisation.

    随着大语言模型执行长时间推理任务，它们会在上下文窗口中积累大量状态信息——架构映射、权衡决策、代码库惯例等。当会话达到上下文限制并进行有损压缩时，这些理解便会丢失。我们提出上下文记忆虚拟化（CMV），这是一个将 LLM 累积的理解视为版本控制状态的系统。借鉴操作系统虚拟内存的思想，CMV 将会话历史建模为有向无环图（DAG），并形式化定义快照、分支和裁剪原语，使上下文能够在相互独立的并行会话间复用。我们提出一种三遍结构无损裁剪算法，在逐字保留每条用户消息和助手回复的同时，通过剔除原始工具输出、base64 图像和元数据等机械性冗余，将 token 数量平均减少 20%；对于存在大量冗余的会话，最高可减少 86%。对 76 个真实世界编码会话进行的单用户案例研究评估表明，在提示缓存条件下，裁剪在经济上仍然可行；混合工具使用会话的收益最大，平均减少 39%，并在 10 轮内达到盈亏平衡。参考实现见 https://github.com/IngressionLabs/contextual-memory-virtualisation。
