    George Bird

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops symmetry-based activations and function-preserving methods for pruning and growing network topologies, with analytical sparsification results. Its analysis of neuron connections offers limited insight into representations, but the central contribution is adaptive architecture and computation rather than internal knowledge or reasoning.

    本文提出基于对称性的激活函数，以及能够在剪枝和扩展网络拓扑时保留函数的方法，并给出解析稀疏化结果。对神经元连接的分析对表征提供的见解有限；其核心贡献在于自适应架构和计算，而非内部知识或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Varying the number of neurons while preserving function is difficult because neural networks' dense connectivity creates strong computational interdependence between units. Elementwise activation functions, particularly their limited equivariance properties, are identified as a central hurdle to achieving this. We propose activation functions designed around chosen equivariances, enabling dense neural networks to adapt via singular value decomposition of their affine maps. This diagonalises layers into one-to-one, ordered connections, making it easier to assess the impact of individual connections on function. Low-impact neurons can be removed (neurodegeneration), and a thresholded buffer of largely inactive `scaffold' neurons is maintained (neurogenesis). These symmetry-led diagonalisation and structural changes prioritise function-invariance: neurogenesis exactly preserves function, neurodegeneration is asymptotically function-preserving with the pruned singular-value threshold. Moreover, this construction enables asymptotic 50\% parameter sparsification of dense networks while preserving function analytically. Thus, the approach enables real-time restructuring of the architecture in response to task demands, task appending, removal or changes. Conceptually, this motivates broader applications of symmetry prescriptions at the small scale, even when no data-driven model-scale symmetry adherence is required. Following this, we build activations around symmetry, not from classical assumptions about individual neurons. Unlike typical elementwise forms, these alternatives feature explicit basis independence and do not individuate neurons. We leverage this to decompose and reinterpret neurons across sequential layers, simplifying structure and providing a natural route to adaptive topologies. Additional developments include a new tunable parameter, the `intrinsic length'.

    在保持函数不变的同时改变神经元数量很困难，因为神经网络的稠密连接使各单元之间存在很强的计算相互依赖。我们认为，逐元素激活函数，尤其是其等变性有限，是实现这一目标的主要障碍。我们提出围绕所选等变性设计的激活函数，使稠密神经网络能够通过对其仿射映射进行奇异值分解来适应变化。这会将各层对角化为一对一、有序的连接，从而更容易评估各条连接对函数的影响。可以移除影响较小的神经元（神经退化），同时维持一个经阈值筛选、由大多不活跃的“支架”神经元组成的缓冲区（神经发生）。这些由对称性引导的对角化和结构变化优先保证函数不变性：神经发生会精确保留函数；在经过剪枝的奇异值阈值下，神经退化会渐近地保留函数。此外，这种构造在解析意义上支持稠密网络渐近地实现 50\% 的参数稀疏化，同时保持函数不变。因此，该方法能够根据任务需求、任务的添加、移除或变化实时重构网络架构。从概念上说，这为在小尺度上更广泛地应用对称性约束提供了动机，即使不要求模型尺度的数据驱动对称性遵循也是如此。基于此，我们围绕对称性构建激活函数，而不采用关于单个神经元的经典假设。与常见的逐元素形式不同，这些替代形式具有明确的基底无关性，不会将神经元个体化。我们利用这一点分解并重新诠释跨连续层的神经元，从而简化结构，并为自适应拓扑结构提供一条自然途径。其他进展还包括一个新的可调参数“内禀长度”。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

Its relevance to reasoning is limited to evaluating these alignment errors; the abstract does not study broader reasoning processes.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a text description is extended with an additional detail, image-text similarity should drop if that detail is wrong. We show that CLIP-style dual encoders often violate this intuition: appending a plausible but incorrect object or relation to an otherwise correct description can increase the similarity score. We call such cases half-truths. On COCO, CLIP prefers the correct shorter description only 34.0% of the time, and performance drops to 27.8% when the added detail is a relation. We trace this vulnerability to weak supervision on caption parts: contrastive training aligns full sentences but does not explicitly enforce that individual entities and relations are grounded. We propose CS-CLIP (Component-Supervised CLIP), which decomposes captions into entity and relation units, constructs a minimally edited foil for each unit, and fine-tunes the model to score the correct unit above its foil while preserving standard dual-encoder inference. CS-CLIP raises half-truth accuracy to 76.4% and improves average performance on established compositional benchmarks by 5.8 points, suggesting that reducing half-truth errors aligns with broader gains in compositional understanding.

    如果在文本描述中补充一条细节，而这条细节是错误的，那么图像与文本的相似度理应下降。我们发现，CLIP 风格的双编码器经常违背这一直觉：在原本正确的描述后添加一个看似合理但实际错误的物体或关系，反而可能提高相似度分数。我们将这类情况称为半真相。在 COCO 上，CLIP 只有 34.0% 的情况下更偏好正确的较短描述；当添加的细节是关系时，这一比例降至 27.8%。我们将这种脆弱性归因于对描述组成部分的监督不足：对比训练会对齐完整句子，却不会明确要求单个实体和关系都以图像为依据。我们提出 CS-CLIP（Component-Supervised CLIP，组件监督 CLIP），将描述拆解为实体和关系单元，为每个单元构造只经过最小编辑的干扰项，并微调模型，使其对正确单元的评分高于干扰项，同时保留标准的双编码器推理方式。CS-CLIP 将半真相准确率提高到 76.4%，并使既有组合基准上的平均表现提高 5.8 个百分点，这表明减少半真相错误与组合理解能力的广泛提升相一致。

    We introduce Heterogeneous Agent Collaborative Reinforcement Learning (HACRL), a new Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Reward (RLVR) problem that addresses the inefficiencies of isolated multi-agent on-policy optimization. HACRL enables collaborative optimization with independent execution: heterogeneous agents share verified rollouts during training to mutually improve, while operating independently at inference time. Unlike LLM-based multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), HACRL does not require coordinated deployment, and unlike on-/off-policy distillation, it enables bidirectional mutual learning among heterogeneous agents rather than one-directional homogeneous teacher-to-student transfer. Building on this problem, we propose HACPO, a collaborative RL algorithm that enables principled rollout sharing to maximize sample utilization and cross-agent knowledge transfer. To mitigate capability discrepancies and policy distribution shifts, HACPO introduces four tailored mechanisms with theoretical guarantees on unbiased advantage estimation. Extensive experiments across diverse heterogeneous model combinations and reasoning benchmarks show that HACPO consistently improves all participating agents, outperforming GSPO with double rollouts by an average of 3.6% while using only half the rollout cost.

    本文的贡献是一种具备执行感知能力的学习与规划框架，用于协调动态环境中的机器人探索和导航。它主要研究智能体规划和任务执行，关于推理式规划的见解居于次要位置；仅凭应用场景，无法充分说明模型内部机制或组合泛化能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Hierarchical multi-robot exploration decouples frontier allocation from local navigation, making systems brittle in dynamic environments. Without awareness of execution difficulty, allocators may send robots toward frontiers whose routes are congested or unsafe, causing bottlenecks, oscillatory replanning, and redundant coverage. We propose VORL-EXPLORE, a hybrid learning and planning framework that makes exploration execution-aware through execution fidelity, an estimate of local navigability and execution reliability. This fidelity score is used to penalize risky or crowded frontiers in a fidelity-coupled Voronoi allocation objective with inter-robot repulsion, and to arbitrate between global $A^*$ guidance and a reactive reinforcement learning policy during navigation. As a result, robots follow efficient global plans in reliable regions and rely more on safer local reactions in crowded or changing areas. The fidelity model is recalibrated using self-supervised pseudo-labels derived from recent progress and safety outcomes. Quantitative experiments on randomized dynamic grids and an ablation under severe traffic show higher success rates, shorter exploration lengths, and lower inter-robot coverage overlap. A Gazebo factory scenario is included as a deployment illustration. The source code is available at https://github.com/21ning/VORL-EXPLORE.

    While Large Language Models (LLMs) provide semantic flexibility for robotic task planning, their susceptibility to hallucination and logical inconsistency limits their reliability in long-horizon domains. To bridge the gap between unstructured environments and rigorous plan synthesis, we propose DUPLEX, an agentic dual-system neuro-symbolic architecture that strictly confines the LLM to schema-guided information extraction rather than end-to-end planning or code generation. In our framework, a feed-forward Fast System utilizes a lightweight LLM to extract entities, relations etc. from natural language, deterministically mapping them into a Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) problem file for a classical symbolic planner. These results confirm that The key is not to make the LLM plan better, but to restrict the LLM to the part it is good at - structured semantic grounding - and leave logical plan synthesis to a symbolic planner.

    MCPHunt 提出受控基准和污点追踪方法，用于衡量多服务器智能体工作流中的凭据传播，并研究提示缓解措施。这项工作显著推进了对智能体工具使用和数据流的评估；组合主要是工作流背景，而不是被研究的能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-server MCP agents create an information-flow control (IFC) problem: faithful tool composition can turn individually benign read/write permissions into cross-boundary credential propagation -- a structural side effect of workflow topology, not necessarily malicious model behavior. We present MCPHunt, to our knowledge the first controlled benchmark that isolates non-adversarial, exact-match credential propagation across multi-server MCP trust boundaries, with three methodological contributions: (1) canary-based taint tracking that reduces propagation detection to objective string matching; (2) an environment-controlled coverage design with risky, benign, and hard-negative conditions that validates pipeline soundness and adds a matched alternative-value control (same tasks, distinct synthetic credentials); (3) completion-requires-secret (CRS) stratification that disentangles task-mandated propagation (faithful execution of verbatim-transfer instructions) from policy-violating propagation (credentials included despite the option to redact). Across 3,615 main-benchmark traces from 5 models spanning 147 tasks and 9 mechanism families, policy-violating propagation rates of 11.5-41.3% persist across all models. This propagation is pathway-specific (rates from 0.0% to 74.4% across mechanisms for GPT-5.4) and concentrated in browser-mediated data flows; under the matched alternative-value control, propagation persists (25.9% vs. 20.4%; the matched-pair CI spans zero, so the comparison neither distinguishes nor equates the two rates). A prompt-mitigation study across 3 models shows policy-violating propagation rates as low as 0.3% (98% relative reduction from baseline) while preserving 80.5% utility, but effectiveness varies across models, motivating data-flow-aware defenses beyond prompting. Code, traces, and the labeling pipeline are publicly available under MIT and CC BY 4.0.

    中文

    多服务器 MCP 智能体会带来信息流控制（information-flow control，IFC）问题：忠实的工具组合可能使单独看似无害的读写权限导致凭据跨边界传播——这是工作流拓扑带来的结构性副作用，不一定反映模型的恶意行为。我们提出 MCPHunt。据我们所知，这是首个受控基准，用于隔离多服务器 MCP 信任边界间非对抗性、精确匹配的凭据传播；它包含三项方法贡献：（1）基于金丝雀的污点追踪，将传播检测简化为客观的字符串匹配；（2）受环境控制的覆盖设计，包含有风险、无害和强负例条件，用于验证流程的可靠性，并加入匹配的替代值对照（任务相同，合成凭据不同）；（3）完成任务需要秘密（completion-requires-secret，CRS）分层，用于区分任务要求的传播（忠实执行原文照搬的传递指令）和违反策略的传播（即便可以选择删去凭据，仍将其包含在内）。在来自 5 个模型、涵盖 147 项任务和 9 类机制的 3,615 条主基准轨迹中，所有模型均持续出现违反策略的传播，发生率为 11.5-41.3%。这种传播具有路径特异性（GPT-5.4 在不同机制下的发生率为 0.0% 至 74.4%），并集中在通过浏览器中介的数据流中；在匹配的替代值对照下，传播仍然存在（25.9% 对 20.4%；匹配对置信区间跨越零，因此该比较既无法区分这两个发生率，也无法证明它们相等）。一项涵盖 3 个模型的提示缓解研究表明，违反策略的传播发生率最低可降至 0.3%（相较基线降低 98%），同时保留 80.5% 的效用；但效果因模型而异，这说明需要超越提示的、具备数据流感知能力的防御。代码、轨迹和标注流程依据 MIT 和 CC BY 4.0 许可公开提供。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper builds a tokenized coastal-data representation and agent framework for faster exploration and query answering.     本文构建了一种令牌化沿海数据表示和智能体框架，以加快数据探索与查询回答。智能体提出并检验假设的能力与推理有一定关联，但核心贡献在于数据访问和智能体系统设计，没有明确分析推理机制或组合泛化能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models and the agents built on them are the most capable reasoning machines ever built, and science is beginning to put them to work. Atmospheric and oceanic sciences are starting to see agentic integration, but coastal hydrodynamics remains largely untouched by AI. Simply, agents cannot easily read its data products without saturating their context windows. A time frame from a coastal model can hold hundreds of megabytes, and if the archive's chunking does not suit the query, the agent will spend more time downloading and compacting than gaining insights. After all, the archives were designed for storage, not for the fast, on-the-fly access agents need. Speech and music once hit the same wall. A minute of audio is millions of numbers, yet today's audio models hold conversations and write music. They "learned" to do this by "listening" to tokens. Neural audio codecs turn waveforms into short sequences of discrete symbols that a model reads like words and decodes back into sound. Coastal water is a similar signal: dense, finely sampled, and repeatable. We are convinced it has an analogous compact native representation that preserves the salient physics. Tokens are that representation: small integers, light enough for an agent to sweep six months of a coastline in seconds. Agents can then do more than simple lookup-related tasks; they can form and test their hypotheses as they explore the tokenized representation efficiently. Herein, we build this framework, using vector quantized variational autoencoders to compress tide level, the non-tidal residual, and surface wind speed into 16x16 grids of tokens along the US Atlantic and Gulf coasts. Agents traverse and explore these grids (e.g., tracking, spatiotemporal trend analysis) considerably faster than raw archives in both on-prem and off-prem modalities, while correctly answering several types of under-specified queries.

    中文

    大型语言模型及其所构建的智能体是迄今最强大的推理机器，科学研究也开始让它们发挥作用。大气科学和海洋科学开始引入智能体，但海岸水动力学基本尚未受到 AI 的涉足。简而言之，智能体很难读取这类数据产品，否则上下文窗口就会被填满。一段沿海模型的时间帧可能包含数百兆字节；如果档案的分块方式不适合查询，智能体花在下载和压缩上的时间就会多于获取洞见的时间。毕竟，这些档案是为存储而设计的，并非为智能体所需的快速、即时访问而设计。语音和音乐曾经也遇到同样的瓶颈。一分钟音频包含数百万个数字，但如今的音频模型可以进行对话、创作音乐。它们通过“聆听”令牌“学会”了这些能力。神经音频编解码器将波形转换为简短的离散符号序列，模型像读词一样读取这些符号，再将其解码回声音。沿海水体也是一种类似的信号：密集、采样精细且可重复。我们确信，它也存在一种类似的紧凑原生表示，能够保留关键物理特性。令牌就是这种表示：它们是小整数，轻便到足以让智能体在几秒内遍历六个月的海岸线数据。这样一来，智能体就能执行简单查找以外的任务；它们可以在高效探索令牌化表示的同时提出并检验假设。本文构建了这一框架，使用向量量化变分自编码器，将美国大西洋沿岸和墨西哥湾沿岸的潮位、非潮汐残差和表面风速压缩为 16x16 的令牌网格。无论采用本地部署还是外部部署模式，智能体遍历和探索这些网格（例如进行追踪、时空趋势分析）都比处理原始档案快得多，同时还能正确回答多种信息不充分的查询。

    Hsin-Ling Hsu, Zizheng Wang, Donghua Zhang, Nai-Chia Chen, Jerry Wang, Jun-En Ding, Chia-Hsuan Hsu, Guoan Wang, Feng Liu, Fang-Ming Hung, Chenwei Wu, Liyue Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a pipeline and dataset for training LLMs to gather tests and update diagnoses across turns, with evidence-driven evaluation; this substantially targets multi-step reasoning. Its trajectory structure and agent interaction support that training setup, but the abstract gives no substantive account of compositional generalization or internal model mechanisms.

    本文开发了一套流程和数据集，用于训练 LLM 跨轮次收集检查结果并更新诊断，并通过证据驱动的评估进行衡量；其重点是多步推理。轨迹结构和智能体交互服务于这一训练设置，但摘要没有实质讨论组合泛化或模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Most existing LLM diagnoses are evaluated on static, single-turn settings where complete patient information is provided upfront, an oversimplification of real clinical practice. We study active diagnosis: the real-life clinical process of starting from initial observation, ordering tests, interpreting results, and updating a differential diagnosis across multiple turns. Through systematic analysis, we identify three recurring failure modes in current LLMs: ungrounded test ordering, unreliable diagnostic update, and degraded multi-turn coherence. Together, these failures reveal a core deficit: existing medical training data teaches models to reason from complete information but not to act under evolving, partial evidence. To address this gap, we introduce MedAction, a tree-structured distillation pipeline that synthesizes diverse and high-quality multi-turn diagnostic trajectories via LLM-environment interaction. We propose two knowledge-graph-grounded metrics to filter trajectory quality: Disease Trajectory Consistency (DTC), which tracks whether the model's hypothesis converges toward the correct diagnosis, and Reasoning-Action Consistency (RAC), which verifies that belief updates are driven by gathered evidence. Using this pipeline, we construct MedAction-32K, a dataset of 32,681 trajectories from 2,896 PMC cases. Fine-tuning an 8B model on MedAction-32K achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on both MedR-Bench and our curated MedAction-300-Hard benchmark, pushing the edge for open-source medical LLMs.

    中文

    现有大多数 LLM 诊断工作都在静态的单轮设定中评估，预先提供完整患者信息，这过度简化了真实临床实践。我们研究主动诊断：从初始观察出发、开具检查、解读结果，并在多轮交互中更新鉴别诊断的真实临床过程。通过系统分析，我们发现当前 LLM 存在三种反复出现的失败模式：开具检查缺乏依据、诊断更新不可靠，以及多轮连贯性下降。这些失败共同揭示了一项核心缺陷：现有医学训练数据教会模型根据完整信息进行推理，却没有教会它们在证据不断变化且不完整时采取行动。为弥补这一不足，我们提出 MedAction，一种通过 LLM 与环境交互来合成多样、高质量多轮诊断轨迹的树结构蒸馏流程。我们提出两种以知识图谱为依据的指标来筛选轨迹质量：疾病轨迹一致性（Disease Trajectory Consistency，DTC），用于追踪模型假设是否逐渐收敛到正确诊断；推理—行动一致性（Reasoning-Action Consistency，RAC），用于验证信念更新是否由收集到的证据驱动。使用该流程，我们构建了 MedAction-32K，这是一个包含 2,896 个 PMC 病例的 32,681 条轨迹的数据集。在 MedAction-32K 上对一个 8B 模型进行微调后，该模型在 MedR-Bench 和我们整理的 MedAction-300-Hard 基准上均达到开源模型中的最先进表现，进一步提升了开源医学 LLM 的能力上限。

    POETS: Uncertainty-Aware LLM Optimization via Compute-Efficient Policy Ensembles

    POETS：通过计算高效的策略集成实现不确定性感知的 LLM 优化

    Nicolas Menet, Andreas Krause, Abbas Rahimi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    POETS contributes a policy-ensemble method with a theoretical link to KL-regularized Thompson sampling and reports improved optimization and transfer, including on reasoning tasks. The ensemble architecture and compute-efficient LoRA branches advance model systems, while mathematical reasoning is an evaluation domain rather than the paper’s central contribution; no internal representation analysis is described.

    POETS 提出一种策略集成方法，在理论上关联到 KL 正则化的 Thompson sampling，并报告了优化和迁移能力的提升，包括在推理任务上的提升。集成架构和计算高效的 LoRA 分支推进了模型系统的发展；数学推理是评估领域，而非论文的核心贡献。文中没有描述对内部表征的分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Balancing exploration with exploitation is a core challenge in black-box optimization and reinforcement learning. We introduce POETS ($\textbf{Po}$licy $\textbf{E}$nsembles for $\textbf{T}$hompson $\textbf{S}$ampling), a novel framework that bridges uncertainty quantification and policy optimization. Our approach is grounded in the insight that policies trained with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization implicitly encode an underlying reward function. Building on this, POETS bypasses the complex, nested process of training an uncertainty-aware reward model and separately fitting a policy to this model. Instead, we directly train a policy ensemble to capture epistemic uncertainty by matching implicitly encoded reward functions to online, bootstrapped data. To overcome the prohibitive compute and memory constraints of ensembling Large Language Models (LLMs), POETS utilizes an efficient architecture: the ensemble shares a pre-trained backbone while maintaining diversity through independent Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) branches. Theoretically, we show that POETS implicitly approximates KL-regularized Thompson sampling, a principled optimization strategy with optimal cumulative regret bounds of $O(\sqrt{T \gamma_T})$. Empirically, we demonstrate that POETS achieves state-of-the-art sample efficiency across diverse scientific discovery domains, including protein search, therapeutic molecular design, and quantum circuit design. POETS also improves the optimization trajectory and out-of-distribution transfer of reinforcement learning across mathematical reasoning and code generation tasks, proving particularly robust in off-policy settings with experience replay or in small dataset regimes.

    中文

    在黑箱优化和强化学习中，平衡探索与利用是一项核心挑战。我们提出 POETS（$\textbf{Po}$策略$\textbf{E}$集成以实现$\textbf{T}$汤普森$\textbf{S}$采样），这是一种将不确定性量化与策略优化相结合的新框架。我们的方法基于这样一个洞见：经过 Kullback-Leibler（KL）正则化训练的策略会隐式编码底层奖励函数。基于此，POETS 跳过了复杂的嵌套流程——先训练具备不确定性感知能力的奖励模型，再单独拟合策略以适配该模型。相反，我们直接训练策略集成，通过将隐式编码的奖励函数与在线自助采样数据相匹配来捕捉认知不确定性。为克服集成大型语言模型（LLM）带来的高昂计算和内存限制，POETS 采用了一种高效架构：集成共享一个预训练主干，同时通过独立的低秩适配（LoRA）分支保持多样性。从理论上讲，我们证明 POETS 隐式近似 KL 正则化的 Thompson sampling；这是一种有原则的优化策略，具有最优累计遗憾界 $O(\sqrt{T \gamma_T})$。在实证方面，我们证明 POETS 在多个科学发现领域（包括蛋白质搜索、治疗性分子设计和量子电路设计）中实现了最先进的样本效率。POETS 还能改善数学推理和代码生成任务中强化学习的优化轨迹与分布外迁移；在使用经验回放的离策略设置或小数据集场景中，它尤其稳健。

    Injection-Execution Dissociation: A Mechanistic Evaluation of Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in Stateful LLM Agents

    注入—执行解耦：对有状态 LLM 智能体中持久记忆攻击与防御的机制评估

    Jun Wen Leong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study separates memory storage from later execution, evaluates architectural defenses, and uses causal mediation to investigate attack paths, providing substantive evidence about persistent-memory agent behavior. This supports systems and offers limited mechanistic insight, but it does not study general reasoning or compositional generalization.

    这项研究将记忆存储与后续执行分开考察，评估了架构层面的防御措施，并运用因果中介分析调查攻击路径，为持久记忆智能体的行为提供了实质性证据。它对系统研究有所贡献，并带来有限的机制层面洞见，但没有研究一般推理或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In LLM agents with persistent memory, whether a model stores an injected instruction and whether it later acts on it are separable safety properties. We call this the injection-execution dissociation. We evaluate 29 frontier endpoints with the malicious document in the retrieval corpus (N=10 each, four topped up to N=40; an earlier bug-affected collection is superseded). Execution is common: 7 endpoints exfiltrate in at least 9 of 10 runs and 11 more in some but fewer. Zero exfiltration is weak evidence of resistance: GPT-5.4, GPT-5.6-sol and Claude Haiku 4.5 never exfiltrate in 40 draft-only runs each but send almost no email, and in an exploratory follow-up that supplies the content and asks for a send they exfiltrate in 20 of 20, 5 of 20 and 6 of 20 runs. Anthropic's Opus and Sonnet models mostly store no forwarding directive and exfiltrate in at most 1 of 10 draft-only runs. We test six defences at four architectural layers in a 5,040-run factorial on nine open-weight models (N=40 per cell); these models store the instruction in every run, so it tests execution only. Input filters never see the payload, which arrives through retrieval. Retrieval-layer classifiers see it but, at the small operating points tested, do not flag it; frontier judges did. Only Memory Sandbox, which removes the recall tool, blocks the attack (0% ASR for eight of nine models). It is bypassed when a model rebuilds the instruction from the retrieval corpus: three Bedrock-served models do so (32.5-97.5% ASR), and a causal-mediation study on two OpenAI models attributes every success under the sandbox to this path. Stored but dormant instructions may create a cross-model risk; transfer was not demonstrated. Defences should be evaluated at both stages.

    中文

    对于具有持久记忆的 LLM 智能体，模型是否存储了注入的指令，以及之后是否会据此采取行动，是可以分开考察的安全属性。我们将其称为注入—执行解耦。我们在检索语料中放入恶意文档，对 29 个前沿端点进行评估（每个端点 N=10，其中四个补充至 N=40；一项受早期缺陷影响的采集已由此结果取代）。执行攻击很常见：7 个端点在至少 9/10 次运行中外传数据，另有 11 个端点在部分运行中外传。零外传只能算是抵抗攻击的微弱证据：GPT-5.4、GPT-5.6-sol 和 Claude Haiku 4.5 在各自 40 次仅起草邮件的运行中从未外传数据，但它们几乎不发送邮件；在一项探索性后续实验中，我们提供内容并要求发送，它们分别在 20/20、5/20 和 6/20 次运行中外传数据。Anthropic 的 Opus 和 Sonnet 模型大多不会存储转发指令，在仅起草邮件的运行中至多有 1/10 次外传数据。我们在九个开放权重模型上进行 5,040 次运行的因子实验，在四个架构层级测试六种防御措施（每个实验单元 N=40）；这些模型在每次运行中都会存储指令，因此该实验只测试执行阶段。输入过滤器从未看到载荷，因为载荷是通过检索传入的。检索层分类器能够看到载荷，但在测试的小规模运行点上并未将其标记；前沿模型评审器则做到了。只有移除回忆工具的 Memory Sandbox 能阻断攻击（九个模型中有八个的 ASR 为 0%）。如果模型从检索语料中重新构造指令，就能绕过该防御：三个由 Bedrock 提供服务的模型会这样做（ASR 为 32.5-97.5%）；针对两个 OpenAI 模型的因果中介研究将沙箱下的每一次成功攻击都归因于这条路径。已存储但处于休眠状态的指令可能带来跨模型风险；本研究并未证明这种迁移。防御措施应在两个阶段都接受评估。

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language models (VLMs) perform strongly on multimodal benchmarks, yet their ability to reliably follow continuous visual structure remains unclear. We focus on path following, a basic operation that requires following a selected path through successive visual continuations. Before considering complex factors such as crossings or overlaps, we first test whether current VLMs can robustly follow a simple continuous line under controlled settings that remove such confounds. Across frontier models, we find that tracing is already fragile, with this vulnerability manifesting as unstable path preservation in the presence of other nearby paths. Analysis of internal representations shows that information needed to determine the correct path continuation becomes weaker, with this degradation already emerging in the visual encoding stage. Common remedies do not resolve this weakness: model scaling provides limited improvement, additional reasoning provides uneven gains at substantial cost, and explicit tracing instructions fail to stabilize performance.     We revisit the I/O complexity of attention in large language models. Given query-key-value matrices $Q,K,V\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$, and a machine with fast memory size $M$, the goal is to compute the "attention matrix" $A=\text{softmax}(Q K ^{\top}/\sqrt{d}) V$ with the minimal number of data transfers between fast and slow memory. Existing methods in the literature, most notably FlashAttention and its variants, incur an I/O cost that depends quadratically on the context length $n$, while a trivial lower bound only requires $\Omega(nd)$ I/O's to read the inputs and write the output. In this work we show that the dependence on $n$ can be reduced to almost-linear, by developing I/O-efficient algorithms inspired by the recent approximate attention method of Alman and Song [NeurIPS'23]. We also provide (algorithm-specific) lower bounds in different parameter regimes, which nearly match the corresponding upper bounds, indicating that the proposed algorithms are indeed close to I/O-optimal.

    GRKV introduces a training-free regression method that spreads evicted-token information across retained tokens to reduce KV-cache merging error and memory overhead.     GRKV 提出一种免训练的回归方法，将被淘汰 token 的信息分散到保留的 token 中，从而降低 KV 缓存合并误差和内存开销。这对模型内存与推理计算作出了实质性贡献，但仅凭注意力输出目标不足以证明其对内部可解释性有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) with extended context lengths rely on the key-value (KV) cache to support attention over prior tokens. However, maintaining the KV cache incurs substantial memory overhead, motivating KV-cache compression methods that enforce a fixed budget through eviction and merging. Modern eviction methods increasingly adopt span-based retention because preserving contiguous spans is empirically effective and better preserves semantic coherence. Yet, when combined with post-eviction merging, span-based retention concentrates merges onto a small set of span-boundary carrier tokens, producing a highly imbalanced merge pattern that exacerbates over-merging and increases information loss. To address this imbalance, we propose GRKV (Global Regression for KV Cache), a training-free KV-cache merging method that directly minimizes the discrepancy between compressed-cache and full-cache attention outputs. GRKV uses ridge-regression-based merge steps to distribute information from evicted tokens across retained tokens, while regularizing the updates to prevent over-smoothing. Across the LongBench and RULER long-context benchmarks, GRKV is the only merging method that improves overall performance with minimal overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/pjunjie/GRKV.

    中文

    具有扩展上下文长度的大型语言模型（LLM）依赖键值（KV）缓存来支持对先前 token 的注意力计算。然而，维护 KV 缓存会带来显著的内存开销，因此人们提出了通过淘汰和合并来施加固定预算的 KV 缓存压缩方法。现代淘汰方法越来越多地采用基于片段的保留策略，因为经验证明，保留连续片段效果良好，也更能保持语义连贯性。然而，当这种策略与淘汰后的合并结合时，合并操作会集中到少数片段边界的承载 token 上，形成极不均衡的合并模式，加剧过度合并并增加信息损失。为解决这种失衡，我们提出 GRKV（KV 缓存全局回归），一种免训练的 KV 缓存合并方法，直接最小化压缩缓存与完整缓存的注意力输出之间的差异。GRKV 使用基于岭回归的合并步骤，将被淘汰 token 的信息分散到保留的 token 中，同时通过正则化更新来防止过度平滑。在 LongBench 和 RULER 长上下文基准测试中，GRKV 是唯一一种能以极低开销提升整体表现的合并方法。代码见 https://github.com/pjunjie/GRKV。

    StemBind：多模态大语言模型在抽象视觉推理中如何迷失于规则与实例之间

    Xixiang He, Baiqi Wu, Xingming Li, Ao Cheng, Qiyao Sun, Xuanyu Ji, Qingyong Hu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a diagnostic benchmark that separates perception, rule induction, and answer selection, and identifies rule-to-instance mapping as a major visual-reasoning failure. Its analysis of combining a rule with an instance is an incidental compositional connection; it does not study internal representations or model systems.

    本文提供了一个诊断基准，将感知、规则归纳和答案选择区分开来，并指出规则到实例的映射是视觉推理中的主要失败环节。其对规则与实例如何结合的分析，只与组合能力有所间接关联；本文没有研究内部表征或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often know the rule but pick the wrong answer: on abstract visual reasoning (AVR) tasks, a model can describe what it sees and name the underlying pattern, yet still fail to choose the matching candidate. Existing AVR benchmarks cannot detect this because they collapse perception, rule induction, and answer selection into a single right-or-wrong signal. We introduce StemBind, a shared-stem diagnostic benchmark that probes the same visual stem with three aligned questions: Perception (what is in the image), Rule (what pattern governs it), and Full (which option completes it), so a final-answer error can be attributed to a specific sub-step on the same evidence. StemBind contains 2,298 curated knowledge-light stems across nine auditable visual operations, totaling 19,533 P/R/F tasks, with each full item annotated by Sternberg's four reasoning stages (S1 Encode, S2 Infer, S3 Map, S4 Apply). Evaluating 24 frontier MLLM configurations yields four findings. (i) The R-F chasm: rule accuracy exceeds full-item accuracy on 22 of 24 models, so most failures happen after the rule is identified. (ii) A persistent binding gap: even when P and R are both correct on the same stem, models still answer F incorrectly 51.2% of the time. (iii) The bottleneck is S3: process diagnostics and Stage-wise Stimulus Augmentation localize the dominant failure to rule-to-instance mapping. (iv) Scaling and thinking do not help: neither larger models nor explicit thinking mode reliably closes the gap, and thinking even lowers rule and full-item accuracy. StemBind reframes AVR evaluation from final-answer ranking to locating where abstract visual reasoning breaks down, identifying rule-to-instance binding as a concrete next target for vision-grounded reasoning.

    中文

    多模态大语言模型（MLLM）常常知道规则却选错答案：在抽象视觉推理（AVR）任务中，模型能够描述所见内容并指出其背后的模式，却仍可能无法选出匹配的候选项。现有 AVR 基准无法检测这一点，因为它们把感知、规则归纳和答案选择合并成单一的对错信号。我们提出 StemBind，这是一种共享题干诊断基准，针对同一视觉题干提出三个对应问题：感知（图像中有什么）、规则（支配图像的模式是什么）和完整题目（哪个选项能补全图像），从而能够依据相同证据，将最终答案错误归因于某个具体子步骤。StemBind 包含 2,298 个经过筛选、所需知识较少的题干，涵盖九种可审计的视觉操作，共计 19,533 个 P/R/F 任务；每道完整题目都依据 Sternberg 的四个推理阶段进行标注（S1 编码、S2 推断、S3 映射、S4 应用）。对 24 种前沿 MLLM 配置的评估得到四项发现。(i) R-F 鸿沟：22/24 个模型的规则准确率高于完整题目准确率，因此大多数失败发生在识别规则之后。(ii) 持续存在的绑定鸿沟：即使模型在同一题干上对 P 和 R 的回答都正确，回答 F 时仍有 51.2% 的概率出错。(iii) 瓶颈在 S3：过程诊断和分阶段刺激增强将主要失败定位于规则到实例的映射。(iv) 扩大规模和思考都没有帮助：更大的模型和显式思考模式都无法可靠地弥合这一鸿沟，而且思考甚至会降低规则准确率和完整题目准确率。StemBind 将 AVR 评估从最终答案排名转向定位抽象视觉推理失效的环节，并指出规则到实例的绑定是视觉基础推理中一个明确的后续研究目标。

    Tianlong Nan, Xiaopeng Li, Christian Kroer, Tianyi Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops exploration methods and regret guarantees for preference-based LLM alignment, with experiments on fine-tuning. This substantially advances learning methods relevant to capability development, while policy exploration is only an incidental systems connection and no internal mechanisms or compositional generalization are studied.

    本文针对基于偏好的 LLM 对齐，开发了探索方法和遗憾保证，并进行了微调实验。这对相关学习方法及能力发展作出了实质性贡献；策略探索仅与系统研究间接相关，本文没有研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Preference alignment is central to improving large language models (LLMs), but reward-based formulations can be restrictive when human preferences are non-transitive. Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) addresses this limitation by modeling alignment as a preference game and seeking a Nash equilibrium. However, the learning-theoretic foundations of scalable NLHF remain limited: existing regret guarantees rely on explicit preference-model estimation and minimax oracles, whereas simpler iterative methods lack such guarantees. We study online iterative NLHF and identify exploration as a key obstacle. First, we show that standard iterative NLHF can incur an exponential dependence on the inverse KL-regularization parameter, demonstrating that implicit exploration through policy updates can be insufficient. We then propose Exploratory Nash Preference Optimization (ENPO), which combines a SFT-type regularization with adversarial policy exploration. ENPO eliminates this exponential dependence without requiring minimax oracles or explicit preference-model estimation. We further introduce Bonus-Explorer ENPO (BENPO), which uses additional oracles to achieve an $O(\log T)$ regret bound. Finally, we develop Direct ENPO (DENPO), a practical variant of ENPO for fine-tuning LLMs. Experiments with Llama-3-8B-Instruct demonstrate consistent improvements over the evaluated RLHF and NLHF baselines across multiple benchmarks.

    中文

    偏好对齐对于改进大型语言模型（LLM）至关重要，但当人类偏好不具传递性时，基于奖励的建模方式会受到限制。基于人类反馈的纳什学习（NLHF）通过将对齐建模为偏好博弈并寻求纳什均衡，解决了这一限制。然而，可扩展 NLHF 的学习理论基础仍不充分：现有遗憾保证依赖显式偏好模型估计和极小极大预言机，而更简单的迭代方法则缺乏这类保证。我们研究在线迭代 NLHF，并指出探索是一个关键障碍。首先，我们证明，标准迭代 NLHF 对 KL 正则化参数倒数的依赖可能呈指数级，说明通过策略更新进行隐式探索可能并不充分。随后，我们提出探索式纳什偏好优化（ENPO），将 SFT 类型的正则化与对抗式策略探索相结合。ENPO 无需极小极大预言机或显式偏好模型估计，即可消除这种指数级依赖。我们进一步提出 Bonus-Explorer ENPO（BENPO），借助额外的预言机实现 $O(\log T)$ 遗憾界。最后，我们开发 Direct ENPO（DENPO），这是 ENPO 的实用变体，可用于微调 LLM。使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的实验表明，在多个基准测试中，该方法持续优于所评估的 RLHF 和 NLHF 基线。

    ENGLISH

    Learning from imperfect data is a central theme in machine learning, connecting practical questions of robustness to fundamental questions of learnability. Here we examine attribute noise: learning from corrupted inputs while keeping the labels intact, a setting that has received considerably less analytical attention than its label-noise counterpart. We consider two types of corruption models: additive noise and replacement noise. Through experiments with multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on corrupted classification datasets, we find that neural networks remain robust, maintaining well-above-chance accuracy even when inputs are >90% corrupted -- far beyond human recognition. To understand this robustness, we analyze infinite-width networks in the heavy-corruption regime using a mean-field-inspired approach and derive a leading-order decision rule for the classification outcome: the network implements a prototype rule, the nearest-class-mean, assigning each test point to the class whose training-set average it most closely resembles. This leading-order decision rule is universal across a broad range of MLP architectures, holding for any depth, as well as a wide class of activation functions and noise distributions. The same centroid mechanism closely matches finite-width network behavior in our experiments and provides an interpretable and analytically tractable account of why learning can succeed even when individual training examples carry almost no signal.

SWARR has two stages: (1) efficient conversion from a pretrained SA model to SWA with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which avoids pretraining a new base model, and (2) policy adaptation with reinforcement learning (RL). We find that SWA still underperforms SA after SFT, and we hypothesize that this gap is caused in part by a data-architecture mismatch: most SFT data are prepared for SA models and may contain long-range dependencies that are difficult for SWA to model. Because on-policy RL optimizes self-generated trajectories under the SWA constraint, it can adapt trajectories to better match SWA. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that this recipe substantially narrows the gap between SWA and SA, recovering much of the accuracy lost during SWA conversion while preserving the efficiency benefits of linear-complexity attention. Our central contribution is the empirical finding that RL changes the conclusion one would draw from conversion and SFT alone about SWA's viability for math reasoning.

    中文

    推理型和智能体型大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展增加了对长上下文推理的需求，但自注意力（SA）的计算量会随上下文长度呈二次增长。为此，我们研究 SWARR（用于数学推理的强化适配滑动窗口注意力），这是一套将 SWA 模型适配到数学推理任务的实用方案。SWARR 分两个阶段：(1) 通过监督微调（SFT）将预训练 SA 模型高效转换为 SWA 模型，无需预训练新的基础模型；(2) 通过强化学习（RL）进行策略适配。我们发现，经过 SFT 后，SWA 的表现仍逊于 SA；我们推测，造成这一差距的部分原因是数据与架构不匹配：大多数 SFT 数据是为 SA 模型准备的，可能包含 SWA 难以建模的长距离依赖。由于在线策略 RL 会在 SWA 约束下优化模型自行生成的轨迹，因此能够调整轨迹，使其更适合 SWA。在数学推理基准上的实验表明，这一方案显著缩小了 SWA 与 SA 之间的差距，在保留线性复杂度注意力效率优势的同时，恢复了 SWA 转换过程中损失的大部分准确率。我们的核心贡献是通过实证发现：与仅依据转换和 SFT 得出的结论相比，RL 会改变人们对 SWA 是否适用于数学推理的判断。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A theory can accommodate a counterexample by adding an exception. The harder problem is deciding how far the exception should extend and which predictions should survive. We present DeFAb, a dataset and symbolic verification framework built from curated biological knowledge in the Gene Ontology. Models fill gaps in a theory or propose exceptions to its rules. A verifier checks the consequences of each edit, allowing different solutions to receive credit. Simple symbolic repairs solve all 336 tasks in the released evaluation panel. This result exposes a limitation of the revision test. An exception tied to one entity can succeed without identifying a pattern that applies to other cases. We develop a contextual task that requires an exception to reach the relevant cases and preserve predictions elsewhere. Two planned studies compare training with verified and rejected examples, and revision with and without feedback about consequences. DeFAb makes the scope of a proposed explanation testable, providing a controlled step toward studying theory revision in scientific reasoning.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Serving open-weight language models on premises forces a trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. Hosting models of different sizes lets easy queries go to a small, efficient model and hard ones to a large model. We present CRE-Router (Cluster, Route, Escalate), a two-stage method that decides which of these models answers each query. It clusters queries and routes each cluster to the model that best trades error against cost, under a budget on the time per output token (TPOT) or the end-to-end latency per request (E2EL). It then either accepts the answer or, when a quality estimator rejects it, escalates the query to the strong model. Routing decides before generation, so a hard query goes straight to the strong model; escalation decides after, so it can catch the errors routing cannot predict. It needs no annotation beyond task-correctness labels. We evaluate CRE-Router on TeleMath, TeleQnA and AIME, with pools of two to nine models served on A100 GPUs. CRE-Router is more accurate than the efficient models in its pool and comparable to the strong model it escalates to, at a lower cost per token. We also find that the choice of cost term decides which models serve the workload, that pricing each model per cluster shortens the wait per request, and that a change of hardware changes the best routing.

The two tasks are jointly optimized with CoAA-RL, which rewards forecasts by their utility for downstream safety judgment. The resulting guard model, Vanguard, blocks unsafe actions before execution.     On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities by supervising trajectories sampled from the student's own policy, yet its generalization behavior remains poorly understood, as most studies evaluate OPD on a single domain and on benchmarks close to the training data. We present a controlled study that varies one generalization factor at a time, from in-domain distribution shifts to cross-domain transfer and the multi-teacher setting. In cooperative cooking, wildfire response and medical question answering, the experienced newcomer, averaged over seats, outscores the one without a notebook in every setting, so the usual comparison would approve it.     ENGLISH

    Autonomous LLM agents can turn semantic judgments into consequential actions such as payments and permission changes. If the same process makes these judgments and controls a reusable signing credential, a mistaken judgment can reach execution without further approval. To make LLM review govern execution, we present KITA, an authorization architecture that keeps the user's personal signing key and every threshold signing-key share outside all LLM processes. Under threshold-signature unforgeability and our system assumptions, an adversary controlling the proposer and fewer than t reviewer-signer domains cannot produce a valid authorization for a new action without signing contributions from t distinct domains. This execution-bound authorization integrity ensures that each accepted authorization includes a share from an uncompromised domain, bound to the canonical action and released only after authenticated reviewer approval. We implement an in-process prototype of KITA with a structured-output LLM adapter and threshold BLS. Six system tests validate quorum gating and message binding, seven controlled baseline scenarios compare authorization outcomes, and cryptographic microbenchmarks measure online signing cost and its scaling behavior.

    Task vectors enable post-training model editing by identifying semantically meaningful directions in weight space, typically computed as the difference between a fine-tuned model and its pretrained initialization. However, this reliance on fine-tuning makes discovering such directions costly and limits the practicality of post-training model editing. To address this limitation, we introduce Training-Free Task Vectors (TFTVs), a novel method to compute task-vector-like directions without requiring fine-tuning. Our method maps activation steering vectors to rank-one weight-space edits using only forward-pass statistics, while satisfying arithmetic properties that directly support learning via addition, forgetting via subtraction, and the composition of multiple edits. Empirically, we evaluate TFTVs on large language model behavioral control tasks and show that they consistently amplify, suppress, and compose target behaviors while preserving general knowledge and problem-solving skills. We also validate our method against other editing and steering baselines, experimentally demonstrating that TFTVs achieve stronger trait control with better or competitive utility preservation. We hope our work opens new directions for the community in post-training model editing and broader training-free model control. Code is available on the project website: tftv-llm.github.io.

    Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. A rigorous evaluation reveals that leading hierarchical macro planners routinely emit physically unrealisable sub-goals. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the strongest hierarchical baseline on the same world model while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

    Multi-turn LLM agents often receive sparse task feedback across several interactions, while generating each response token by token. This creates two related credit-assignment questions: which responses helped achieve the outcome, and which generation decisions mattered within each response? Existing methods typically focus on only one level: turn-level methods evaluate complete responses but do not distinguish the decisions within them; token-level methods can propagate feedback across turns but do not explicitly model credit for each response. These complementary limitations motivate learning credit at both levels and coordinating it in a single policy update. We introduce VETTA, a credit assignment method that jointly learns turn- and token-level values through separate heads on a shared lightweight critic. VETTA computes advantages along both temporal sequences and combines each turn advantage with a within-response-centered token residual for PPO updates. Furthermore, to reduce value-learning cost, the critic retains only early Transformer blocks from the pretrained checkpoint used to initialize the actor. Experiments on four agent benchmarks demonstrate VETTA's strong performance. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, VETTA achieves success rates of 95.5% on ALFWorld, 76.0% on WebShop, and 52.2% on ScienceWorld. With Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, it reaches 84.9% and 80.7% success on Sokoban under sparse and dense rewards, respectively. Critic-depth comparisons further show strong task performance with substantially lower critic-side computation. These results demonstrate that coordinating turn- and token-level credit with a lightweight shared critic improves agent performance while keeping value estimation efficient. Code is available at https://github.com/Jiaju-Chen/VETTA-official.

    Task-oriented conversational agents remain fragile under real world conversation scenarios as they rarely follow a predictable script, especially when users exhibit non-cooperative behavior. Existing function-calling benchmarks often emphasize successful, cooperative interactions and underrepresent adversarial conversation trajectories, thereby limiting the training resources available for developing robust agents.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) offer a parameter efficient approach to scaling reasoning by reusing shared parameters across recurrent computation steps. Despite their promise, effective post-training of LoopLMs remains challenging. Existing approaches either provide reward based supervision that is sparse or costly to extend across loops, or rely on external teachers or privileged information, leading to limited teacher availability or teacher-student context mismatch. To address these limitations, we introduce LoopOPD, a cross-loop on-policy distillation framework that uses additional recurrent computation within a LoopLM as its own source of supervision. LoopOPD uses a frozen terminal loop policy as a compute privileged teacher for an intermediate loop student on student generated rollouts, providing dense supervision without an external teacher or privileged information. We further propose Dynamic LoopOPD (D-LoopOPD), which continually refreshes the terminal loop teacher as the shared model parameters are updated, enabling recurrent self-improvement. We characterize how distillation updates propagate across loop depths and derive sufficient conditions under which a single update yields simultaneous local improvement at both loop depths. Experiments on Ouro-Thinking models show that LoopOPD improves mathematical reasoning, while D-LoopOPD yields further gains through dynamic teacher updates. Despite being trained only on mathematical data, the resulting models also improve on general reasoning and code generation benchmarks, demonstrating that recurrent computation can serve as an effective source of supervision for LoopLMs. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) provide a parameter efficient approach to scaling model capabilities through repeated use of shared parameters across recurrent steps. Since each recurrent depth can be read out independently, a single LoopLM exposes a broader output space across inference depths, raising an important question: whether safety is preserved throughout recurrent computation. Prior evaluations suggest that deeper recurrence can improve safety on harmful queries, but robustness under jailbreak attacks remains unclear. We therefore conduct a comprehensive safety evaluation of LoopLMs under jailbreak attacks targeting different recurrent depths. We find that attack success can increase at deeper inference depths, the same query can elicit different safety behaviors across depths, and attacks constructed against one depth can transfer to others. Moreover, SFT and preference alignment do not eliminate these safety gaps, motivating an alignment method designed for LoopLMs. We introduce SafeBridge, which combines lightweight depth specific control of shared recurrent layers, selective state bridging, and joint safety supervision across recurrent depths. Across model scales, multiple attack methods, and safety benchmarks, SafeBridge substantially reduces attack success for both matched-depth and cross-depth attacks. It also improves general utility over the vanilla models while maintaining comparable over-refusal behavior. Our results show that the safety of a LoopLM cannot be inferred from a single recurrent depth, motivating safety alignment across recurrent computation. Our code and model checkpoints will be released upon acceptance.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Probes on activation vectors are widely used to detect misbehavior in language models, but their success relies on the assumption that models cannot control what their activations encode. Humans can learn, through neurofeedback, to control the firing of even single neurons, and recent studies investigated whether this ability extends to language models, reaching conflicting conclusions. No experimental design so far disentangles competence at the task from genuine access to one's own activations. We fill this gap with in-context neurofeedback sessions, in which a "subject" model is asked to maximize (or minimize) a score derived from its activations, shown back to it at every turn. In our first experiment, the sentences are generated either by the subject or by a second "writer" model, while the score always derives from the activations of the subject. We test ten open-weight models from five families, with sizes from 9B to 32B. Some models move their own scores considerably, but no more than a writer of comparable competence moves them. Is this because the task requires no privileged access, or because the subject controls its activations while processing the sentences, whoever wrote them? To answer this, we prefill a fixed sentence as the subject's reply at every turn and ask it to increase or decrease the score. Three out of ten models show small but consistent control effects. We further ask whether models can control their activations to the point of fooling an activation monitor. We make models repeat sentences a monitor would flag, such as a deceptive answer for a deception monitor, and ask them to raise or lower the monitor's score. No model learns to lower it, but one model can raise it. In-context control of a model's own activations might not yet be a threat to activation monitors, but it exists in a few models and needs to be tracked as models evolve.

Three context-engineering techniques (CETs) help by shaping it: semantic layers describe the data, orchestration splits work among agents, and compaction condenses interaction history. Existing studies validate each CET alone, leaving open how agent behavior shapes its effect. We present a comprehensive analysis of the three CETs, alone and combined, with seven large language models (LLMs) on 1,514 long-horizon tasks from five benchmarks, covering behavior, accuracy and cost. We find that data agents without CETs form three behavior groups: investigators, premature answerers that answer without inspecting data, and early stoppers that give up. Each CET delivers its known benefit, from more investigation to smaller prompts, but only the behavior group it matches turns that benefit into accuracy, such as premature answerers under orchestration. For investigators, the same CETs can hurt: the semantic layer stops them from looking, orchestration makes them overconfident, costing 5 percentage points, and compaction makes them repeat steps. Combining CETs yields smaller gains and losses than their sum. We derive guidance for choosing CETs by agent behavior, task demands and accuracy-cost trade-offs.

    中文

    在异构数据上回答问题意味着要结合来自文件、数据库、文档和网络的证据。数据智能体将这一过程自动化，但其成功取决于上下文。三种上下文工程技术（CET）通过塑造上下文发挥作用：语义层描述数据，编排将工作分配给多个智能体，压缩则浓缩交互历史。现有研究分别验证了每种 CET，但智能体行为如何影响其效果仍未明确。我们使用七种大型语言模型（LLM），在来自五个基准的 1,514 项长时程任务上，对这三种 CET 单独及组合使用进行了全面分析，考察了行为、准确率和成本。我们发现，不使用 CET 的数据智能体形成三类行为：调查者、未检查数据便作答的过早回答者，以及放弃任务的过早停止者。每种 CET 都能带来已知益处，从增加调查到缩短提示，但只有与该益处相匹配的行为组才能将其转化为准确率提升，例如编排对过早回答者的作用。对调查者而言，同样的 CET 可能有害：语义层会阻止他们继续查找，编排会让他们过度自信，导致准确率下降 5 个百分点，而压缩会让他们重复步骤。组合使用 CET 所带来的增益和损失都小于各自效果之和。我们据此提出指导建议，根据智能体行为、任务需求以及准确率与成本之间的权衡来选择 CET。

    算法模型化：将优化算法转化为可演化的智能

    Jian Yao, Zhiyao Zhang, Yichen Li, Xingyu Wu, and Kay Chen Tan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper turns iterative optimization into a trainable autoregressive model that learns from algorithm trajectories and optimization feedback, then generalizes across problems and larger dimensions. This substantially advances learned problem-solving algorithms, with partial relevance to composition through population interactions and iterative dynamics; the abstract does not describe internal interpretability or agent system design.

    本文将迭代优化转化为可训练的自回归模型，使其从算法轨迹和优化反馈中学习，并泛化到不同问题和更高维度。它显著推动了学习式问题求解算法的发展；种群交互和迭代动态与组合性部分相关，但摘要没有描述内部可解释性或智能体系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Can algorithms be learned and evolved as models, rather than repeatedly redesigned as programs? We explore this question by introducing Algorithm Modelization, a new paradigm that turns iterative algorithms into trainable models. Its central idea is to regard algorithm execution trajectories as computational experience: by learning how algorithmic states evolve over iterations, a model can internalize the knowledge embodied in existing algorithms, reproduce their computational behaviors, and further evolve beyond them through training. As a first realization of this paradigm, we modelize iterative optimization as an autoregressive process, where preceding generations constitute the computational context for generating the next population. We develop a dimension-independent population-temporal architecture to capture both population interactions and iterative dynamics, together with an imitation-to-surpassing learning framework that first acquires algorithmic knowledge from heterogeneous teachers and then improves the resulting optimizer directly through optimization feedback. The modelized optimizer consequently goes beyond reproducing individual algorithms: it consolidates heterogeneous search knowledge into a single trainable model, achieves stronger optimization capability through subsequent improvement, and generalizes its acquired knowledge across problems and substantially larger unseen dimensions. More fundamentally, Algorithm Modelization makes algorithmic capability accumulable through learning, where new algorithms and problem-solving experience can become training resources for progressively improving the model. Our results establish a promising path from manually designed algorithms toward general algorithm models that learn, generalize, and evolve from computational experience.

    中文

    能否将算法作为模型来学习和演化，而不必反复将其重新设计为程序？我们通过提出算法模型化这一新范式来探索这个问题，它将迭代算法转变为可训练模型。其核心思想是将算法执行轨迹视为计算经验：通过学习算法状态如何随迭代演化，模型能够内化现有算法蕴含的知识，复现其计算行为，并通过训练进一步超越这些算法。作为这一范式的初步实现，我们将迭代优化模型化为自回归过程，其中前几代构成生成下一代种群的计算上下文。我们开发了一种与维度无关的种群—时间架构，用于捕捉种群交互和迭代动态；并提出一种从模仿到超越的学习框架，先从异构教师中获取算法知识，再通过优化反馈直接改进所得优化器。因此，模型化优化器不再局限于复现单个算法：它将异构搜索知识整合进一个可训练模型，通过后续改进获得更强的优化能力，并将习得的知识泛化到不同问题以及维度大得多的未见问题上。更根本地说，算法模型化使算法能力能够通过学习不断积累，新算法和问题求解经验都可以成为训练资源，以逐步改进模型。我们的结果为从人工设计算法迈向能够从计算经验中学习、泛化和演化的通用算法模型，确立了一条有前景的路径。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

We study persona selection with binary comparisons between candidate responses as the online signal.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse attention limits the keys used by each query, but finding those keys can still require a full-prefix scan at every layer. We introduce $MLIPS:$ $Multi$-$Layer$ $Indexer$ $Pool$ $Sharing$, a training-free method that shares candidate search while retaining each consumer's own scoring and selection. A producer publishes a top-$M$ pool larger than the attention budget $K$; subsequent layers select their own top-$K$ from that pool. Measurements across three sparse-attention model families show substantially higher coverage from broad pools than overlap between final selections. We implement layerwise sharing, persistent decode reuse, and a coarse producer in vLLM for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Across four long-context suites, three consumer layers per producer give $1.14$-$1.40\times$ speedups and $14.8$-$27.4\%$ lower GPU energy, with observed accuracy changes of $-1.49$ to $+0.29$ percentage points in single runs. More extensive sharing exposes task-dependent quality losses. Sampled prefill traces also reveal recurring selected KV positions across query groups and layers. We characterize this shared working-set structure and use it to motivate Top-$G$, an exploratory bounded pool construction for prefill. Its deployment, task accuracy, and serving benefits remain open.

    ENGLISH

    Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.

    Pavlos Poulos, Katelyn Sadorf, Themos Stafylakis, Costas A. Anastassiou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a spiking recurrent architecture that couples ternary temporal filtering with resonate-and-fire neurons, reporting speech recognition performance and modeled efficiency. Its learned layer hierarchy and latent manifolds provide some representational evidence, while the main contribution advances sparse event-driven computation.

    本文提出一种脉冲循环架构，将三值时间滤波与共振-发放神经元相结合，并报告了语音识别性能及建模效率。其学习得到的层级结构和潜在流形提供了一些表征方面的证据，而主要贡献在于推进稀疏的事件驱动计算。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient inference through sparse, event-driven computation, yet remain constrained on continuous, context-dependent tasks such as automatic speech recognition (ASR). A key bottleneck is the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron, whose membrane decay erases information across pauses and phonetic boundaries while it must both extract features and retain long-range context. Inspired by cortical separation of nonlinear filtering and somatic integration, we introduce the Spiking Ternary GRU (stGRU): a ternary-weight gated recurrent unit performs temporal filtering, while downstream Resonate-and-Fire (RF) neurons generate the binary spike stream driving the next block's event pathway. This makes binary event transmission a native training constraint rather than a separate deployment-time activation quantization step; together with ternary weights, learned projections avoid dense floating-point matrix MACs. Trained end-to-end on LibriSpeech-960, Small, Medium, and Large stGRUs reach 8.09%, 7.04%, and $6.44 \pm 0.17\%$ WER on test-clean without an external language model. To our knowledge, these are the first matrix-MAC-free spiking networks without a learned ANN sequence decoder to achieve single-digit WER on LibriSpeech. The architecture also achieves 10.88% test CER on Aishell-1 (9.28% on dev) when trained from scratch. Internally, trained networks develop a depth-graded hierarchy: shallow layers act as fast acoustic filters, while deep layers form slower semantic integrators whose latent representations segregate into part-of-speech manifolds and word-level spike events. Deep-layer firing rates follow lognormal distributions with a sparsity gradient, mirroring hierarchical processing observed in human cortex in vivo. Our biologically grounded architecture combines competitive ASR with favorable modeled compute and memory cost.

    中文

    脉冲神经网络（SNN）有望通过稀疏、事件驱动的计算实现高能效推理，但在自动语音识别（ASR）等连续且依赖上下文的任务上仍受到限制。一个关键瓶颈是漏积分-发放（LIF）神经元：其膜电位衰减会在停顿和语音边界处抹去信息，而它还必须同时提取特征并保留长程上下文。受皮层将非线性滤波与胞体整合分离这一机制的启发，我们提出脉冲三值 GRU（stGRU）：三值权重门控循环单元执行时间滤波，下游的共振-发放（RF）神经元则生成二进制脉冲流，以驱动下一模块的事件通路。这使二进制事件传输成为原生的训练约束，而不是独立的部署时激活量化步骤；结合三值权重，学习得到的投影避免了密集浮点矩阵乘加运算。在 LibriSpeech-960 上进行端到端训练后，Small、Medium 和 Large stGRU 在 test-clean 上的词错误率（WER）分别达到 8.09%、7.04% 和 $6.44 \pm 0.17\%$ WER，且未使用外部语言模型。据我们所知，这是首批在 LibriSpeech 上实现个位数 WER、无需学习型 ANN 序列解码器且不执行矩阵乘加的脉冲网络。该架构从头训练后，在 Aishell-1 上的 test CER 也达到 10.88%（dev 上为 9.28%）。在内部，训练后的网络形成了按深度分级的层次结构：浅层充当快速声学滤波器，而深层则构成较慢的语义整合器，其潜在表示分化为词性流形和词级脉冲事件。深层的放电率呈对数正态分布，并具有稀疏度梯度，这与体内人类皮层中观察到的层级处理相呼应。我们的生物学启发架构兼具竞争力的 ASR 性能以及有利的建模计算和内存成本。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion transformers are widely used in image-editing services. To preserve both efficiency and privacy, existing systems commonly rely on cloud-device collaboration. Keeping request-specific inference on the device avoids sending personal images and prompts to the cloud. These workloads often use common templates, such as in face swapping and virtual try-on, enabling KV state to be precomputed and reused across requests. However, this reusable state is large and scales with the number of templates, making it impractical to store all of them on mobile devices. Storing them in the cloud addresses this capacity issue, but cache transfer is placed onto the inference path and can even be slower than on-device computation, especially under fluctuating mobile networks. We introduce SAKURA, a cloud-edge architecture that delivers reusable attention state to mobile devices under a bandwidth budget. It first uses a fine-grained token-importance-aware compression method to preserve image quality under limited transfer budgets. At runtime, SAKURA adaptively selects the cache representation for each upcoming shard based on network bandwidth. To enable efficient execution, we develop a pipelined runtime that overlaps cache transfer and reconstruction with on-device execution. We evaluate SAKURA using three editing tasks and two diffusion models, using a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 phone. SAKURA reduces latency by 1.82x and 3.27x over CacheGen adapted to DiT and on-device generation, respectively. It also reduces cache storage by 3.06x over uncompressed cache, while preserving image quality.

    中文

    扩散 Transformer 广泛应用于图像编辑服务。为兼顾效率与隐私，现有系统通常依赖云端与设备协同。将特定请求的推理保留在设备上，可以避免将个人图像和提示词发送到云端。这类工作负载通常使用常见模板，例如换脸和虚拟试穿，因此可以预先计算 KV 状态并在多个请求间复用。然而，这些可复用状态规模庞大，且会随模板数量增长，因此在移动设备上存储所有状态并不现实。将它们存储在云端可以解决容量问题，但缓存传输会被纳入推理路径，尤其在移动网络波动时，甚至可能比设备端计算更慢。我们提出 SAKURA，这是一种云边架构，可在带宽预算下向移动设备提供可复用的注意力状态。它首先采用细粒度、感知 token 重要性的压缩方法，以便在传输预算有限时保持图像质量。运行时，SAKURA 根据网络带宽，自适应地为每个即将处理的分片选择缓存表示。为实现高效执行，我们开发了一种流水线运行时，使缓存传输和重建与设备端执行重叠。我们使用一部搭载 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 的手机，通过三种编辑任务和两种扩散模型对 SAKURA 进行评估。与适配于 DiT 的 CacheGen 和设备端生成相比，SAKURA 分别将延迟降低至原来的 1.82 倍和 3.27 倍。与未压缩缓存相比，它还将缓存存储量减少了 3.06 倍，同时保持了图像质量。

    Hyunwoo Yu, Jongbeom Lee, Hyunbin Kim, Sungjun Park, Jaemin Choi, Jincheol Yang, Seunghun Moon, Bongjoon Hyun, Kyomin Sohn, Kyeongbo Kong, Suk-Ju Kang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

Its clustering and proxy use are incidental to composition or internal-mechanism analysis, which the abstract does not investigate.

    该论文提出查询几何聚类、基于误差的选择和尾部代理，使稀疏注意力兼具更高准确率与更快速度，对高效模型计算作出了实质性贡献。其聚类和代理的使用只是附带涉及组合或内部机制分析；摘要并未对这些方面展开研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse attention reads only a small subset of the key-value cache, and how to treat the unread tail remains a key challenge. Discarding the tail biases the output, and sampling it as previous approaches do fails at reads of 5% and below, where the tail likely holds heavy hitters the selector missed. Our key observation is that the simplest possible proxy, one token that folds the entire tail into its count-aware mean, already yields lower output error than a sample at every read behind a practical selector. We further show in closed form that at low reads sampling nearly doubles the weight error of discarding while a single proxy stays below it. Building on these findings, we explore approximating the dense attention distribution with a few proxies that target the tail. We propose OpenAttention, a pipeline of clustering, ErrorGate and top-k selection followed by a count-aware mean proxy. To implement clustering and selection both efficiently and effectively, we design training-free Query-Geometry Clustering (QGC) and a Query-Geometry Selector (QGS), which compress the keys while respecting the query directions. Additionally, unlike prior methods that rank clusters by centroid alone, ErrorGate allocates the exact read by the estimated weight error of each cluster. On RULER-32K HARD with Llama-3.1-8B, OpenAttention retains 99% of dense accuracy at a 1% read. It also achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across models, context lengths and datasets. Our customized attention kernel for OpenAttention runs the decode attention stage 10$\times$ faster than dense attention at a 1% read.

    中文

    稀疏注意力只读取键值缓存中的一小部分，而如何处理未读取的尾部仍是一项关键挑战。丢弃尾部会使输出产生偏差；正如以往方法所做的那样对尾部进行采样，在读取率为 5% 及以下时也会失效，因为尾部很可能包含选择器遗漏的高权重项。我们的关键观察是，最简单的代理——用一个 token 将整个尾部折叠为带计数权重的均值——在实用选择器之后的所有读取率下，产生的输出误差都低于采样。我们进一步通过闭式分析表明，在低读取率下，采样造成的权重误差几乎是丢弃尾部时的两倍，而单个代理的误差则低于丢弃尾部。基于这些发现，我们探索用少量针对尾部的代理来近似稠密注意力分布。我们提出 OpenAttention，这是一条由聚类、ErrorGate、top-k 选择和带计数权重的均值代理组成的处理流程。为高效且有效地实现聚类和选择，我们设计了无需训练的查询几何聚类（QGC）和查询几何选择器（QGS），它们在遵循查询方向的同时压缩键。此外，不同于以往仅按质心对簇排序的方法，ErrorGate 根据每个簇估计的权重误差来分配精确读取量。在使用 Llama-3.1-8B 的 RULER-32K HARD 上，OpenAttention 在 1% 的读取率下保留了稠密注意力准确率的 99%。它在不同模型、上下文长度和数据集上也达到了最先进的准确率。我们为 OpenAttention 定制的注意力内核在 1% 的读取率下，使解码注意力阶段比稠密注意力快 10$\times$倍。

    Robot foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating low-cost offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To test this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to robotics and make sensorimotor alignment measurable, offering a low-cost, representation-level view of robot foundation models that closed-loop success rates alone cannot reveal.

    中文

    机器人基础模型通常通过成本高昂的闭环运行来评估，因此需要低成本的离线代理指标来衡量模型能力。柏拉图表征假说（PRH）认为，随着表征能力提升，视觉和语言等模态会趋同于一个共享的现实统计模型。我们探讨运动轨迹是否也构成这样一种模态：随着具身模型能力增强，其感知表征是否应趋同于物理运动的结构？为检验这一点，我们提出感知运动对齐（$S^2$），这是一种无需训练的离线指标，用于衡量模型的感知表征与物理运动几何结构的对齐程度。我们发现，$S^2$与不同模型系列在下游机器人任务上的成功率呈正相关，因此可作为一种低成本离线代理指标，在闭环评估前对模型进行优先级排序。$S^2$还可以在耗费大量成本进行微调、将视觉语言模型（VLM）骨干转化为视觉语言动作模型（VLA）之前，识别出有前景的骨干模型。除了这种相关性，$S^2$还能从表征层面解释 VLA 和世界动作模型（WAM）中观察到的现象。借助$S^2$，我们将 PRH 扩展到机器人领域，并使感知运动对齐变得可测量，从而为机器人基础模型提供一种仅凭闭环成功率无法揭示的低成本、表征层面视角。

    Rethinking Structured Generation: Can Graph-Based Reasoning Resolve Ambiguity?

    重新思考结构化生成：基于图的推理能否消解歧义？

    Ratun Rahman and Atit Pokharel

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper reformulates structured generation to preserve multiple valid interpretations and selects among graph-structured candidates using semantic and relational consistency, with improved robustness under ambiguity. This substantially advances compositional structure and inference, though the abstract does not establish a broader account of reasoning mechanisms.

    该论文重新表述了结构化生成问题，以保留多个有效解释，并使用语义与关系一致性在图结构候选项中进行选择，从而提升歧义情境下的鲁棒性。这对组合结构和推断作出了实质性推进，但摘要未能确立对推理机制的更广泛解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Structured generation is typically formulated as a deterministic mapping from input to a single structured output. This assumption is fundamentally misaligned with natural language, which often admits multiple structurally distinct yet semantically valid interpretations. As a result, existing methods rely on single-reference supervision that collapses ambiguity into one prediction, leading to unstable and inconsistent outputs under underspecified inputs. We reformulate structured generation as an \textit{ambiguity-aware inference problem}, where the objective is to reason over a set of plausible structured outputs rather than predict a single solution. We show that standard training inherently suppresses valid alternatives, and instead adopt a multi-valid learning framework that preserves ambiguity during optimization. To operationalize this formulation, we construct a candidate space of structured outputs, represent each candidate as a graph capturing entities and their relationships, and perform selection via graph-based reasoning over semantic alignment and relational consistency. This enables principled comparison across competing interpretations beyond token-level likelihoods. Experiments on structured generation benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in accuracy, stability, and robustness under varying levels of ambiguity. These results highlight the importance of modeling ambiguity explicitly and suggest a shift from single-output prediction to set-level reasoning in structured generation.

    中文

    结构化生成通常被表述为从输入到单一结构化输出的确定性映射。这一假设与自然语言的本质并不相符，因为自然语言往往允许多个结构不同但语义有效的解释。因此，现有方法依赖单一参考答案监督，将歧义压缩为一个预测，导致在输入信息不足时输出不稳定且不一致。我们将结构化生成重新表述为一个 \textit{感知歧义的推断问题}，其目标是在一组合理的结构化输出上进行推理，而非预测单一解。我们表明，标准训练会从根本上抑制有效的替代解释，因此采用一种多有效答案学习框架，在优化过程中保留歧义。为落实这一表述，我们构建结构化输出候选空间，将每个候选表示为一张刻画实体及其关系的图，并通过基于图的推理，根据语义对齐和关系一致性进行选择。这使我们能够超越 token 级似然，对相互竞争的解释进行有原则的比较。在结构化生成基准上的实验表明，在不同歧义程度下，准确率、稳定性和鲁棒性均持续提升。这些结果凸显了显式建模歧义的重要性，并表明结构化生成应从单输出预测转向集合层面的推理。

    ENGLISH

    Activation interventions can make a language model produce a target answer, but can the model use the intended condition in other computations? We study this question in Qwen3.5-27B on tool-use tasks where time or permissions determine eligibility and selection. Across 32 fresh worlds, two case-specific residual-writing variants raise familiar target-selection correctness from 35/128 to 119/128 and from 33/128 to 114/128. Yet these gains disappear when familiar facts and identifiers are recombined within the same selection task, while selection of previously rewarded identifiers increases. The gains persist across output formats but yield little improvement in independent judgments about whether a candidate is eligible or should be selected. Internal edits can nevertheless change how a source fact affects a judgment: in a prespecified secondary comparison, an early-layer source patch changes 50/64 judgments when that source is used, with one adverse change among 64 cases where it is not. This selective effect does not ensure correct complete actions. Together, these results separate target-selection control, condition-sensitive judgments, and complete-action correctness. Evaluating how an edited state is used, rather than only its trained answer, exposes these differences.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper mines and validates reusable design principles for multi-agent workflow orchestration, a substantial contribution to agent-system design.     本文挖掘并验证了适用于多智能体工作流编排的可复用设计原则，是对智能体系统设计的重要贡献。其可组合算子是工作流组件，但摘要并未研究组合泛化或模型内部机制；任务表现是工作流发现的证据，并非推理方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Designing large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems (MAS) still relies on trial and error and informal "folk wisdom." Manual studies test only a few communication structures or topologies (e.g., sequential, parallel, shared-memory, or debate), while automated optimizers discard search trajectories after selecting a task-specific workflow. We present a two-phase pipeline for mining reproducible design principles from workflow code and execution traces. We repurpose AFlow's MCTS optimizer across six composable operators and 26 deterministically verified Enigmata tasks, retaining all intermediate rounds to build a corpus of 28,568 executable workflows. A sandboxed AutoResearch loop then mines orchestration code and prompt templates under an $L_0$-penalized validation objective and tests candidate principles on held-out searches. Across 300 feature-mining trials, we identify effects that persist on held-out searches across three levels of workflow design: workflows beginning with independent solvers and one-shot aggregation (Star-first) perform worse ($\Delta = -0.045$); persistent shared documents (SharedMemory) outperform debate ($\Delta = +0.135$); and prompt specificity and placeholder-based context routing yield gains comparable to communication-structure selection ($\Delta = +0.118$). More broadly, our pipeline and results show the feasibility of turning discarded search trajectories into a statistical testbed for discovering and validating multi-agent workflow design principles.

    大型语言模型（LLM）多智能体系统（MAS）的设计仍依赖反复试错和非正式的“经验之谈”。人工研究只测试少数几种通信结构或拓扑（例如顺序式、并行式、共享内存式或辩论式），而自动优化器在选定特定任务的工作流后会丢弃搜索轨迹。我们提出了一个两阶段流程，从工作流代码和执行轨迹中挖掘可复现的设计原则。我们将 AFlow 的 MCTS 优化器应用于六种可组合算子和 26 项经过确定性验证的 Enigmata 任务，并保留所有中间轮次，构建了一个包含 28,568 个可执行工作流的语料库。随后，一个沙盒化的 AutoResearch 循环在带有 $L_0$惩罚项的验证目标下挖掘编排代码和提示模板，并在留出搜索中测试候选原则。在 300 次特征挖掘试验中，我们发现了在留出搜索中持续存在、横跨工作流设计三个层面的效应：以独立求解器和一次性汇总（Star-first）开头的工作流表现较差（$\Delta = -0.045$）；持久共享文档（SharedMemory）的表现优于辩论（$\Delta = +0.135$）；提示的具体程度和基于占位符的上下文路由所带来的收益，与通信结构选择相当（$\Delta = +0.118$）。总体而言，我们的流程和结果表明，将被丢弃的搜索轨迹转化为统计测试平台，以发现并验证多智能体工作流设计原则是可行的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Context compaction lets long-horizon coding agents continue beyond their context windows, but can erase the state needed to finish a task. Prior evaluations measure efficiency, retained information, or end-to-end success, leaving the effect of a specific history replacement difficult to isolate. Compact-Bench pairs full-history and summary-only continuations from a shared repository state, and evaluates recurring details and successive production compactions. It covers 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 agentic sessions, and 106 production chains. Across 14 summarizer backbones, stable damage ranges from 5-64% of 22 full-history successes: Claude Opus 4.8 preserves the most repairs, while DeepSeek-Flash damages the most. With Kimi-K3 as summarizer, the Kimi Code prompt preserves the most task continuations (19/22), whereas Claude Code retains the most recurring details (15.0%). LLM summaries retain at most 16.0% of recurring details, compared with 79.1% for mechanical extraction; production summaries retain 15.7% at the first boundary. Failures recur across methods: one repair is damaged by 13/14 backbones, and another by all 5 prompts. These results show that reliable compaction requires preserving the progress needed to complete a task, and that retaining relevant information alone does not ensure successful continuation. Code is available at https://github.com/cai-jianfeng/compact-bench and data is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/caijanfeng/compact-bench.
