    ENGLISH

    Mobile GUI agents frequently perform repetitive tasks with similar interaction procedures. Reusing previous executions can reduce redundant LLM inference and execution overhead, but variations in user instructions and execution environments may invalidate previously successful actions. We systematically characterize these variations into six representative categories and observe that such changes do not necessarily invalidate entire procedures: individual transitions can remain reusable when validated against the current task context and interface state. Based on this insight, we propose graph-text templates for selective execution-trace reuse. The graph captures UI states and action transitions, while the text encodes task intent, procedural structure, and typed slots for variable content. A record-template-replay framework constructs templates from verified executions and leverages the current instruction and live UI state to reuse, adapt, or discard individual transitions. Given an execution trace, our framework reduces LLM inference token consumption by approximately 80% on average across five base agents on AndroidWorld, with most agents achieving at least 1.5-fold execution speedup over LLM-only execution. In real-device evaluations on Android and HarmonyOS, our framework achieves action reuse ratios of 70.7-79.8% while maintaining over 2-fold execution speedup in most evaluated configurations.

    Learning to Be Monitored: Causal Bounds and Intervention-Aware Post-Training Recipes for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability

    学会接受监测：面向思维链可监测性的因果界限与干预感知后训练方案

    Qiang Fu, Xinyue Li, Andre Wibisono, Arman Cohan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives causal bounds for evaluating whether monitors detect intervention-caused behavior in chain-of-thought, then shows that post-training methods can improve monitorability. This is a substantial contribution to evaluating and training explicit reasoning traces, while monitoring does not itself reveal internal mechanisms and the training methods are not primarily advances in agent systems.

    该论文推导了因果界限，用于评估监测器能否检测到由干预导致的思维链行为，随后表明后训练方法能够提高可监测性。这对评估和训练显式推理轨迹作出了重要贡献；不过，监测本身并不揭示内部机制，而且这些训练方法的重点并非推进智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring aims to detect potentially harmful behaviors in large language models (LLMs) from their CoTs. Intervention-based evaluations measure this property by asking whether a monitor can detect the role of an intervention from the CoT when the targeted behavior occurs, typically using minimal-criterion sensitivity ($\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$) proposed by~\citep{guan2025monitoring}. However, a target behavior observed under intervention is not necessarily caused by it, and we show that this metric can overestimate how often a monitor detects target behaviors actually caused by the intervention. Specifically, we establish $\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$ as an upper bound on this causal detection rate and derive a complementary lower bound, which provides a tighter evaluation framework for CoT monitorability. With this framework, we study whether LLMs can be trained to make their CoTs easier to monitor. We first construct a training dataset of paired control--intervention tasks spanning multiple intervention types. Using the dataset, we design and apply three intervention-specific training methods based on off-policy self-distillation, reinforcement learning, and on-policy self-distillation to train separate variants of each base model. Across various model-monitor configurations, all three methods generally improve CoT monitorability over the corresponding base models under our extended evaluation framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/xinyue-lxy/learning-to-be-monitored.

    思维链（CoT）监测旨在根据大型语言模型（LLM）的 CoT 检测潜在有害行为。基于干预的评估通过询问监测器能否在目标行为出现时从 CoT 中检测到干预的作用来衡量这一属性，通常使用 minimal-criterion sensitivity（$\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$），该指标由~\citep{guan2025monitoring} 提出。然而，在干预下观察到的目标行为不一定是由干预导致的；我们表明，该指标可能高估监测器检测到实际由干预导致的目标行为的频率。具体而言，我们证明 $\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$ 是这一因果检测率的上界，并推导出一个互补的下界，从而为 CoT 可监测性提供更严格的评估框架。借助这一框架，我们研究能否训练 LLM，使其 CoT 更易于监测。我们首先构建一个涵盖多种干预类型的成对控制—干预任务训练数据集。利用该数据集，我们设计并应用三种针对干预的训练方法，分别基于离策略自蒸馏、强化学习和同策略自蒸馏，为每个基础模型训练独立变体。在各种模型—监测器配置下，根据扩展后的评估框架，这三种方法通常都能提升 CoT 可监测性，相较于对应的基础模型有所改善。代码见 https://github.com/xinyue-lxy/learning-to-be-monitored。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and evaluates cost-sensitive, per-query modality selection to improve the accuracy-cost trade-off for omni-modal inference.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) can jointly process a broad range of modalities, such as text, audio, and video, enabling stronger multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, but often at substantial inference cost. We observe that the benefit of additional modalities varies across queries, indicating that a fixed modality configuration can be inefficient. Motivated by this, we study query-wise modality selection, which keeps the underlying Omni-LLM fixed while adaptively selecting which modalities to provide for each query. We formulate the problem as an accuracy-cost optimization problem and develop a cost-sensitive learning approach for modality selection. We evaluate our approach on WorldSense using Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni under three inference-cost measures: input tokens, latency, and monetary cost. Across both models, query-wise modality selection consistently improves the accuracy-cost trade-off and can even outperform the standard setting in which all available modalities are provided to the Omni-LLM. For Qwen2.5-Omni, our cost-sensitive approach matches or exceeds this full-modality accuracy while requiring only approximately 41% of the input tokens, 39% of the latency, and 61% of the monetary cost.

    Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly

    基准测试对上下文压缩的友好程度出乎意料

    Jeanne Salle, Hardik Bhatnagar, Matthias Bethge, Sahar Abdelnabi, Maksym Andriushchenko

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper systematically evaluates context compaction in long-horizon agents, finding that lost constraints can harm task execution and that benchmark structure often makes compaction losses recoverable. This advances understanding of agent memory and context management; its reasoning connection is through preserving prior decisions and constraints, not a study of reasoning mechanisms.

    该论文系统地评估了长时程智能体中的上下文压缩，发现丢失约束可能损害任务执行，而基准测试的结构往往使压缩损失能够恢复。这推进了对智能体记忆和上下文管理的理解；它与推理的关联在于保留先前决策和约束，而非研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window. To continue the task, the agent scaffold has to free up the context window, a process known as context compaction. Compaction is generally lossy by design: agents can silently lose task constraints, instructions, or their reasoning behind earlier decisions. Although compaction is a standard component of coding agent scaffolds, it has not been studied systematically with frontier models on realistic, long horizon agentic tasks. Previous work evaluate smaller open weight models on toy or synthetic trajectories. We fix the agent scaffold (OpenCode), implement five compaction strategies inside it, and evaluate three frontier models on three long horizon benchmarks (PaperBench, ProgramBench, PostTrainBench). For the two 1M context models, the compaction threshold does not measurably affect the task performance, whereas GPT-5.3-Codex, the model with the smallest context window, performs worse at lower thresholds on PaperBench and, less clearly, on PostTrainBench. No compaction method outperforms default self-summarization, and methods that discard more content cost some models up to 20 points while leaving other models the same. Compaction can, however, silently remove task constraints: on ProgramBench, the first compaction summary already drops about one third of the task's anticheating rules on average, and this rises monotonically with the number of compactions. On real user-agent sessions from SWE-chat, instructions about how the agent should work and what it should not do are dropped around 6 times more than specifications of what to build. We argue that current benchmarks are compaction-friendly: i.e., the objective is fixed and the agent's progress stays on disk, so most of what compaction discards can be recovered, except constraints that don't exist anywhere else.

    长时程智能体任务如今正使 LLM 智能体超出其上下文窗口。要继续执行任务，智能体脚手架必须释放上下文窗口空间，这一过程称为上下文压缩。压缩通常从设计上就是有损的：智能体可能在不知不觉中丢失任务约束、指令或先前决策背后的推理。尽管压缩是编程智能体脚手架的标准组成部分，但此前尚未在真实的长时程智能体任务中，使用前沿模型对其进行系统研究。以往工作评估的是较小的开放权重模型，使用的则是玩具式或合成轨迹。我们固定智能体脚手架（OpenCode），在其中实现五种压缩策略，并在三个长时程基准测试（PaperBench、ProgramBench、PostTrainBench）上评估三个前沿模型。对于两种上下文长度为 1M 的模型，压缩阈值不会对任务表现产生可测量的影响；而上下文窗口最小的模型 GPT-5.3-Codex 在 PaperBench 上于较低阈值下表现更差，在 PostTrainBench 上也有较不明显的类似趋势。没有任何压缩方法优于默认的自我摘要；丢弃更多内容的方法会使某些模型损失最多 20 分，而其他模型的表现则不变。不过，压缩可能会悄然移除任务约束：在 ProgramBench 上，第一次压缩生成的摘要平均就会丢弃约三分之一的任务反作弊规则，而且随着压缩次数增加，这一比例单调上升。在 SWE-chat 的真实用户—智能体会话中，关于智能体应如何工作以及不应做什么的指令，被丢弃的频率约为构建内容规格的 6 倍。我们认为，当前基准测试对压缩较为友好：也就是说，目标固定且智能体的进度保存在磁盘上，因此压缩丢弃的大部分内容都可以恢复，只有那些在其他地方没有记录的约束例外。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper theoretically analyzes early training dynamics and hidden representations in large residual networks, finding that high input dimension suppresses nonlinear feature learning and leaves early outputs effectively linear.     该论文从理论上分析大型残差网络的早期训练动态和隐藏表示，发现高输入维度会抑制非线性特征学习，使早期输出实际上保持线性。这对表示学习机制作出了重要贡献，但没有研究组合性、推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We study the early training dynamics of nonlinear residual networks with blocks of zero hidden layers as a model of more general residual networks. We analyze networks in a sequential limit where first width and depth diverge, then the number of training data points diverges, and finally the input dimension diverges. This is a more refined setup compared to the typical mean-field theory analysis in which depth and width diverge but the number of training datapoints and input dimension are fixed. Our main technical result is a diagrammatic computation of both the network output and the hidden representations after the few steps of gradient descent in terms of the statistics of inner products of inputs from the training set. One of our principle conceptual findings is a negative result: in the limit of large input dimension the network output can learn only a linear function of its inputs early in training since higher learned monomials are more and more suppressed in the input dimension and vanish in the large dimension limit. This suggests that mean-field limits of ResNets are surprisingly rigid in the regime of high input dimension and may not be sufficient toy models for understanding feature learning. Finally, we investigate how to ensure hyperparameter transfer for the learning rate as a function of dataset size and input dimension. We test our predictions numerically and find excellent agreement with our theory.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Phronix develops an agent harness that validates and refines reusable capabilities from execution outcomes, improving task reliability and reducing repeated effort and token use. Reuse of capabilities offers partial compositional insight, while the central contribution is agent memory and execution organization; the abstract does not establish a reasoning mechanism.

    Phronix 构建了一种智能体脚手架，能够根据执行结果验证并改进可复用能力，从而提高任务可靠性并减少重复工作和 token 消耗。能力复用与组合性有一定关联，但其核心贡献在于智能体记忆和执行组织；摘要并未确立一种推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executions. We introduce Phronix, a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions. Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities. It distills every observed interaction into a capability store and researches a failing task rather than abandoning it. First, such learned capabilities solve a recurring task on the first attempt in 93-95% of cases across every model, significantly reducing solution non-determinism and improving reliability. Second, Phronix turns an agent's own execution into 7.6-30.8 durable capabilities per task without user instruction, and creation falls below two once the needed capability exists. Third, warm-start runs consume only 0.38-0.40 million tokens per task, which is three to four times less than a single baseline attempt, while a cold-start costs no more than the baseline. On the 1000 Genome Pegasus workflow, instrumenting a production application for I/O performance analysis, Phronix passes all 11 correctness checks against six for the baseline harness, and also lifts the task solving rates of two cheaper models from 29% and 27% of SWE-bench tasks solved to 91% and 87%, respectively, matching the performance of the most expensive evaluated model.

    A bug report describes what went wrong, but rarely where the code should change. Existing repository-level localization methods often let language models iteratively decide what code to inspect next, requiring repeated model calls and substantial token usage. We investigate whether these inspection decisions can instead be planned before source retrieval. In this research, we introduce CuraLoc, which first selects candidate files and represents their symbols using compact behavioral and structural descriptions. In a single planning decision, the model jointly selects starting symbols, chooses code relationships to inspect from each, and forms hypotheses about likely edits. Deterministic retrieval collects the requested source for a final ranking informed by those hypotheses, concentrating model reasoning on choosing and comparing code rather than directing each retrieval step. We demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed approach on the SWE-Bench Lite and Verified datasets. On SWE Bench Verified with GPT-5.2, CuraLoc raises Func@1 from LocAgent's 53.8% to 59.3% while using 90.3% fewer recorded tokens, and also outperforms RepoSearcher (56.2%) and Agentless (39.6%) on Func@1. On SWE-bench Lite, CuraLoc achieves a high 83.8% Func@5 accuracy improving on Agentless by more than 15% in relative accuracy. Additionally, CuraLoc supports different model backbones, with strong localization accuracy demonstrated using both GPT-5.2 and GPT-6 Astra. These results provide evidence that repository-level code inspection can be planned effectively without iterative model-controlled navigation.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether language models’ probability judgments remain coherent when reasoning over latent explanations, and finds that a ground-truth-free consistency residual flags unreliable answers. This is a substantial empirical contribution to reasoning evaluation, but it does not investigate internal mechanisms or model systems.

    该论文检验语言模型在对潜在解释进行推理时，其概率判断是否保持一致，并发现一种无需真实值的残差指标能够标记不可靠答案。这对推理评估作出了重要的实证贡献，但没有研究内部机制或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LawZero's Scientist AI trains a Predictor toward the Bayesian posterior, with an objective that penalizes inconsistent probabilities among latent explanations. We ask whether current frontier language models, with no such training, are already consistent in this sense zero-shot: do their probability judgments satisfy the law of total probability, $P(X)=\sum_z P(z)P(X|z)$, when the latent $z$ must be inferred from records in the context? In separate single-turn calls, models are asked for $P(X)$, for $P(z)$ over the latent's states, and for $P(X|z)$; a causal family applies the same test to $P(y|do(x))$ and the back-door adjustment. Every query has an exact ground-truth probability, and a subset of items is asked in three wordings to separate persistent incoherence from rewording noise. Across seven models, GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5 are the most coherent (mean absolute residual 0.08 and 0.12 log-odds, about 2 percentage points). Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash and DeepSeek V4-Pro show persistent incoherence (0.27-0.35 log-odds) that is mostly item-specific rather than a shared offset. Within every model, larger residuals go with larger errors against the truth (Spearman 0.40-0.62), so the residual, which needs no ground truth, flags unreliable answers. Reasoning length does not predict coherence, across models or within a model across rewordings of the same question.     ENGLISH

    Tool-calling agents are mostly optimized for accuracy; in deployment, however, their growing cost is latency: every tool call is decoded autoregressively. Speculative decoding accelerates this without changing the output, and retrieved past calls make strong drafts under real use, where each user's behavior tends to repeat. Yet existing systems keep no cross-session memory, or build the draft store once and never update it. We propose SpecMem, a tool-call memory kept alive and managed throughout deployment: verified calls are written back online into bounded per-user stores with LRU eviction, and a side-effect gate defers irreversible calls until verification confirms. On multi-session, multi-user query streams served by three open-weight models, a frozen store steadily loses acceptance while SpecMem holds it: a 27% gap in mean accepted tokens (+11% to +34% across benchmarks, tracking how much novel work arrives after the store is built) and up to 1.74x wall-clock speedup.     Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates. When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter. By keeping the original weights frozen, Self-Direction prevents adapter training from overwriting base-model parameters while training additional parameters equivalent to ~0.02% of the base model's parameter count for each adapter. We find that Self-Direction reduces repeated mistakes across future encounters of a task, nearly doubling the reliability of an agent's corrections. Learned lessons also transfer: a handful of adapters generalize to dozens of new tasks without additional training. Ultimately, this self-directed repair transforms everyday mistakes into lasting lessons.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Covariate-aware time series foundation models (TSFMs) accept a future path for a control variable and return a forecast, inviting what-if queries. The query is interventional; the models are trained on observational data. We determine whether their answers are the conditional slope $\partial E[Y|X]$ or the interventional effect $\partial E[Y|do(X)]$, at three levels. Theory: a Bayes-optimal observational predictor answers interventional queries associationally unless the adjustment set is available and used; for in-context least squares we derive the resulting confounding gap -- a model's effect estimate under an observational minus under a randomized context -- in closed form, a parameter-free reference line. Behaviour: on a preregistered grid with exact counterfactual ground truth, Chronos-2, TiRex-2, TabPFN-TS and TimesFM-2.5 all track this line ($R^2$ 0.90-1.00) and respond more confounded than regression itself (slopes 1.3-1.8), on linear and nonlinear structural models. Pairs of models with identical observational laws prove this is not an identifiability limit: when the effect is identifiable, least squares recovers 100% of the true effect difference, Chronos-2 75%, TiRex-2 34%. Representation: linear probes decode the data-generating regime (94-96%) and the true effect ($R^2$ 0.7-0.9) from embeddings that the forecasts ignore. On two physical systems with randomized actuators, pretrained models under-respond by 2-5x and ignore in-window confounding. Minutes of interventional post-training on 3,000 synthetic series cut the gap by up to 83% and transfer outside the training prior. Its forecasting cost is a replay-distribution effect: replaying the model's own pretraining prior cuts it from +47% to +10% MASE, and with low-rank adaptation yields a recipe meeting the preregistered criterion over three seeds (52-61% gap reduction at +1-3% cost) while improving the DoTime benchmark.

    ENGLISH

    While animals and people tend to learn a task more quickly and reliably when they first train on simpler versions of it, curriculum learning's effectiveness in artificial settings varies, and appears substantially greater in reinforcement learning than in supervised learning. In this work, we construct and analyze a minimal model of policy learning to better understand why. We consider an open-loop, episodic target interception task whose parameters---especially how close the agent must be to the target to receive an informative reward signal---can be chosen so that the agent either receives informative rewards frequently ('dense' rewards) or rarely ('sparse' rewards). We mathematically and numerically analyze the dynamics of REINFORCE-based policy learning in both cases. In the dense reward case, curricula have only marginal benefits; in the sparse case, curricula can be required for learning to occur at all. We find that this is especially true when the agent has the conflicting goals of minimizing effort and accumulating high reward, since this can produce distinct reward landscape optima which compete with one another. Our characterization of useful curricula in this setting indicates that they address two issues: they (i) make rewards less sparse to speed up learning, and (ii) shape the reward landscape to steer agents away from bad local optima.

Scoring actions relative to that step separates appropriate effort from over-persistence and premature handoff. Across eight frontier models and 19,371 trajectories, we find that nearly every run that needs outside help collects sufficient evidence, yet a third still exhaust their budget, and every unsafe request we detect comes after that point. Fortunately, an escalation tool, or an external monitor for models that ignore the tool, already guards against much of this behavior: the tool cuts budget exhaustion from 34.0% to 6.7%, and the monitor nearly triples task success after environment restoration. Even then, a fired escalation is not yet a useful handoff: tickets reliably name the blocker but often omit the agent's own progress and verification status. Taken together, we argue that knowing when to stop therefore needs explicit support, both in the tool that lets an agent hand off and in the report it leaves behind.

    中文

    编码智能体接受的训练目标是完成任务，即使环境使任务无法完成，它们仍会继续尝试。通常只需几步就会出现证据，表明只有外部帮助才能恢复进展，但智能体很少据此采取行动：它们会过度坚持、尝试不受欢迎的变通办法，并声称取得了记录无法支持的成功——我们将这一现象称为证据—行动落差。为测量这一现象，我们提出 ImpasseBench：在原本可解决的修复任务中注入十二种真实的环境阻碍，并标记每条轨迹中收集到的证据达到充分程度的步骤。根据相对于该步骤的行动进行评分，可以区分恰当的努力、过度坚持和过早移交。在八个前沿模型的 19,371 条轨迹上，我们发现，几乎所有需要外部帮助的运行过程都会收集到充分证据，但仍有三分之一耗尽预算；我们检测到的每个不安全请求都出现在证据充分之后。值得庆幸的是，升级工具已经能防范其中许多行为；对于忽略该工具的模型，外部监控器也能起到类似作用：该工具将预算耗尽率从 34.0% 降至 6.7%，而监控器使环境恢复后的任务成功率接近翻三倍。即便如此，触发升级还不等于完成有效移交：工单会可靠地说明阻碍因素，却常常遗漏智能体自身的进展和验证状态。综上，我们认为，智能体要知道何时停止，需要获得明确支持，既包括让智能体移交任务的工具，也包括它留下的报告。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is a training and inference framework that learns hardware-compatible structured sparsity to reduce memory and latency across deployment budgets. This is a strong systems contribution; model compression alone provides no substantive insight into internal representations, composition, or reasoning.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scaling laws continue to reward increases in model scale, while the resulting computational and memory demands drive greater reliance on cloud infrastructure for inference. Yet unreliable network connectivity, communication delays, and privacy requirements can make such reliance impractical, motivating local execution on edge devices. Local deployment requires models to fit within limited memory and execute efficiently with the available computational resources. Recent work has shown that learning sparse-plus-low-rank representations enables elastic compression of a single checkpoint to multiple memory budgets. However, fewer parameters do not necessarily translate into faster inference. Indexing overhead and irregular memory access in unstructured sparse components can offset computational savings. To address this critical deployment barrier, we introduce S-SALAAD, a unified framework that jointly learns the model weights and their low-rank and structured sparse components during training. The framework supports a family of hardware-compatible structured sparsity patterns. It couples this structure learning with budget-aware compression and dedicated CPU and GPU kernels that exploit the learned structure for acceleration, enabling efficient inference from a single checkpoint across memory budgets. Experiments on Llama2 and Qwen3 models, covering both pretraining and distillation, show that S-SALAAD advances the empirical Pareto frontier in perplexity, memory, and inference latency across multiple hardware platforms relative to the evaluated baselines. These results show that structured learning can translate elastic compressibility into reduced memory requirements and lower inference latency, enabling practical deployment of large models on edge devices.

    缩放定律持续奖励模型规模的增长，但随之而来的计算和内存需求，也使推理越来越依赖云基础设施。然而，网络连接不稳定、通信延迟和隐私要求可能使这种依赖不切实际，因此需要在边缘设备上本地运行模型。本地部署要求模型能够适配有限内存，并利用可用计算资源高效运行。近期研究表明，学习稀疏加低秩表征可以将单个检查点灵活压缩到多种内存预算。然而，参数更少并不一定能带来更快的推理速度。非结构化稀疏组件中的索引开销和不规则内存访问，可能抵消计算节省。为解决这一关键部署障碍，我们提出 S-SALAAD，这是一个统一框架，可在训练期间联合学习模型权重及其低秩和结构化稀疏组件。该框架支持一系列与硬件兼容的结构化稀疏模式，并将结构学习与预算感知压缩以及专用 CPU 和 GPU 内核相结合；这些内核利用所学结构实现加速，使单个检查点能够在不同内存预算下高效推理。针对 Llama2 和 Qwen3 模型开展的实验涵盖预训练和蒸馏，结果表明，与所评估的基线相比，S-SALAAD 在多个硬件平台上改善了困惑度、内存占用和推理延迟之间的经验 Pareto 前沿。这些结果表明，结构化学习可以将弹性可压缩性转化为更低的内存需求和推理延迟，从而使大型模型能够在边缘设备上实际部署。

    LazyFlash: Forward-Dense, Backward-Sparse Attention for Accelerated Long-Context Fine-Tuning

    Keqi Deng, Ruchao Fan, Jinyu Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LazyFlash introduces gradient-aware block sparsification and importance sampling to accelerate attention’s backward pass while preserving dense forward behavior and standard serving compatibility. Its contribution is to training computation and efficiency, not to internal interpretability, composition, or reasoning capability.

    LazyFlash 提出感知梯度的块稀疏化和重要性采样方法，以加速注意力的反向传播，同时保留稠密前向计算，并兼容标准服务部署。其贡献在于训练计算和效率，而非内部可解释性、组合能力或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly long sequences, attention becomes a major computational bottleneck. Sparse attention mostly targets inference, yet many methods still train densely or cannot support sparse training, and their added complexity makes sparsity hard to turn into wall-clock speedups, leaving dense attention widely used in practice. This paper introduces LazyFlash, a forward-dense, backward-sparse attention method built on the observation that attention training is dominated by the backward pass. LazyFlash keeps the forward pass exactly dense, so the trained model remains a standard dense model that existing systems such as vLLM can serve without any change. For the backward pass, LazyFlash proposes a gradient-aware block sparsification design that ranks query blocks by their attention-output gradient norms and skips those contributing negligibly to parameter updates, turning the dense backward into a block-sparse one. A gradient-mass budget adapts the amount of skipped computation to each head and training step, while importance sampling preserves the dense gradient in expectation. These designs are implemented inside the tiled FlashAttention backward kernel, where skipped blocks are never loaded or computed, translating gradient sparsity into real wall-clock acceleration. Experiments on long-context text and speech LLMs show that LazyFlash maintains downstream performance while achieving up to 5.7x attention-backward speedup over FlashAttention and 1.7x end-to-end training speedup.

    中文

    随着大型语言模型（LLM）处理越来越长的序列，注意力成为主要计算瓶颈。稀疏注意力大多针对推理阶段，但许多方法仍采用稠密训练，或不支持稀疏训练；其额外复杂性也使稀疏性难以转化为实际运行时间的加速，因此实践中仍广泛使用稠密注意力。本文提出 LazyFlash，一种前向稠密、反向稀疏的注意力方法，其依据是注意力训练的主要开销来自反向传播。LazyFlash 保持前向传播完全稠密，因此训练后的模型仍是标准稠密模型，现有系统（如 vLLM）无需任何更改即可提供服务。对于反向传播，LazyFlash 提出一种感知梯度的块稀疏化设计，按照注意力输出梯度范数对查询块排序，并跳过那些对参数更新贡献可忽略的块，将稠密反向传播转变为块稀疏反向传播。梯度质量预算会根据各个注意力头和训练步动态调整跳过的计算量，同时重要性采样可在期望意义上保留稠密梯度。这些设计被实现于分块 FlashAttention 反向传播内核中；被跳过的块既不会加载，也不会计算，从而将梯度稀疏性转化为实际的运行时间加速。针对长上下文文本和语音 LLM 的实验表明，LazyFlash 在保持下游性能的同时，相比 FlashAttention 将注意力反向传播加速最高达 5.7 倍，并将端到端训练加速 1.7 倍。

    Decode Late, Multiply Once: Rethinking the Dot Product for Quantized Weights

    延后解码，一次乘法：重新思考量化权重的点积计算

    Jonathan Tapson

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents an exact dot-product refactoring for quantized weights and a processing-element design that reduces multiplier use and weight memory, with savings dependent on sharing across PEs. This is a substantive model-computation and hardware contribution, but it does not address interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    本文提出一种针对量化权重的精确点积重构方法，以及一种可减少乘法器用量和权重存储的处理单元设计；节省效果取决于多个 PE 之间的共享。这是模型计算和硬件方面的实质性贡献，但未涉及可解释性、组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large neural networks are increasingly deployed with 1-4 bit weights and 16- or 32-bit activations, yet their dot products still use one multiplier per element. We show that a length-n dot product with k-bit weight codes can be computed with n+2^k additions and at most 2^k decodes and 2^k multiplications. Each weight code is used directly as an address offset that selects one of 2^k accumulators; each activation is added into the selected accumulator; and the accumulated sums are decoded and multiplied only once, at the end, in a fused decode-and-multiply step. The decoded weight vector is never formed. The refactoring is exact for integer arithmetic, works with integer or floating-point operands and with arbitrary, including nonlinear, decoders, and extends to group-wise scales and to matrix and tensor products. The multiplier count falls by n/2^k, while total arithmetic energy improves by a smaller, bounded factor that we quantify with a cost model. We describe a scatter-accumulate processing element (SA-PE) that replaces the MAC unit in a weight-stationary systolic array, with a load/stream/reduce/drain schedule in which a small, time-shareable multiplier runs only 2^k times per tile. Because decoded weights are not stored, local weight memory shrinks by up to w_d/k for w_d-bit decoded weights. An RTL implementation synthesized for FPGA and compared with a matched MAC array shows that an unshared SA-PE is larger than a MAC PE, and that the saving appears when the reduction multiplier is shared across PEs. Software models confirm exact integer equivalence and floating-point error no worse than the conventional pipeline. We do not claim the underlying identity is new, and we discuss related work on weight sharing and lookup-based kernels.

    中文

    大型神经网络越来越多地采用 1-4 位权重和 16 位或 32 位激活进行部署，但它们的点积仍为每个元素使用一个乘法器。我们展示了，对于使用 k 位权重编码、长度为 n 的点积，可以通过 n+2^k 次加法，以及最多 2^k 次解码和 2^k 次乘法来计算。每个权重编码都直接用作地址偏移量，用于选择 2^k 个累加器之一；每个激活值都加到所选累加器中；最后再对累加结果解码并只乘一次，作为融合的解码与乘法步骤。整个过程中不会形成解码后的权重向量。这种重构在整数运算中是精确的，适用于整数或浮点操作数，也适用于任意解码器（包括非线性解码器），并可扩展到组级缩放以及矩阵和张量乘积。乘法器数量减少 n/2^k 倍，而总算术能耗的改善幅度较小且有界，我们用成本模型对其进行了量化。我们描述了一种散射累加处理单元（SA-PE），用它替换权重驻留脉动阵列中的 MAC 单元；其加载/流式处理/归约/排空调度中，一个小型且可分时共享的乘法器每个分块只需运行 2^k 次。由于不存储解码后的权重，若解码后权重为 w_d 位，本地权重存储最多可缩减 w_d/k。我们在 FPGA 上综合了一种 RTL 实现，并与匹配的 MAC 阵列进行比较，结果表明未共享的 SA-PE 比 MAC PE 更大；只有在多个 PE 之间共享归约乘法器时，才能体现出节省。软件模型确认了整数运算完全等价，浮点误差不高于传统流水线。我们并不声称底层恒等式是新的，并讨论了权重共享和基于查找表的内核相关工作。

    ENGLISH

We study execution-time reliability of tool-using AI agents, isolating recovery decisions from language-model behavior. Checkpoint state, permission to dispatch, evidence of an external effect and permission to reconcile are distinct obligations. We present a finite conformance study that checks these obligations through histories scored against a provider effect ledger hidden from the recovering application. A prospectively frozen campaign executes 336 histories on native LangGraph and Temporal hosts, crossing 14 schedules, three provider contracts and four matched application policies. All 168 paired host cells have identical checked outcomes. Per host, retained-ledger reconciliation passes all 42 histories: 21 checked completions, 15 denials and six unknown outcomes with reservations retained. Cached retry, revalidation before retry and stable-key retry pass 30, 36 and 31 histories respectively. A separate 16-case component study of InfinityOS, an enterprise AI platform developed by Arya.ai, exercises exported authority, worker, recovery and settlement code over repository fakes. The results isolate the roles of current authority, provider contracts and retained observations in recovery, with safety, completion and unresolved obligations reported separately for the declared application profile.

    ENGLISH

    Distilling interactive LLM agents requires choosing between teacher-generated demonstrations and student-generated experience, corresponding broadly to off-policy and on-policy distillation. While both have proven effective, we argue that this distinction is inherently hierarchical: the policy that induces an interaction history need not be the same as the policy that generates the token prefix of the current action. We introduce a hierarchical agent distillation framework that formalizes these two levels of on-policiness and enables explicit control over their pairing, mixture proportions, and training schedule. We study this problem through self-distillation, where a frozen teacher has access to task guidance unavailable to the student, and conduct a three-stage controlled study across three models and four interactive environments. We find that student-induced histories paired with teacher-generated action prefixes generally provide the strongest standalone training signal, whereas following the student at both levels generally performs worst. Nevertheless, fully on-policy data becomes beneficial when incorporated into a mixture with other configurations. Moreover, mixtures with identical teacher/student proportions at each level can yield substantially different performance, showing that how the two levels are paired matters beyond the overall amount of on-policy data. Finally, front-loading fully teacher-generated contexts and delaying fully on-policy contexts improves over a static mixture. These findings provide practical principles for deciding where, how much, and when agent distillation should follow the student.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce TWIG (Tree-structured Weights with Inherited Gates), a representation in which every weight of a neural network is the end of a path of small discrete decisions: a sign, a shift by a power of two, a zero gate, an index into a shared table. Weights that belong together share the upper part of their paths, and each decision is inherited by every weight below it, so it is stored once and applied once. This simple change has three consequences. Any trained network can be written as a TWIG, and when the decisions are powers of two its weight layers become circuits made almost entirely of wires and adders, suited to chips whose weights are fixed at fabrication. Pruning, quantization, low-rank factorization, codebooks and weight sharing become edits of one object, so a single optimizer can choose among all of them for a whole network. And choosing the decisions is the ground-state problem of a higher-order Boltzmann machine whose interactions follow the paths of the tree, the problem class that annealers and quantum optimizers are built to solve. Today these questions are handled apart: each compression method brings its own format and solver, a circuit with fixed weights needs a dedicated constant multiplier for every weight, and discrete solvers reach only narrow subproblems such as rounding. Weight formats have long been moving toward shared decisions, through group scales, shared exponents, microexponents and sparse weights; TWIG takes this trend to its end, and every common format is a shallow TWIG at no extra cost. On five weight matrices of a large language model, a flat tree whose signed power-of-two terms are chosen per weight for circuit cost, with no group scales, needs 9--15\% fewer additions than GPTQ at equal layer error at 3- and 4-bit accuracy on typical matrices, and 20--55\% fewer on matrices with strong outliers.

    中文

    我们提出 TWIG（带继承门控的树结构权重），一种神经网络权重表示：每个权重都是一条由若干小型离散决策组成的路径的终点，例如符号、按 2 的幂次移位、零门控，以及共享表中的索引。相互关联的权重共享其路径的上部，每项决策都会被其下方的所有权重继承，因此只需存储一次、应用一次。这一简单改变带来三个结果。任何训练好的网络都能表示为 TWIG；当决策取 2 的幂次时，其权重层几乎完全变成由连线和加法器构成的电路，适用于权重在制造时即被固定的芯片。剪枝、量化、低秩分解、码本和权重共享都变成对同一个对象的编辑，因此一个优化器便能为整个网络在这些方法中作出选择。此外，选择这些决策等价于求解高阶玻尔兹曼机的基态问题；其相互作用沿树的路径展开，这正是退火器和量子优化器旨在解决的问题类别。如今，这些问题分别处理：每种压缩方法都有自己的格式和求解器；权重固定的电路需要为每个权重配备专用常数乘法器；离散求解器也只能处理舍入等狭窄子问题。权重格式长期以来一直在朝共享决策的方向发展，包括分组缩放、共享指数、微指数和稀疏权重；TWIG 将这一趋势推至极致，而且所有常见格式都能以零额外成本表示为浅层 TWIG。在大型语言模型的五个权重矩阵上，对于典型矩阵，采用扁平树、按每个权重的电路成本选择有符号的 2 的幂次项且不使用分组缩放时，在层误差相同、精度为 3 位和 4 位的条件下，所需加法次数比 GPTQ 少 9--15\%；对于离群值显著的矩阵，则少 20--55\%。

    在循环语言模型中，保持深度可复用的关键是步间一致，而非归一化

    Ivan Viakhirev, Kirill Borodin, Maxim Abramov, Grach Mkrtchian

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper investigates why looped models retain reusable depth, finding evidence that training and inference loop agreement matters and locating failure in the readout and last block layer. This is a substantial contribution to model computation and architecture, but it does not directly study internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning capability.

    本文研究循环模型为何能保持深度可复用，发现训练循环与推理循环的一致性很重要，并将故障定位到读出层和层块的最后一层。这是对模型计算与架构的重要贡献，但没有直接研究内部表征、组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped language models apply one block of layers repeatedly, and the design pays off only if depth is reusable: loop steps beyond the trained budget must remain usable at inference. We ask whether that rests on normalising the state between loop steps, as the released Ouro models do, or on agreement between the loop a model is trained with and the loop it is run with. On released weights this loop-boundary normalisation can be removed without adding parameters and with the readout path bit-identical, and the operation is an identity at one loop step, which serves as an implementation check. Removing it takes Ouro-1.4B and Ouro-2.6B to zero accuracy by the trained budget on a balanced binary task (chance 0.500). State-norm growth, the failure that prior accounts predict, is not the cause: the norm stays within a factor of 2.021 while the head commits to a single wrong token. Yet in 19M-parameter models trained from scratch on two synthetic tasks, 16 seeds per configuration, training without the normalisation is never worse than training with it and extrapolates better: the two are closest at the trained depth and separate on both sides of it (Cliff's delta up to 0.867 beyond the budget). Both results follow if agreement, and not the normalisation itself, is what keeps depth reusable. The damage sits in the readout together with the last layer of the block: in the models trained from scratch, refitting the head over the frozen modified loop recovers a third of the lost accuracy and plateaus, while refitting the last block layer with it recovers all of it. Finally, comparing looped with stacked depth at an equal inference loop count is confounded by unequal overshoot of the trained budget; at matched overshoot the advantage of looping vanishes on one task and shrinks on the other.

    中文

    循环语言模型会反复应用同一个层块；只有当深度可以复用时，这种设计才有价值：超出训练预算的循环步数在推理时仍须可用。我们探究这究竟取决于循环步之间的状态归一化（已发布的 Ouro 模型采用了这种做法），还是取决于模型训练时使用的循环次数与运行时使用的循环次数是否一致。在已发布的权重上，可以移除这种循环边界归一化而不增加参数，同时保持读出路径逐位完全一致；在一个循环步时，该操作等同于恒等映射，可用作实现检查。移除归一化后，Ouro-1.4B 和 Ouro-2.6B 在一个平衡二元任务上，到训练预算对应的循环深度时准确率降为零（随机猜测准确率为 0.500）。先前解释所预测的故障原因——状态范数增长——并非原因：范数始终保持在 2.021 倍范围内，而输出头却会确定地给出一个错误词元。然而，在两个合成任务上从头训练的 19M 参数模型中，每种配置使用 16 个随机种子；不使用归一化进行训练的效果从未差于使用归一化训练的模型，且外推表现更好：两者在训练深度处最接近，在训练深度两侧则开始分化（超出预算后 Cliff's delta 最高达 0.867）。如果起作用的是一致性，而非归一化本身，那么这两项结果都可以得到解释。损害同时出现在读出层和层块的最后一层：对于从头训练的模型，在冻结修改后的循环结构上重新拟合输出头，只能恢复三分之一的准确率损失，之后便停滞；若同时重新拟合层块的最后一层，则能全部恢复。最后，在推理时循环次数相同的情况下比较循环深度与堆叠深度，会受到训练预算超出量不相等的干扰；在超出量匹配时，循环结构的优势在一个任务上消失，在另一个任务上则缩小。

    Knowing Whom to Trust is not Enough: The Trust--Agreement Gap in Repeated Multi-Party LLM Negotiation

    知道该信任谁还不够：重复多方 LLM 谈判中的信任—达成协议差距

    Amit Sarker, Moumita Choudhury, Saaduddin Mahmud, Shlomo Zilberstein

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces repeated multi-party LLM negotiations with persistent pairwise trust estimates and finds that trust improves agreement only when agents are guided to use it. This is a substantial agent-memory and interaction study, while reasoning is examined as a supporting factor; it does not investigate internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文提出一种重复多方 LLM 谈判设置，其中持续维护成对信任估计，并发现只有在引导智能体使用信任信息时，信任才会提升协议达成率。这是一项重要的智能体记忆与交互研究，推理则作为辅助因素加以考察；本文没有探究模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in negotiations on behalf of individuals and organizations, yet they remain vulnerable to manipulation, particularly in repeated multi-party interactions. Classical multi-agent systems address this challenge through explicit trust and reputation models, whereas existing work on LLM negotiation largely treats trust as an emergent phenomenon. We investigate whether LLM agents can form useful trust estimates from prior interactions and leverage them to improve future negotiation outcomes. We introduce a repeated, multi-party, multi-issue negotiation framework in which recurring agents participate in a sequence of negotiation games while one participant covertly attempts to prevent agreement. After each game, agents assess their counterparts and maintain pairwise trust estimates that carry over to subsequent negotiations. We compare trust-aware and trust-agnostic agents and analyze how explicit trust influences negotiation outcomes. Our results reveal a \emph{trust--agreement gap}: trust-aware agents can identify the adversary within a few games, but accurate trust estimates do not consistently translate into better agreements. Trust increases agreement rates by up to 23 percentage points, but only when agents are explicitly guided to use it in their decisions. Explicit trust can therefore improve repeated LLM negotiations, but its value depends critically on how trust is assessed and incorporated into agents' reasoning.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地代表个人和组织参与谈判，但仍容易受到操纵，尤其是在重复的多方互动中。经典多智能体系统通过显式信任与声誉模型应对这一挑战，而现有的 LLM 谈判研究大多将信任视为涌现现象。我们研究 LLM 智能体能否根据过往互动形成有用的信任估计，并利用这些估计改善未来的谈判结果。我们提出一个重复的多方多议题谈判框架：反复参与的智能体依次进行一系列谈判博弈，其中一名参与者暗中试图阻止达成协议。每场博弈结束后，智能体会评估对手，并维护可延续至后续谈判的成对信任估计。我们比较具备信任意识与不具备信任意识的智能体，并分析显式信任如何影响谈判结果。结果揭示了一个 extit{信任—达成协议差距}：具备信任意识的智能体能在几场博弈内识别出对手，但准确的信任估计并不总能转化为更好的协议。只有在明确引导智能体依据这些估计作出决策时，信任才会使协议达成率最多提高 23 个百分点。因此，显式信任能够改善重复 LLM 谈判，但其价值关键取决于如何评估信任，以及如何将其纳入智能体的推理。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The central contribution is a provenance and taint-tracking mechanism that contains prompt injection across MCP tools and agent boundaries, with ablations and a trusted-promotion mechanism. This is a substantial agent-system security contribution, but it does not investigate model internals, composition, or reasoning capabilities.

    本文的核心贡献是一种来源跟踪与污点跟踪机制，可遏制 MCP 工具和智能体边界间的提示注入，并辅以消融实验和可信提升机制。这是一项重要的智能体系统安全贡献，但没有探究模型内部机制、组合性或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic AI systems using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection through untrusted tool outputs. We demonstrate cross-modal trust laundering, in which instructions concealed in an email-signature image using least-significant-bit (LSB), discrete cosine transform (DCT), or metadata steganography bypass text scanners and enter a multi-agent workflow when decoded by a tool. To counter this threat, we propose decode-time provenance binding, which combines HMAC-authenticated trust labels with an MCP-maintained provenance ledger and context-taint tracking. The mechanism labels decoded content as untrusted and blocks critical tool calls influenced by that content, even when a compromised agent substitutes a valid trusted label. We evaluate the approach using a real MCP testbed with three steganographic carriers and 24 adaptive payloads. The undefended pipeline exhibits 100% attack success, while keyword and regex defenses each permit 62.5% of attacks. Our mechanism blocks all attacks (0% success), including adversarial label substitution across mediated agent boundaries. A four-component ablation validates the roles of decode marking, cryptographic authentication, lineage tracking, and sink enforcement. An audited trusted-promotion mechanism increases legitimate-task completion from 67% to 100% without compromising protection. The approach provides carrier-independent containment within fully mediated MCP execution environments. Code and data are publicly available.

Long-form microdrama script generation with LLMs requires both diverse plot progression and long-range narrative coherence. Our observations reveal that candidate continuations increasingly concentrate on fewer narrative mechanisms as generation progresses, while conventional retrieval may reinforce trope reuse and overlook historical information essential to future plots. To address these challenges, we propose DraMaze, a multi-agent pipeline that explores diverse causal paths through trope memory-guided evolutionary tree search and mutation. It further constructs a Backward Narrative Dependency Tree to organize, retain, and retrieve historical memories based on future narrative goals. We also introduce MiDramaBench, a bilingual benchmark for evaluating script logic and creative quality across different script lengths, together with causal-pattern metrics for narrative repetition and diversity.     Carson Cary, Yukai Jin, Yihao Huang, Zhankai Ye, Fangyi Li, Ting Hua, Xin Liu, Shangqian Gao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GS-MoE compresses MoE models by sharing low-rank subspaces across experts, pruning intermediate widths, and allocating budgets by layer and expert. This is a substantial contribution to model computation and parameter organization; retained reasoning performance is an evaluation metric, not a reasoning-method contribution.

    GS-MoE 通过在专家间共享低秩子空间、剪除中间层宽度，并按层和专家分配预算来压缩 MoE 模型。这对模型计算和参数组织作出了重要贡献；保留的推理性能是评估指标，而非推理方法方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse activation, but storing their expert parameters remains a major memory bottleneck. We introduce GS-MoE, a training-free compression framework that addresses redundancy across and within experts through two compression axes: shared-subspace rank and expert intermediate width. Groupwise low-rank representations capture shared structure across experts while retaining expert-specific projections, and Nystr\"om-based neuron compression reduces intermediate width within each expert. For fixed shared subspaces, we derive per-expert reconstruction-error reductions from the reconstruction objective and use them to guide expert grouping. Budgets are allocated hierarchically using a gradient-free layer-importance score to guide the allocation of rank and width budgets across layers, which eigenvalues and leverage then distribute as non-uniform ranks across groups and intermediate widths across experts. Experiments demonstrate the complementary benefits of compression along both axes, particularly at high compression rates on fine-grained MoE models. On DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base, at a 60% reduction in total model parameters, GS-MoE retains approximately 90% of the uncompressed model's average reasoning performance, compared with 73% for D$^2$-MoE, while achieving 20% lower out-of-domain perplexity. We provide a code implementation at: https://github.com/cbacary/GS-MoE

We introduce RSI-Opt, a plug-and-play Recursive Self-Improvement Optimizer Agents which evolves the knowledge that guides this process: a prompt, a playbook of procedures, a library of tested optimizer code, and a decision cadence. A meta-agent rewrites this policy using evidence from earlier runs, and an archive retains evaluated policies for further evolution. Across 5 generations on three training tasks, the meta-agents develop reusable procedures and code and conduct their own CPU proxy experiments. Controlled comparisons show that the evolved policy combines reusable optimization knowledge with adaptation to each task: initial decisions capture most observed gains on seen tasks, while continued adaptation improves outcomes on unseen tasks.     Supervised contrastive learning and its balanced variants have demonstrated their effectiveness for representation learning under long-tailed distributions. However, although prior analyses suggest that their optimal representations may exhibit a regular simplex geometry, whether such a geometry is indeed exhibited remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we present a theoretical framework for these objectives that characterizes whether a regular simplex is formed at the optimum. By applying this to representative objectives, we show that these objectives fail to form a regular simplex at the optimum because they remain dependent on the number of samples per class. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce structural balancing that can be applied to contrastive objectives, and propose a fully balanced contrastive objective that provably forms a regular simplex geometry at its optimum. Both theoretical and empirical results demonstrate that the proposed method yields a more balanced representation space and improves performance on long-tailed recognition and transfer learning tasks.

    Recent \emph{test-time training} (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient \emph{test-time adaptation} method for scientific discovery. We introduce \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT on all five mathematical tasks, while reducing computational cost by $82.8$-$84.6\%$ in FLOPs and $47.7$-$58.4\%$ in runtime.     Multi-agent LLM systems aim to improve reasoning through debate, evidence sharing, and mutual correction, but interaction can also introduce failures that final accuracy alone cannot explain. Agents may converge too early, ignore dissent, suppress correct minority answers, or preserve a wrong framing across rounds. We present a corpus-grounded taxonomy of communication failures, built from 3,211 failed multi-round trajectories across medical QA, coding, finance, multi-hop reasoning, ethics, and embodied text tasks. Using this taxonomy, we analyze failure distributions across datasets and system designs, round-level error dynamics, recovery hardness, majority transitions, minority-signal suppression, and self-reported confidence. We find that failures are dominated by recovery/correction and consensus/decision problems rather than isolated first-round mistakes, with many emerging after agents first observe peer responses. Based on these findings, we recommend stronger disagreement handling, evidence verification, minority-signal preservation, and recovery checks before finalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models (DLMs) support bidirectional denoising and iterative refinement, but generation remains largely controlled by token-level masking schedules. This leaves draft-level refinement implicit and limits explicit control over when to insert missing content, delete redundant spans, revisit uncertain regions, or stop editing. We introduce Diffusion Editing Language Adapter (DELA), a plug-in framework that enables controllable draft refinement with a frozen DLM. DELA operates on clean, variable-length drafts using four explicit editing actions: Insert, Delete, Remask, and Stop. The controller determines when and where to edit the draft, while the frozen DLM fills masked regions through denoising, separating high-level edit control from token-level generation. A naive single-phase editor would be computationally expensive because arbitrary interior edits can disrupt prefix stability and limit reliable KV-cache reuse. To address this, DELA uses a two-phase decoding procedure: a fast, append-only drafting phase that supports KV-cache reuse, followed by a global refinement phase that enables targeted non-monotonic edits to the full draft. We train the controller using a staged curriculum that begins with learning local edit priors from synthetic recovery tasks and mined actions that improve draft quality. Subsequent stages refine edit selection through rollout-based outcome preferences and alignment with downstream task feedback. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and code generation show that DELA achieves gains of up to 5.5 percentage points over direct diffusion decoding while keeping the backbone frozen. DELA thus provides a modular approach to explicit draft-level control in diffusion language models.

    Awni Altabaa, Tobias Schnabel, Kiran Tomlinson

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper compares formal theories of transformer capabilities and tests their predictions, including length generalization on structurally varied tasks; this offers substantial insight into generalization, though its focus is broader than composition. Its computational tasks have some connection to reasoning and architecture, but the abstract does not center reasoning mechanisms or model systems.

    本文比较了关于 Transformer 能力的形式化理论并检验其预测，涵盖结构多样任务上的长度泛化；这为理解泛化提供了实质性见解，不过其关注范围比组合性更广。文中的计算任务与推理和架构有一定关联，但摘要并未以推理机制或模型系统为中心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Several formal theories have been developed to characterize the capabilities and limitations of the transformer architecture, each employing different abstractions that capture different features of the architecture. Due to the differences in their underlying assumptions and conceptual frameworks, these theories can disagree in their predictions about what tasks transformers find easy or hard. We map out seven theories of transformer capability (Star-free, $\mathsf{AC}^0$, $\mathsf{TC}^0$, C-RASP, MPC, BAPO, and Sensitivity) and translate their results into a common matrix of predictions across a suite of tasks covering different computational structures. We provide new theoretical results to complete this matrix. We then evaluate theoretical predictions through controlled experiments measuring in-distribution sample complexity, length generalization, and pretrained language model performance. We find that no single theory explains the observed pattern of successes and failures. When a theory does not capture the transformer behaviors relevant to a task, its predictions break down; for instance, we show that the $k$-hop induction task is predicted hard by C-RASP because it does not model content-dependent attention, but we train small transformers on this task that length-generalize. Similarly, theories assuming hard attention like $\mathsf{AC}^0$ and BAPO predict binary majority to be hard, for which we also find success in practice. Together, our results point to several specific features that a theory of transformers must capture: soft rather than hard attention, dynamic content-dependent retrieval, bounded computation at each position, an account of learnability and inductive biases, and a combination of upper and lower bounds.

    The paper tests causal hidden-state interventions on early chain-of-thought trajectories and shows that intervention timing affects downstream safety outcomes, separating risk prediction from effective control.     该论文测试了对早期思维链轨迹的因果隐藏状态干预，并表明干预时机会影响下游安全结果，从而区分了风险预测与有效控制。这推进了对推理过程的分析，并为生成机制提供了洞见，但其目标并非组合泛化或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) generation offers an opportunity to intervene before a reasoning model completes its answer. But does the point at which risk is easiest to detect also offer the most effective control? We study this question with REACT, a conditional activation intervention that learns a safety direction from paired safe and unsafe trajectories and applies it once to an early CoT hidden state. The model weights remain frozen, and all subsequent tokens are generated without further edits. To study timing, we train directions separately at each of the first five CoT positions and evaluate ungated edits with full post-edit regeneration. Across three distilled reasoning models and three generation seeds, the strongest gains concentrate in a two- to three-token early window; on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, the effect falls to approximately zero at the fourth and fifth tokens, even though later states can be more predictive of risk. This separates risk readability from effective control: intervention timing must be evaluated through its effect on subsequent generation. On the same 8B model, REACT raises the rate of fully safe CoT-answer outputs on StrongREJECT-273 from 29.06% to 82.05%, while keeping benign refusal and usefulness near baseline. An anonymized implementation is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/REACT_official2-333B.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EDWARD-NMT contributes an MoE architecture with elastic sub-networks and adaptive per-token expert routing, enabling deployment at different memory and compute budgets from one checkpoint. This is a strong systems contribution; its NMT application does not establish a substantive advance in compositional generalization or the other directions.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a powerful paradigm for scaling Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and managing language heterogeneity. However, practical limitations hinder its deployment on resource-constrained devices: the entire expert pool must remain in memory, and the per-token compute budget is statically fixed during training by rigid top-k routing. We introduce EDWARD-NMT (Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for NMT), a novel MoE encoder-decoder architecture designed for a train once, deploy anywhere paradigm that exposes a family of deployable sub-networks at inference time. EDWARD-NMT integrates three key innovations: (i) Matryoshka-style elastic dimensions to flexibly reduce the memory footprint; (ii) an adaptive sigmoid router with a learned, task-conditioned threshold, allowing each token to dynamically determine its active expert count; and (iii) a dual-consistency objective to maximize the performance of the extracted sub-networks. Extensive experiments on PhoMT (En-Vi), WMT-14 (En-De), multilingual OPUS-16, and a multi-domain De-En benchmark validate our approach. The full-capacity architecture matches or exceeds strong MoE baselines with improved parameter efficiency. Furthermore, the sub-networks seamlessly extracted from a single checkpoint consistently outperform comparably sized dense Transformers without any retraining.

    稀疏混合专家（MoE）是扩展神经机器翻译（NMT）和处理语言异质性的有力范式。然而，实际限制妨碍了它在资源受限设备上的部署：整个专家池必须常驻内存，而且通过僵化的 top-k 路由，每个词元的计算预算在训练期间便被静态固定。我们提出 EDWARD-NMT（用于 NMT 的弹性维度、自适应路由与双重一致性），这是一种新颖的 MoE 编码器-解码器架构，旨在实现“一次训练，随处部署”的范式，可在推理时提供一系列可部署的子网络。EDWARD-NMT 集成了三项关键创新：(i) 类 Matryoshka 的弹性维度，可灵活缩减内存占用；(ii) 带有学习得到的、依任务而定的阈值的自适应 sigmoid 路由器，使每个词元都能动态决定其启用的专家数量；以及 (iii) 双重一致性目标，以最大化提取出的子网络的性能。我们在 PhoMT（En-Vi）、WMT-14（En-De）、多语言 OPUS-16 和多领域 De-En 基准上进行了大量实验，验证了该方法。完整容量的架构以更高的参数效率达到或超过了强大的 MoE 基线。此外，从单个检查点直接提取的子网络，无需任何重新训练，始终优于规模相当的稠密 Transformer。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.

    The paper shows that sentiment information is encoded but poorly reflected in embedding geometry, and proposes a diagnostic and trainable head to align the metric with that information. This gives transferable insight into representation geometry; retrieval and RAG are application contexts rather than advances in model or agent systems.

    该论文表明，嵌入中编码了情感信息，但这种信息在嵌入几何结构中体现得很差；论文还提出了一种诊断方法和可训练的头，以使度量与该信息对齐。这为表征几何提供了可迁移的洞见；检索和 RAG 是应用场景，并非模型或智能体系统方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We report a systematic dissociation in modern text embedders: sentiment is almost perfectly decodable from their embeddings, yet almost entirely absent from their metric. Across eleven frozen encoders spanning 2021 to 2026, including 2026-generation models and the 4B-parameter LLM embedder Qwen3-Embedding-4B, a linear probe recovers sentence polarity at up to 91.3% accuracy while cosine similarity separates polarity by a margin of only 0.003-0.064. Qwen3-Embedding-4B, the strongest probe in the panel, reaches 91.3% probe accuracy but only 64.3 retrieval MAP. Because retrieval, clustering, deduplication, and retrieval-augmented generation operate on the metric rather than on a trained probe, these systems are effectively blind to information their encoder demonstrably contains. A task-conditioning control suggests this reflects the pretraining objective rather than a prompting artifact: conditioning Jina-v5 on its classification task rather than its retrieval task recovers only about half of the MAP gain that injection achieves on the same weights (63.2 to 73.8, versus 85.1), and leaves the alignment gap essentially unchanged. Sentiment-Injected Sentence Embeddings (SISE) train a small (0.13M-0.69M-parameter) supervised-contrastive head on a frozen encoder in seconds on a CPU, using the labelled training set. The head improves every encoder released since 2022 on full-data probe accuracy (up to +5.8 points), retrieval MAP (up to +26.0) and polarity margin (7-61x). This is a specialization, not a free gain: the compact 128-d head loses 38-41 Spearman points on STS-B, while a fused variant that concatenates it with the base embedding loses 2.4-12.0. With the head, a 0.6B encoder at 128 dimensions matches a 4B encoder given the same head (91.8 vs. 90.3 MAP). We release a CPU-reproducible pipeline and a reusable diagnostic, the Attribute Alignment Gap.

    Conditional Flow Models for Offline Maximum Entropy Reinforcement Learning

    用于离线最大熵强化学习的条件流模型

    Hao Cheng, Yuling Jiao, Lican Kang, Jerry Zhijian Yang, Chen Zhong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a conditional-flow approach to offline maximum-entropy reinforcement learning and provides nonasymptotic guarantees for environment modeling and value learning, making a substantial algorithmic contribution to learning for problem solving. Its use of diffusion models is incidental to mechanistic interpretability, while the abstract offers no substantive systems contribution.

    该论文提出了一种用于离线最大熵强化学习的条件流方法，并为环境建模和值函数学习提供了非渐近保证，是一项重要的算法贡献，推进了面向问题求解的学习。扩散模型的使用与机制可解释性只有间接联系，而摘要未体现出实质性的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Offline maximum entropy reinforcement learning seeks to estimate the optimal soft action-value function \(Q^*\) from a fixed dataset without further interaction with the environment. Although \(Q^*\) is characterized by the soft optimal Bellman equation, the corresponding Bellman operator cannot be evaluated directly because both the reward distribution and the transition kernel are unknown. Consequently, estimating \(Q^*\) requires the joint treatment of environment modeling and value function learning. We propose a framework that addresses these tasks separately. Conditional diffusion models based on probability flow ODEs estimate the conditional reward distribution and transition kernel. The resulting distributional estimators define a data driven approximation of the soft optimal Bellman operator, whose empirical Bellman residual is minimized over a class of deep neural networks to estimate \(Q^*\). We establish nonasymptotic guarantees for the proposed method. For operator learning, we derive total variation error bounds for the conditional flow estimators that account explicitly for score estimation, numerical discretization, and terminal smoothing. For soft value learning, we first use the soft Bellman equation to show that $Q^*$ inherits H\"older regularity from the conditional reward and transition densities. For any H\"older index $\beta$, the value learning stage achieves an excess Bellman residual risk bound of order $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\big(n^{-\frac{2\beta}{d+2\beta}}\big),$ where $d$ is the total dimension of the state and action spaces. In contrast to many existing theoretical analyses of deep reinforcement learning, our results do not require Bellman completeness. Numerical experiments support the theoretical findings and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

    中文

    离线最大熵强化学习旨在从固定数据集中估计最优软动作价值函数\(Q^*\)，且无需与环境进行进一步交互。尽管 \(Q^*\) 由软最优 Bellman 方程刻画，但由于奖励分布和转移核都未知，相应的 Bellman 算子无法直接计算。因此，估计 \(Q^*\) 需要联合处理环境建模和值函数学习。我们提出一个分别处理这两项任务的框架。基于概率流 ODE 的条件扩散模型用于估计条件奖励分布和转移核。由此得到的分布估计器定义了软最优 Bellman 算子的数据驱动近似；我们在一类深度神经网络上最小化其经验 Bellman 残差，以估计 \(Q^*\)。我们为所提出的方法建立了非渐近保证。对于算子学习，我们推导出条件流估计器的总变差误差界，并明确计入分数估计、数值离散化和终端平滑带来的影响。对于软价值学习，我们首先利用软 Bellman 方程证明，$Q^*$ 继承了条件奖励密度和转移密度的 H\"older 正则性。对于任意 H\"older 指数 $\beta$，价值学习阶段达到阶为 $\widetilde{\mathcal O}\big(n^{-\frac{2\beta}{d+2\beta}}\big),$ 的超额 Bellman 残差风险界，其中 $d$ 是状态空间和动作空间的总维数。与许多现有的深度强化学习理论分析不同，我们的结果不需要 Bellman 完备性。数值实验支持了理论发现，并展示了所提方法的有效性。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SyncPro’s main contribution is a dual-stream video assistant that tracks evidence while responding concurrently, trained with supervised learning and trajectory-level reinforcement learning. This substantially advances streaming reasoning and agent response behavior, while compositional generalization is only incidental to the framework.

    SyncPro 的主要贡献是一个双流视频助手：它在跟踪证据的同时并行响应，并通过监督学习和轨迹级强化学习进行训练。这实质性推进了流式推理和智能体响应行为；组合泛化仅与该框架间接相关。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user's requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. Sharing one generation path also couples two distinct requirements: preserving evidence for future decisions and producing only the response requested by the user. Moreover, responses generated after reasoning must wait for it to finish, even when sufficient evidence is already available. To address these challenges, we introduce SyncPro, a synchronous dual-stream framework with specialized generation paths for evidence tracking and user-facing responses. Its Inner and Response branches share causal history and activate independently, allowing relevant evidence changes to trigger internal updates and responses to proceed concurrently with ongoing reasoning. We construct 189K dual-stream examples and train SyncPro through supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. Experiments across three proactive benchmarks show improved response timing and more accurate answers to user requests.

    中文

    主动式流式视频理解要求助手跟踪不断展开的事件，并在满足用户指定条件时作出响应。为作出这些判断，助手必须累积相关证据，并随着新观察的到来重新评估响应条件。现有工作为这一过程提供了互补能力：主动式视频助手学习何时响应，而流式视频推理方法则生成定时的中间文本，以组织观察结果并支持后续回答。这些能力共同为主动推理奠定了基础，但如何协调持续推理与及时响应仍缺乏充分研究。直接改造现有方法时，固定的推理间隔可能会在没有相关变化时触发更新，也可能将有用的更新推迟到下一个预定步骤。共用一条生成路径也会将两个不同要求耦合起来：保留供未来决策使用的证据，以及只生成用户要求的响应。此外，即使已有足够证据，推理后生成的响应也必须等待推理结束。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SyncPro，这是一种同步双流框架，为证据跟踪和面向用户的响应设置了专门的生成路径。其 Inner 和 Response 分支共享因果历史并独立激活，使相关证据的变化能够触发内部更新，同时让响应与正在进行的推理并行生成。我们构建了 189K 个双流样本，并通过监督微调以及轨迹级强化学习训练 SyncPro。在三个主动式基准上的实验表明，该方法改善了响应时机，并提升了回答用户请求的准确性。

    Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this work, we investigate whether such trade-offs can be improved by changing how strongly each domain contributes to learning while keeping its data exposure fixed. We find that, in controlled knowledge--mathematics experiments, loss reweighting produces a single checkpoint that surpasses the best knowledge and reasoning scores attained along either stage trajectory. This reveals an independent control that data-mixture ratios alone do not capture. Building on this finding, we propose LARE (Loss-Adaptive Reweighting under fixed Exposure), which automatically adjusts domain weights from running loss statistics. Motivated by a theoretical analysis of gradient noise, its normalized inverse-square-root rule balances relative loss scales without changing the sampled mixture or requiring additional runs to search for weights. Across knowledge, mathematics, and code, \Method{} improves all five evaluated benchmarks for a 1.5B model trained on 240B tokens, averaging +7.84 pp over a matched direct mixture, including gains of +17.06 pp on GSM8K and +9.00 pp on MATH.     Seunghan Lee, Jun Seo, Junhyeok Kang, Jaehoon Lee, Sangjun Han, Sungdong Yoo, Minjae Kim, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, Soonyoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn

    DIVA and DIVA-U use decision value and uncertainty to select information checks and stop when further evidence is not worth its cost, improving decision regret across domains and models. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to strategic information seeking and decision-making, while its LLM context alone offers only a partial systems connection and no internal-mechanism or compositional insight.

    DIVA 和 DIVA-U 利用决策价值和不确定性来选择信息核查，并在进一步证据不值得其成本时停止，从而降低了不同领域和模型的决策遗憾。这是对策略性信息搜寻和决策制定的重要算法贡献；不过，仅有 LLM 这一背景与系统的关联有限，也没有提供关于内部机制或组合能力的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions under incomplete information, where deciding what to look up and when to stop matters as much as the final answer. However, LLMs fall into an information trap: They pay for checks, i.e., costly pieces of evidence, that cannot change their decision or are not worth their cost, and they keep asking when the evidence is already sufficient. To this end, we propose Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition (DIVA), a simple yet effective procedure for LLM information seeking based on the decision value of evidence. DIVA 1) lets the LLM specify a small decision model, i.e., how likely a bad outcome is and how each check would shift this probability, through short numeric questions and 2) values each candidate check by how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, stopping when no check is worth its cost. Its variant, DIVA-U, further accounts for the LLM's uncertain estimates of how strongly each check shifts this probability. DIVA is training-free and applies to any LLM. Across four domains and 20 LLMs, DIVA-U has lower regret, i.e., value lost relative to the best possible decision, than every LLM baseline on real-world data, mainly by stopping once evidence suffices, and DIVA cuts the regret of the best LLM baseline by 75% in synthetic scenarios where every check's reliability is given. Code: github.com/seunghan96/diva.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于在信息不完整的情况下支持决策，此时，决定查找什么信息以及何时停止，与最终答案本身同样重要。然而，LLM 会陷入信息陷阱：它们会为那些无法改变决策或不值得其成本的核查（即代价高昂的证据片段）付出代价；即使证据已经充分，它们仍会继续询问。为此，我们提出决策知情的价值信息获取方法（Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition，DIVA），这是一种简单而有效的程序，根据证据的决策价值来引导 LLM 搜寻信息。DIVA 1）让 LLM 通过简短的数值问题指定一个小型决策模型，即不良结果发生的可能性，以及每项核查会如何改变这一概率；2）根据每项候选核查可能产生的结果在扣除成本后能在多大程度上改善决策，为其估值，并在没有核查值得其成本时停止。其变体 DIVA-U 进一步考虑了 LLM 对每项核查会在多大程度上改变该概率所作估计的不确定性。DIVA 无需训练，适用于任何 LLM。在四个领域和 20 个 LLM 上，与所有 LLM 基线相比，DIVA-U 在真实世界数据上的遗憾更低；遗憾即相对于最佳可能决策所损失的价值。这主要归功于它会在证据充分时停止。在每项核查的可靠性均已给定的合成场景中，DIVA 将最佳 LLM 基线的遗憾降低了 75%。代码：github.com/seunghan96/diva。

    SWE-Shift 推出一个基准，用于评估编码智能体在执行期间面对工作区变化时的表现，并发现其成功率大幅下降，包括无法保留已有工作或刷新证据等问题。这是对智能体任务执行和状态管理的重要评估贡献；不过，摘要没有报告推理机制或组合泛化方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.

    Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown promising applications in reasoning tasks, its application to span-level hallucination detection is challenged by localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and uncontrolled length inflation. To address these issues, we introduce Socratic Guided Policy Optimization (SOPO), a multi-turn RL framework for robust hallucination detection. The key innovation of SOPO is a Socratic feedback mechanism, where a teacher model guides the reasoning trajectories during rollout by providing indirect hints inferred from the ground truth. This teacher-guided approach enables the model to generate more effective reasoning trajectories for hard examples, thus alleviating reward sparsity. Furthermore, we incorporate Turn-based Advantage Scaling to penalize verbosity bias, encouraging the model to develop efficient and autonomous reasoning capabilities. Empirical results on RAGTruth demonstrate that SOPO (4B) achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-5) and standard RL baselines, while obtaining higher reported mean scores than GRPO on four out-of-domain benchmarks, with mixed evidence against CAPO. This substantially advances agent execution and feedback control; task decomposition and solving are relevant to reasoning and composition, but the abstract does not establish a reasoning mechanism or compositional-generalization contribution.

    SolveBind 将分层验证求解与基于证据的运行时监督和恢复控制相结合，提升了 GUI 智能体在动态验证条件下完成任务的能力。这显著推进了智能体执行与反馈控制；任务分解和求解与推理及组合有关，但摘要并未确立推理机制或组合泛化方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents. We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion. Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints. We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision. A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities. A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets. Across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3-34.5 percentage points. It achieves the highest success rate on all six AndroidWorld backbones. In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks. With automatic submission, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage. Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7x and 2.4x their full-supervision values, respectively. These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success-cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.
