    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RoboCode learns reusable action primitives and a soft compositional representation, with evidence of code reuse across manipulation tasks; this is a substantial contribution to composition.     RoboCode 学习可复用动作原语和软组合表示，并提供跨操作任务复用编码的证据；这是对组合能力的重要贡献。其动作接口具有可解释性，但摘要没有描述对模型表示、推理或系统组织的机制分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent robot manipulation policies commonly predict continuous action chunks directly from observations, without explicitly modeling reusable structure in the action space. However, manipulation demonstrations often contain recurring short-horizon motion patterns that are shared across tasks. We introduce \textsc{RoboCode}, which learns these patterns through a shared soft-gated primitive action interface. Rather than assigning each action chunk to a single discrete code, \textsc{RoboCode} represents it as a soft composition of multiple learned primitives, providing a flexible intermediate representation of short-horizon actions. The primitive interface is learned from action chunks pooled across multiple tasks and then frozen while task-specific state encoders are trained to map current state inputs into the shared latent space. Experiments on five ManiSkill manipulation tasks address three questions. First, the learned primitive interface reconstructs action chunks with an average reconstruction MSE of 0.0187. Second, analysis of code activations reveals structured code reuse across tasks. Third, \textsc{RoboCode} achieves the highest or tied closed-loop success rate on all evaluated tasks, with an average success rate of 75.6%, compared with 68.8% for ACT and 41.6% for the larger Diffusion Policy baseline. These results suggest that soft-gated primitive codebooks provide an effective and interpretable intermediate action representation for robot manipulation.

    中文

    近期的机器人操作策略通常直接根据观测预测连续动作块，并不显式建模动作空间中的可复用结构。然而，操作演示通常包含跨任务共享的重复短时运动模式。我们推出 \textsc{RoboCode}，通过共享的软门控原语动作接口来学习这些模式。\textsc{RoboCode} 不会将每个动作块分配给单个离散编码，而是将其表示为多个已学习原语的软组合，从而为短时动作提供灵活的中间表示。该原语接口从多个任务汇集的动作块中学习得到，随后保持冻结，同时训练特定于任务的状态编码器，将当前状态输入映射到共享潜在空间。在五项 ManiSkill 操作任务上的实验探讨了三个问题。首先，学得的原语接口能够重建动作块，平均重建 MSE 为 0.0187。其次，对编码激活的分析揭示了跨任务的结构化编码复用。第三，\textsc{RoboCode} 在所有评估任务上的闭环成功率均为最高或并列最高，平均成功率为 75.6%；ACT 为 68.8%，规模更大的 Diffusion Policy 基线为 41.6%。这些结果表明，软门控原语码本能够为机器人操作提供有效且可解释的中间动作表示。

    MS-TTRL: Breaking the Frequency Conflict in Multiple-Solution Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

    MS-TTRL：打破多解测试时强化学习中的频率冲突

    Zhixia Zhang, Binqian Xu, Huaiyang Wang, Yikun Ban, Dianbo Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MS-TTRL develops a test-time reinforcement learning method that separates correctness estimation from diversity preservation and improves recovery on multiple-solution reasoning tasks. Its focus on reasoning and learning signals supports a strong Reasoning score, while the outcome cache and candidate states are supporting devices rather than a central systems contribution.

    MS-TTRL 提出一种测试时强化学习方法，将正确性估计与多样性保持分离，并提升了多解推理任务的恢复率。该方法聚焦推理与学习信号，因此推理方面的评分较高；结果缓存和候选状态则是辅助机制，并非核心系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific, engineering, and mathematical reasoning tasks can admit multiple valid solutions, while exhaustive annotation of the full solution set is often prohibitively costly. Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) applies reinforcement learning to unlabeled test instances, offering a label-free approach to multiple-solution reasoning. In this setting, generation frequency serves two opposing objectives: correctness estimation favors frequent outcomes, whereas outcome-level diversity preservation favors less frequent outcomes. We term this tension the \textbf{Frequency Conflict}. To resolve this conflict, we propose MS-TTRL, which obtains frequency-independent correctness estimates through Outcome-Level Self-Verification while reserving generation frequency solely for diversity preservation. Three-State Outcome Cache and the Candidate State support verification reuse across repeated observations and confidence-aware handling of ambiguous outcomes, while Confidence-Gated Inverse Probability Scaling selectively strengthens the learning signals of rare, reliably verified outcomes. Experiments across two benchmarks, four multiple-solution tasks, and three backbone models, each evaluated with five random seeds, show that MS-TTRL improves Recovery Rate by 19.13 percentage points on average over the best-performing label-free baseline and approaches the performance of the supervised IPS-GRPO.

    中文

    科学、工程和数学推理任务可能存在多个有效解，而对全部解进行穷尽式标注往往成本过高。测试时强化学习（TTRL）将强化学习应用于未标注的测试样例，为多解推理提供了一种无需标签的方法。在这一设置中，生成频率服务于两个相互对立的目标：正确性估计倾向于高频结果，而在结果层面保持多样性则倾向于低频结果。我们将这种张力称为 \textbf{频率冲突}。为解决这一冲突，我们提出 MS-TTRL，通过结果级自验证获得独立于频率的正确性估计，同时仅将生成频率用于保持多样性。三状态结果缓存和候选状态支持在重复观测之间复用验证结果，并以置信度感知的方式处理模糊结果；置信度门控的逆概率缩放则有选择地增强稀有且经过可靠验证的结果所提供的学习信号。在两个基准、四项多解任务和三个骨干模型上的实验（每项均采用五个随机种子评估）表明，与表现最佳的无标签基线相比，MS-TTRL 的恢复率平均提高 19.13 个百分点，并接近有监督 IPS-GRPO 的性能。

    Correct but Unselectable: The Hidden Interface Tax in Multi-Candidate Reasoning

    正确却无法被选中：多候选推理中隐蔽的接口代价

    Qianli Ma, Zhiqing Tang, Fanshuai Meng, Zhi Yao, Hanshuai Cui, Weijia Jia

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a selector compatibility bottleneck in multi-candidate reasoning and proposes CACC to improve how candidate answers are made usable, with mixed benchmark results. This gives substantive insight into reasoning performance, while its interface layer is a limited systems contribution; it does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文指出了多候选推理中的选择器兼容性瓶颈，并提出CACC来提高候选答案的可用性，但在不同基准上的结果不一。这为推理表现提供了有实质意义的见解，而其接口层属于有限的系统贡献；本文没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Small language models deployed under cost, latency, or privacy constraints cannot simply switch to larger models when reasoning fails. Multi-candidate generate-then-rerank offers a natural test-time scaling route. However, more candidates do not always yield higher accuracy. We identify a previously overlooked bottleneck between generation and selection: a correct answer may appear in the candidate pool yet fail to be selected because it is incomplete, unparseable, or misaligned with the answer mode the fixed selector expects. We term this loss the hidden interface tax and formalize a coverage-conversion decomposition that distinguishes raw oracle coverage from selectable coverage, the subset of problems where a correct candidate can actually be consumed by the selector. We propose Compatibility-Aware Candidate Construction (CACC), an interface layer between the candidate source and the fixed selector that repairs fragments, aligns answer modes, and removes selector-confusing noise without retraining either component. On numeric reasoning (GSM8K, competition_math), CACC raises both oracle coverage and final accuracy. On GPQA Diamond, CACC alone improves final accuracy from 5.6% to 19.2% (+13.6 pp); combined with proposer-side strengthening it reaches 25.8% (+20.2 pp). On MMLU-Pro, CACC exposes a coverage-conversion gap: answer-mode-compatible construction raises oracle coverage, but final accuracy decreases by 0.85 pp under the original selector; adding proposer-side strengthening improves final accuracy.

    中文

    在成本、延迟或隐私约束下部署的小型语言模型，在推理失败时无法简单切换到更大的模型。多候选生成后重排序提供了一种自然的测试时扩展途径。然而，候选数量增加并不总能带来更高准确率。我们发现了生成与选择之间一个此前被忽视的瓶颈：正确答案可能出现在候选池中，却因为不完整、无法解析，或与固定选择器所期待的答案模式不一致而未被选中。我们将这种损失称为隐蔽接口代价，并形式化提出覆盖率转换分解，用以区分原始预言机覆盖率与可选覆盖率；后者指正确候选实际上能够被选择器处理的问题子集。我们提出兼容性感知候选构造（CACC），作为候选来源与固定选择器之间的接口层，用于修补片段、对齐答案模式并去除会使选择器困惑的噪声，且无需重新训练任一组件。在数值推理任务（GSM8K、competition_math）上，CACC同时提高了预言机覆盖率和最终准确率。在GPQA Diamond上，仅使用CACC就将最终准确率从5.6%提高到19.2%（+13.6个百分点）；与提议器侧增强结合后，准确率达到25.8%（+20.2个百分点）。在MMLU-Pro上，CACC揭示了覆盖率转换差距：与答案模式兼容的构造提高了预言机覆盖率，但在原始选择器下，最终准确率下降了0.85个百分点；加入提议器侧增强后，最终准确率有所提高。

    BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization

    BiLoCo：用于训练后量化的二值低秩校正

    David Jin, Beshr IslamBouli, Tarushii Goel, Han Guo, Yoon Kim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BiLoCo contributes a binary low-rank correction and fused implementation that reduce quantization storage and inference overhead. Its focus is efficient model computation, a substantial Systems contribution; quantization accuracy alone does not provide evidence about internal representations, composition, or reasoning.

    BiLoCo提出了二值低秩校正及其融合实现，可降低量化存储需求和推理开销。本文聚焦于高效模型计算，是一项重要的系统贡献；仅有量化精度方面的结果，并不能为内部表征、组合或推理能力提供证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. On 4B--72B LLMs, BiLoCo matches or improves memory-matched SVDQuant for PTQ. We implement BiLoCo on B300 as a fused single kernel, where the FP4 GEMM runs on tensor cores, the bit-packed correction on the CUDA cores of the same launch, and the two are combined in the GEMM epilogue. With batch size $1$, the fused kernel is at most $11\%$ slower than the FP4-only GEMM for every rank up to $512$. At rank $128$, it is at most $20\%$ slower up to batch size $8$.

    中文

    将训练后量化（PTQ）至FP4已成为降低大型语言模型推理成本的一项关键技术，尤其适用于支持原生FP4张量核心的Blackwell GPU。然而，直接进行PTQ至FP4仍会造成明显的精度差距。近期的SVDQuant工作通过添加由SVD得到的高精度低秩校正，缓解了扩散模型中FP4量化引入的误差。然而，这种高精度低秩校正每个秩需要许多比特，并且运行在与主FP4 GEMM相同的张量核心上。我们提出BiLoCo，这是一种低秩校正方法，其左右因子存储为二进制 ${\{\pm 1\}}$符号向量，而非BF16数值。对于每个秩一分量，这种有符号格式所需的存储空间减少$16{\times}$，并且由于校正现在只包含加法和减法运算，因此可以在CUDA核心上与FP4张量核心GEMM并行运行。在4B--72B LLM上，BiLoCo在PTQ中的表现不逊于或优于内存占用相当的SVDQuant。我们在B300上将BiLoCo实现为一个融合的单内核：FP4 GEMM在张量核心上运行，位打包校正在同一次启动的CUDA核心上运行，二者在GEMM尾处理中合并。当批大小为$1$时，对于所有不超过$11\%$的秩，融合内核的速度最多比仅使用FP4的GEMM慢$512$。在秩为$128$时，对于不超过批大小$20\%$的情况，其速度最多慢$8$。

    Single-image 3D scene construction is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Recent methods such as SAM-3Dfy enable end-to-end reconstruction of 3D assets and their scene layouts, but still struggle with fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality. Meanwhile, specialized 3D object generators provide detailed object geometry, while 3D foundation models offer strong and generalizable spatial understanding. An RPF-based aligner then bridges these capabilities by establishing geometric correspondence between object-local meshes and partial scene pointmaps, recovering object layout for scene composition. Without requiring complete scene-level supervision, the proposed workflow consistently outperforms SAM-3Dfy across multiple geometric metrics on Scene-Maker and 3D-FUTURE200.     Zimu Wang, Xiaobo Wang, Siyu Ye, Jiaqi Li, Silin Chen, Yuling Shi, Ruobing Wang, Jingjing Zhang, Chaofan Wang, Kai Wu, Mengnan Qi, Kai Cai, Xiaodong Gu, Zilong Zheng

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and $\tau^3$ Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. The largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points, while method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. RSIHub provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies, inspectable candidate histories, and reusable components for developing new methods.

    PFIR trains 3D models to infer object function from parts before identifying the object, with a curriculum and dual-objective RL improving ambiguous and out-of-distribution recognition.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    3D MLLMs recognize objects via pattern matching, which fails when geometrically similar objects require functional reasoning to disambiguate (e.g., dresser vs. wardrobe). Our per-sample Geometric Confusion Score (GCS) exposes this failure: baseline accuracy is 33.7% on ModelNet40's most ambiguous 20% versus 84.0% on its least ambiguous 20%. We identify a function-as-annotation pattern, in which functional language decorates a known identity instead of supporting inference, and hypothesize that reversing this information flow should concentrate improvements on the most ambiguous samples. PFIR (Part-level Functional Inference for Recognition) reverses that flow. Built on PartNeXt part segmentation, its data pipeline produces 507K QA pairs with functional CoTs (geometry $\to$ function $\to$ identity), and its progressive curriculum culminates in dual-objective GRPO: strict functional reasoning and descriptive grounding for Objaverse's diverse distribution. The two RL objectives yield nearly orthogonal task vectors ($\cos = 0.056$), enabling composition via Task Arithmetic. Under a strict dual OOD protocol (Objaverse $\to$ ModelNet40; XYZRGB $\to$ XYZ-only), PFIR raises zero-shot accuracy from 60.5% to 66.7%, with gains concentrated $2.6\times$ more on geometrically ambiguous samples---supporting part-level functional reasoning as an effective route to more generalizable 3D recognition.     Zhiyong Cao, Hengjie Zhu, Yongxin Wang, Xuchen Li, Jintao Li, Shuxia Liu, Dunqiang Liu, Bo Wang, Kairan Zhang, Cong Lin, JiangDi Yu, Siyuan Liu, Sijia Yao, Yi-Liang Wei, Lingxu Ma, Aijia Wang, Anxin Chen, Zixian Wei, Xiang Ruan, Ruizhi Xu, Ruqian Shi, Baihua Xiao, Sicheng Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a transferable framework for evaluating agent harness reliability and attributing failures through execution traces and mechanism chains, making agent systems its main contribution. Task success involves problem solving, but the abstract focuses on harness evaluation rather than advancing reasoning capabilities.

    本文提出了一个可迁移的框架，通过执行轨迹和机制链评估智能体框架的可靠性并归因故障，因此主要贡献在智能体系统方面。任务成功涉及问题求解，但摘要关注的是框架评估，而非提升推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification. We construct 95 expert-level, mechanism-oriented tasks with executable or state-based ground truth to support semantically equivalent comparisons while preserving the native behavior of each harness. We design a Trajectory Tracing (TT) module to capture agent execution traces and introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separately assesses agent performance and harness reliability. In addition, we design a Multi-source Evidence Acquisition (MEA) module to provide evidence from the agent context, harness, and execution environment for LLM-based evaluation, and develop a Failure Attribution (FA) module that uses explicit mechanism chains to support attribution at the run level. Across 4 harnesses, 9 models, and 95 tasks, our evaluation of 3,420 runs yields macro-averaged harness scores ranging from 59.8% to 72.0%, while 31.1% of runs achieve task success despite failing at least one harness criterion. TraceTrial-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible foundation for comparing agent harnesses, diagnosing their failures, and studying how harness design interacts with model behavior.

    Shan Peng, Shuaiqi Cheng, Miao Peng, Chenyi Zi, Jia Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DMAIC-Bench tests whether agents use intermediate evidence to choose whether to proceed, redirect, or stop, and finds frequent continuation despite disqualifying results. This directly evaluates evidence-dependent decision-making, while its workflow benchmark offers only limited insight into composition and agent organization.

    DMAIC-Bench检验智能体是否会利用中间证据来决定继续、转向还是停止，并发现即使结果已不允许继续，智能体仍经常继续执行。本文直接评估了依赖证据的决策；其工作流基准对组合和智能体组织方式只能提供有限见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma's explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public.

    中文

    多阶段分析任务要求LLM智能体利用中间证据来决定继续、转向还是停止。智能体对自身输出进行批判的自我反思已得到广泛研究，但批判本身并不能说明证据是否改变了下一步行动。我们将这种能力称为自我克制。现有智能体基准大多衡量任务完成情况或输出质量，却没有对此进行检验。DMAIC-Bench围绕精益六西格玛明确的统计前置条件，在四个行业的15个案例中构建了97项带种子的任务，用于评估这一能力。配对的反事实变体要求在工作流的同一位置采取相反行动，以区分有依据的克制与不加区分地停止。我们使用私有评分器评估执行轨迹，并通过独立专家审查最终结论。在来自六家提供商的13个模型中，执行层面的路由准确率在匹配的GO决策上平均为92%，在NO-GO决策上平均为19%；任何被禁止的后续计算都计为路由错误。执行轨迹显示，智能体会先报告正确诊断，再进行这些结果已不允许的分析。另外，对11个接受审计的智能体进行盲法专家审查后估计，报告在已经到达的NO-GO决策中，有47%依据无效证据采取行动，区间为31%至61%。明确允许停止有助于某些模型，但无法始终让模型在GO和NO-GO两类分支上都恢复正确决策。在批量核糖核酸测序（RNA-seq）和病例对照全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中进行的16项生命科学任务表明，同一框架也能评估工业工作流之外依赖证据的决策。项目代码和数据见：https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public。

    ENGLISH

    Multi-step retrosynthesis requires recursively transforming a target molecule through successive reaction steps into purchasable building blocks, and recent work has begun to draw on large language model (LLM) reasoning to tackle the task. In its latest evolution, LLM reasoning has entered the long-horizon regime: models pursue objectives across interdependent steps, interact with environments, and adapt to feedback. This shift has markedly advanced LLM capabilities, as illustrated by breakthroughs in AI-driven mathematical research. At this frontier, we introduce Solvent, an 8B LLM that successfully extends long-horizon reasoning to multi-step retrosynthesis. Through a two-round post-training curriculum, Solvent learns to interleave iterative synthesis planning, external availability verification, and adaptive route revision. Experiments show that, following a $2.1\times$ performance boost from RL, Solvent scores 61.86% across four benchmarks, surpassing mid-scale language models and prior search-based retrosynthesis systems, and rivaling frontier trillion-parameter LLMs.

    Zhibo Hu, Chen Wang, Yanfeng Shu, Liming Dong, Hye-young Paik, Liming Zhu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a transferable account of language-model failures using representation geometry, readout relationships, and causal interventions, supporting a strong mechanistic interpretability score. Its focus is perturbation sensitivity rather than reasoning capability, and the abstract provides no substantive connection to composition or model systems.

    本文利用表征几何、读出关系和因果干预，提出一种可迁移的语言模型失效解释，有力支持了较高的机制可解释性评分。论文重点关注扰动敏感性，而非推理能力；摘要也没有实质性涉及组合性或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Why can a task-preserving rewrite turn a correct answer into a failure while a larger internal change leaves the answer intact? We develop a direction-sensitive, readout-relative account of semantic fragility: heterogeneous language changes can share geometric and readout relationships without sharing an input-independent failure direction. Clean decision reserve, representation transformation, and response alignment provide complementary descriptions of this process. An exact longitudinal-transverse decomposition identifies directional information discarded by scalar transmission. A compact reserve-and-transmission model predicts failures across held-out families and items in Qwen3-32B and Gemma 4 31B, with useful but parameterization-dependent transfer to ReClor. Matched interventions show that orientation carries causal information beyond scalar geometry. Among naturally failed rewrites, attention-component tests on disjoint original items and subsequent answer-order controls favor the natural paired direction over tested random and same-answer-letter donor directions. Yet failures rarely persist across option orders, and current-order corrections use recomputed clean references. Shared predictive regularity thus coexists with context-dependent directional effects. Numerical path integration reduces, but does not eliminate, finite-patch approximation error within a fixed context; a larger discrepancy from the natural rewrite effect remains. A complementary fixed-CoT cue study extends this account to influence unacknowledged in recorded reasoning: readout associations transfer across domains, although the positive-mean causal criterion fails and signed-effect prediction remains post hoc. Together, these results support shared relations among reserve, transformation, and response while distinguishing local causal sensitivity from a complete explanation of natural failure.

    中文

    为什么保留任务的改写会让正确答案变成错误答案，而更大的内部变化却能让答案保持不变？我们提出一种方向敏感、相对于读出的语义脆弱性解释：不同类型的语言变化可以具有共同的几何关系和读出关系，而不必共享一个与输入无关的失效方向。干净决策余量、表征变换和响应对齐从不同角度描述了这一过程。精确的纵向—横向分解识别出标量传递所丢弃的方向信息。一个紧凑的余量—传递模型能够预测 Qwen3-32B 和 Gemma 4 31B 在留出类别和样本上的失效，并能迁移到 ReClor，但效果良好程度取决于参数化方式。匹配干预表明，方向信息除标量几何之外还携带因果信息。在自然改写导致失效的样本中，对不相交原始样本进行的注意力组件测试以及后续的答案顺序控制，支持自然配对方向，而非所测试的随机方向和答案字母相同的供体方向。然而，失效很少会在选项顺序改变后持续存在；对当前顺序的纠正使用了重新计算的干净参考。因此，共同的预测规律与依赖上下文的方向效应并存。数值路径积分降低了固定上下文中有限片段近似带来的误差，但没有将其消除；与自然改写效应之间仍存在更大的差异。一项互补的固定 CoT 线索研究将这一解释扩展到记录推理中未被明确承认的影响：读出关联可以跨领域迁移，尽管正均值因果标准未能成立，而且对有符号效应的预测仍属事后分析。总之，这些结果支持余量、变换和响应之间存在共同关系，同时将局部因果敏感性与对自然失效的完整解释区分开来。

Published rules that compare runs with and without a skill retire on the gain alone. We instead withhold the skill, score the model on a task synthesized from it, and trust a high unaided score only when another model gains from the skill, since nearly half of high scores come from tasks no model benefits from. Under four models, a published gain rule applied with one task per skill removes over half of the uncovered skills. We release 1,251 skills with tasks and item scores under four models.

    LLM 智能体会从公共技能库中检索技能，这些技能库最多可容纳约 100,000 条目，并服务于许多模型。随着模型不断改进，技能库必须找出特定模型已经内化的技能（即该模型无需这些技能也能完成任务），并针对该模型将这些技能退役；然而，目前尚无已知可靠性得到验证的内化程度衡量方法。已发表的规则通过比较使用和不使用某项技能时的运行结果，仅依据增益决定是否退役。当技能已被内化时，增益接近于零；而当模型和技能都无法提供相应能力时，增益同样接近于零，我们将后一种状态称为未覆盖。我们改为暂不提供该技能，让模型完成由该技能合成的任务；只有当另一个模型能从该技能中获益时，我们才相信模型在无辅助情况下取得的高分，因为接近一半的高分来自没有任何模型能从技能中获益的任务。在四个模型上，将已发表的增益规则用于每项技能仅一个任务时，会移除一半以上未覆盖的技能。在 SkillsBench 上，31 项退役决定中有 28 项依据的是没有任何一次运行能完全通过的探测任务；而依据无辅助得分进行退役则未造成可检测到的奖励损失。与增益规则相比，无辅助判定在不同任务间更常复现（Cohen's kappa 为 0.42，对比 0.23），但在不同模型间有所差异，因此技能库必须按模型分别解读判定结果。我们发布了 1,251 项技能，以及在四个模型上对应的任务和逐项得分。

    从视觉亲和度到多模态强化学习中的学习信用分配

    Yuhang Han, Dingning Liu, Yujie Chen, Yaojie Zhang, Jingwei Song, Zequn Yang, Xuanming Shang, Li Ding, Zhijiang Guo, Linfeng Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces outcome-conditioned token credit assignment for multimodal RL, using visual evidence and reward outcomes to improve reasoning updates. Its contribution substantially advances reasoning training; visual representations are inputs to the method, with no claim about internal representation mechanisms or system design.

    本文提出一种结果条件化的多模态 RL token 信用分配方法，利用视觉证据和奖励结果改进推理更新。其贡献实质性地推动了推理训练；视觉表征是方法的输入，论文没有声称研究了内部表征机制或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves multimodal reasoning, but uniformly assigning a single response-level advantage to all tokens overlooks the distinct roles of visual observations and subsequent reasoning. Visual affinity alone is insufficient: predictive states may align with both image and prompt-context representations, and upweighting valid visual observations can amplify their negative-advantage updates when later reasoning fails. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{Outcome-Conditioned Visual Credit (OVC)}, a plug-in framework that separates visual-association measurement from token-level credit assignment and is adaptable to policy-optimization methods with uniform response-level advantage allocation. Relative Visual Encoding constructs a context-relative visual coordinate by contrasting each predictive state's affinity to image and prompt-context representations. Outcome-conditioned Evidence Calibration combines this coordinate with uncertainty-scaled predictive features and calibrates their contributions to outcome-discriminative evidence through mean contrasts between positive- and negative-advantage responses, scaled by regularized within-side variation. Visual association thus informs credit through observed outcome differences rather than directly determining update priority. Normalized Credit Allocation conditions the calibrated evidence on the response's advantage sign to produce positive token weights with unit global mean. These detached weights preserve advantage signs while modulating individual token-gradient contributions. OVC reuses existing rollouts without auxiliary reward models, process annotations, or inference-time modules. Instantiated through GSPO-token, OVC retains sequence-level clipping and consistently improves six-benchmark mean accuracy over GSPO across three models, with gains of 1.86-2.39 percentage points.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升多模态推理能力，但将单一的响应级优势统一分配给所有 token，会忽视视觉观测与后续推理各自不同的作用。仅凭视觉亲和度并不足够：预测状态可能同时与图像表征和提示上下文表征对齐；如果后续推理失败，提高有效视觉观测的权重反而可能放大它们在负优势下的更新。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textbf{结果条件化视觉信用分配（OVC）}，一种插件式框架，将视觉关联度量与 token 级信用分配分开，并可适配采用统一响应级优势分配的策略优化方法。相对视觉编码通过对比每个预测状态与图像表征和提示上下文表征的亲和度，构造相对于上下文的视觉坐标。结果条件化证据校准将该坐标与按不确定性缩放的预测特征相结合，并通过正优势响应与负优势响应之间的均值对比，校准这些特征对结果判别性证据的贡献，再以经正则化的组内变异进行缩放。因此，视觉关联是通过观测到的结果差异来影响信用分配，而非直接决定更新优先级。归一化信用分配根据响应的优势符号对校准后的证据进行条件化，生成全局均值为 1 的正 token 权重。这些脱离梯度计算的权重保留优势符号，同时调节各个 token 梯度的贡献。OVC 复用已有的 rollout，无需辅助奖励模型、过程标注或推理时模块。通过 GSPO-token 实例化后，OVC 保留序列级裁剪，并在三个模型上持续提升相较于 GSPO 的六基准平均准确率，提升幅度为 1.86–2.39 个百分点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Music-driven group dance generation must decide not only how each dancer moves, but also what formation the group should form, when it should change, and who should execute each transition. Existing methods can generate orderly and rhythmically synchronized group motion, but remain limited in formation evolution and inter-dancer interaction. In human choreography, formation transitions often align with changes in high-level musical structure, such as the progression from an introduction to a chorus or from a chorus to a climax. We present ChoreoStudio, which makes choreography planning explicit. A music disentangler first decomposes the audio into frame-level rhythmic features and segment-level structural features. Given the segment-level features and sparse labels, a frozen omni-modal model acts as a scriptwriter, producing a global semantic description that guides the Director's choreography planning. Based on this context, the Director produces three coupled interaction decisions: a centroid-relative point set specifies what formation to produce, a transition gate determines when it should change, and a mobility allocation indicates who should execute the transition. The transition gate and mobility allocation are further conditioned on the planned geometric change, coupling formation targets with their temporal and dancer-specific execution. At a finer temporal scale, frame-aligned music features condition the diffusion generator to control detailed body motion and preserve beat-level alignment. The segment-level interaction plan is injected in parallel through frame-aligned instruction tokens and cross-dancer attention biases, coordinating how the generator realizes each transition. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChoreoStudio follows the planned interactions while achieving state-of-the-art performance in motion quality, group organization, and formation dynamics.

    音乐驱动的群舞生成不仅要决定每位舞者如何移动，还必须决定群体要形成什么队形、何时变换队形，以及由谁执行每次转换。现有方法可以生成整齐且与节奏同步的群体动作，但在队形演变和舞者间互动方面仍有局限。在人类编舞中，队形转换常与较高层次的音乐结构变化相契合，例如从引子进入副歌，或从副歌推进到高潮。我们提出 ChoreoStudio，将编舞规划显式化。音乐解缠器首先将音频分解为帧级节奏特征和片段级结构特征。给定片段级特征和稀疏标签，一个冻结的全模态模型充当编剧，生成引导 Director 进行编舞规划的全局语义描述。基于这一上下文，Director 会产生三项相互耦合的互动决策：相对于质心的点集指定要生成什么队形，转换门控决定何时变换队形，移动性分配则指明由谁执行转换。转换门控和移动性分配还以规划好的几何变化为条件，从而将队形目标与其时间安排及具体舞者的执行相耦合。在更精细的时间尺度上，与帧对齐的音乐特征对扩散生成器进行条件化，以控制细致的身体动作并保持节拍级对齐。片段级互动规划还通过与帧对齐的指令 token 和跨舞者注意力偏置并行注入，从而协调生成器如何实现每次转换。在 AIOZ-GDance 上的实验表明，ChoreoStudio 能够遵循规划的互动，同时在动作质量、群体组织和队形动态方面达到最先进的性能。

    Junlin He, Junzhang Zhu, Yudong Li, Yihong Tang, Xuefeng Jiang, Wei Ma, Chengxiang Zhuo, Zang Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TGR-EvoDAG contributes a multi-agent system for evolving recommendation pipelines, with DAG-based branching and merging, cost-aware planning, and downstream co-adaptation. Automated algorithm search is relevant to problem-solving, but the abstract emphasizes system design and application-specific gains rather than general reasoning or compositional generalization.

    TGR-EvoDAG 提出了一个用于演化推荐流水线的多智能体系统，包含基于 DAG 的分支与合并、成本感知规划和下游协同适配。自动算法搜索与问题求解有关，但摘要强调的是系统设计和特定应用的收益，而非通用推理或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution for algorithm discovery. However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a dilemma: general-purpose frameworks lack domain-specific feedback, while recommender-specific frameworks rely on linear evolution. Crucially, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). Unlike end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded pipeline (tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). In this paradigm, existing evolution methods suffer from: i) cost blindness, squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation, discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. To bridge these gaps, we propose TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for GR. TGR-EvoDAG models code evolution as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to maintain multiple evolution branches and merge complementary innovations, unifying advanced search with rich GR diagnostic feedback. We further introduce stage-aware cost planning to optimize GPU-hour budgets, and active downstream co-adaptation to navigate temporary regressions and unlock cross-stage gains. On public Amazon datasets, TGR-EvoDAG enables the first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline, improving offline metrics by up to 37.4% and Agent4Rec simulated user satisfaction by 19.7% over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, in industrial deployment on Tencent's large-scale commercial media platform, the evolved GR achieves a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and a statistically significant 0.40% increase in online click-through rate (CTR).

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体推动了用于算法发现的自动代码演化。然而，当前面向序列推荐的递归自我改进（RSI）研究面临两难：通用框架缺乏领域专属反馈，而推荐系统专用框架则依赖线性演化。关键在于，将两者简单整合后应用于生成式推荐（GR）会失败。与端到端模型不同，GR 依赖模块级联流水线（分词、预训练和对齐）。在这一范式下，现有演化方法存在以下问题：i）忽视成本，未考虑各阶段不对称的再训练开销，导致预算浪费；ii）评估短视，丢弃上游有前景的创新，因为这些创新在下游适配前可能暂时导致指标下降。为弥补这些不足，我们提出专为 GR 设计的多智能体代码演化框架 TGR-EvoDAG。TGR-EvoDAG 将代码演化建模为有向无环图（DAG），以维护多个演化分支并合并互补创新，从而将高级搜索与丰富的 GR 诊断反馈相结合。我们还引入阶段感知成本规划以优化 GPU 小时预算，以及主动的下游协同适配，以应对暂时性退化并释放跨阶段收益。在公开的 Amazon 数据集上，TGR-EvoDAG 实现了首个完整 GR 流水线的自主演化；与最强基线相比，离线指标最高提升 37.4%，Agent4Rec 模拟用户满意度提升 19.7%。此外，在腾讯大型商业媒体平台的工业部署中，演化后的 GR 离线 Hit@1 相对提升 12.16%，在线点击率（CTR）提升 0.40%，且具有统计显著性。

Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

    The paper proposes claim-level measures of convergence, exploration, and retention to study how information flows through multi-agent LLM interactions, finding strategy-dependent tradeoffs.     本文提出趋同、探索和保留这三项主张级度量，用于研究多智能体 LLM 交互中的信息流，并发现不同策略之间存在权衡。这直接推动了对智能体交互和协调的评估，但并未确立推理机制或组合泛化；单纯追踪主张不属于机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When LLM-powered agents interact, information is repeatedly shared, expanded, and forgotten, yet multi-agent evaluation typically focuses on final task outcomes. We study such interaction as claim-level information dynamics and propose RIVER, which decomposes agent outputs into atomic claims and evaluates three complementary dimensions: convergence, exploration, and retention. Convergence captures cross-agent claim correspondence and stance alignment; exploration captures semantic breadth and extension beyond the source; and retention tracks source preservation and the persistence of new claims across stages and lineages. We evaluate five interaction strategies on 40 controlled news-generation cases. Repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, whereas distributed relay yields broader, less shared information. Further comparisons show that method-specific constraints increase exploration while weakening convergence and retention. Our findings suggest that collective information dynamics are better explained by underlying information-flow mechanisms than by simple downstream performance.

    Yeonju Kim, Bella Godiva, Se Jin Park, Yong Man Ro

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper diagnoses long-horizon failure in full-duplex speech models and tests KV-anchor pinning and repetition penalties to reduce collapse. The identified mechanisms give partial insight into model behavior (MechInterp 3), while sustained conversation is a systems contribution (Systems 4); conversation alone does not establish compositional or reasoning advances.

    本文诊断全双工语音模型的长时程失效，并测试固定 KV 锚点和重复惩罚，以减少崩溃。所识别的机制对模型行为提供了部分见解（MechInterp 3），而维持持续对话则属于系统方面的贡献（Systems 4）；仅研究对话并不能证明在组合能力或推理方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at the same time, which makes them promising for natural, open-ended conversation. But can they sustain a coherent conversation for tens of minutes? Because they generate a token every frame, even while listening, they exhaust their context windows within minutes. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate only single turns or a few conversational rounds, too short to expose the long-horizon problem. We introduce the Full-Duplex Long-Horizon Benchmark (FD-LHB), which tests five recent full-duplex models on long replayed conversations and in live conversation with an LLM partner. Every evaluated model eventually either degrades or exhausts its context. Models that keep the full history often degrade before their context runs out, while sliding-window models still fall into repetition, silence, and gibberish. For sliding-window models, we identify two contributing mechanisms. Gibberish and silence are linked to Initialization-Anchor Eviction, where the sliding window discards the first KV entry. Repetition is also reinforced by the model's own recent outputs. Guided by this diagnosis, we apply two simple fixes: Initialization-Anchor Pinning (IAP) keeps that first entry, and Duplex Repetition Penalty (DRP) discourages echoing while guarding against prolonged silence. Together, they support the diagnosis and, without retraining, substantially reduce conversational collapse in replays of up to an hour while running in real time.

    Bangjun Xiao, Chiheng Lou, Xiaodong Ji, Xiangwei Deng, Yikai Zhao, Gang Huang, Hailin Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    KnitTrans coordinates trajectory admission and data transfer to reduce staleness and training latency in LLM reinforcement learning. Its algorithmic contribution is primarily a systems advance; improved learning quality is an outcome, with no substantive reasoning or compositional mechanism analyzed.

    KnitTrans 协调轨迹纳入和数据传输，以降低 LLM 强化学习中的陈旧度和训练延迟。其算法贡献主要是系统方面的进展；学习质量提升是其结果，没有实质性分析推理或组合机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Trajectory transfer from rollout to training affects both learning quality and system efficiency in large language model reinforcement learning (RL). Enforcing batch-wide training requirements can delay the admission of completed trajectories, resulting in higher architectural staleness: the additional parameter-version gap from disaggregated pipelining relative to colocated execution. Beyond admission, misalignment between data access and training consumption causes redundant movement and unnecessary waiting when transferring large trajectory payloads. We present KnitTrans, a system that coordinates the rollout-to-training path through three designs. First, constraint-preserving mini-batch admission allows flexibility in early mini-batch composition, while checking that enough capacity remains to satisfy the remaining quotas. Second, on-demand trajectory data access matches storage units to consumer assignments and overlaps micro-batch data preparation with computation. Third, multimodal encoding deduplication supports reuse across a mini-batch while preserving gradient contributions from all backbone micro-batches. Experiments show up to 93% lower architectural staleness than with train-batch admission, narrowing the learning-quality gap between disaggregated execution and colocated execution. On multimodal workloads, KnitTrans reduces transfer latency by two orders of magnitude and achieves a speedup of up to 5.8 times in transfer plus training over the baseline.

    轨迹从 rollout 阶段传输到训练阶段，会同时影响大型语言模型强化学习（RL）的学习质量和系统效率。强制执行整个批次范围的训练要求，可能会延迟已完成轨迹的纳入，从而导致更高的架构陈旧度：相较于共置执行，分离式流水线所带来的额外参数版本差距。除纳入时机外，数据访问与训练消费之间的不匹配，会在传输大型轨迹负载时造成重复搬运和不必要的等待。我们提出 KnitTrans，一个通过三项设计协调整个 rollout 到训练路径的系统。第一，保留约束的微批次纳入机制允许灵活安排早期微批次的组成，同时检查是否仍留有足够容量以满足剩余配额。第二，按需访问轨迹数据，使存储单元与消费者分配相匹配，并将微批次数据准备与计算重叠进行。第三，多模态编码去重支持在一个微批次内复用编码，同时保留所有骨干网络微批次的梯度贡献。实验表明，与训练批次纳入方式相比，架构陈旧度最多降低 93%，缩小了分离式执行与共置执行之间的学习质量差距。在多模态工作负载上，KnitTrans 将传输延迟降低两个数量级，并使传输加训练相较于基线实现最高 5.8 倍的加速。

    Recursive large language model (LLM) agents solve long-horizon tasks through decomposition, execution, and environmental feedback. Yet after producing an atomic subtask, they often invoke the same large model again to translate a familiar instruction into an executable action. We observe that high-level planning is task-specific, whereas leaf-level action grounding recurs across tasks and can be checked against environment-admitted actions. We introduce LeafSkill, an external reuse layer that retrieves semantically related grounding experience, binds action templates to current objects and admissible actions, and uses a lightweight 1.7B selector to choose a bound action or defer the unchanged subtask to the original agent. Skills remain outside the model parameters, allowing a frozen selector to use post-training additions. Under lexical and syntactic paraphrases, exact matching retrieves none of the reference actions, while semantic retrieval preserves 96.0% and 97.0% candidate coverage; the frozen selector adopts 97.34% of unseen skill types. On an independent confirmation set of 200 Robotouille tasks, LeafSkill completes 137 tasks versus 121 for ReCAP (68.5% vs. 60.5%, exact McNemar p=.0259). On the 106 tasks completed by both, it reduces Qwen3.5-27B tokens by 14.42% and calls by 14.08%. A separate held-out repeat yields a consistent 9.0-point success gain and 18.98% token reduction.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-evaluation. Experiments on tabular VQA benchmarks demonstrate that Self-RefineVQA yields consistent accuracy gains in monolingual and cross-lingual understanding, with a particularly significant boost for small models, enabling lightweight models (e.g., 2B-7B parameters) to rival the performance of significantly larger counterparts. Furthermore, we provide a comparative complexity analysis demonstrating that while inference cost increases linearly, our framework offers superior data efficiency and a lower cumulative cost by eliminating the prohibitive annotation bottleneck of human labeling required for fine-tuning. Our results highlight the potential of prompt-based self-improvement as a scalable, accessible paradigm for reliable table reasoning in VLMs.

    The paper introduces a controlled benchmark and process metric for agents handling asynchronous results, replanning, and task-state changes, and finds substantial reliability gaps.     本文提出一个受控基准和过程指标，用于评估智能体如何处理异步结果、重规划和任务状态变化，并发现了显著的可靠性缺口。这是对智能体执行与评估的有力贡献，而组合与推理只是基准中涉及的次要方面。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute tasks asynchronously: a main agent continues working while its subagents run, and the task state may change before their results arrive. The main agent must decide which work to update or preserve and which checks to repeat, while avoiding prohibited changes. Final task success alone does not reveal whether these results were handled correctly, and natural asynchronous arrivals are hard to reproduce. We introduce Async-RBench, a benchmark for asynchronous task execution in LLM agents, with 200 executable tasks covering eight scenarios. A scenario controller regulates result delivery using predefined task-state conditions, while an Event Response Contract (ERC) specifies what each response must change, preserve, avoid, and re-verify. The Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) weights the response process and outcome equally and is reported separately from task success. We evaluate nine agents and find DRS scores of 19.2 to 45.1, with the lowest scores on duplicate reports and subagent failures. Under our execution protocol, all nine agents obtain lower task success with asynchronous than with batched delivery (26.0% vs. 29.7% on average). For three agents, prompting the main agent to rebuild its plan after every result improves DRS by only 2.6 to 3.5 points. Together, these findings highlight the challenges of reliable asynchronous task execution and the need to evaluate how agents handle incoming results alongside end-to-end task success.

    大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地以异步方式执行任务：主智能体在子智能体运行期间继续工作，而任务状态可能在子智能体结果返回前发生变化。主智能体必须判断哪些工作需要更新或保留，以及哪些检查需要重做，同时避免被禁止的更改。仅凭最终任务是否成功，无法判断这些结果是否得到正确处理；而自然发生的异步结果难以复现。我们提出 Async-RBench，这是一个用于评估 LLM 智能体异步任务执行能力的基准，包含 200 个可执行任务，覆盖八种场景。场景控制器根据预定义的任务状态条件控制结果交付，而事件响应契约（ERC）规定每次响应必须更改、保留、避免和重新验证哪些内容。动态重规划分数（DRS）对响应过程和结果赋予同等权重，并与任务成功率分开报告。我们评估了九个智能体，发现其 DRS 分数为 19.2 至 45.1，在重复报告和子智能体故障场景中的分数最低。根据我们的执行协议，所有九个智能体在异步交付下的任务成功率都低于批量交付（平均为 26.0% 对比 29.7%）。对于三个智能体，提示主智能体在每次收到结果后重建计划，DRS 也仅提高了 2.6 至 3.5 分。总体而言，这些发现凸显了可靠异步任务执行所面临的挑战，也表明有必要在评估端到端任务成功率的同时，评估智能体如何处理传入结果。

    The paper develops martingale-based stopping conditions that preserve the expected GRPO gradient while reducing covariance, then applies event-guided truncation to VLA reinforcement learning.     本文提出基于鞅的停止条件，在保持 GRPO 梯度期望的同时降低协方差，随后将事件引导截断应用于 VLA 强化学习。这对推理相关的训练与优化有重要贡献；VLM 定位和动作反馈并未提供实质性的模型机制洞见或通用系统洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A failed vision-language-action (VLA) rollout does not imply that every action contributed to failure. Yet in group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), a single trajectory-level advantage is assigned to all actions in a rollout. Potentially useful recovery attempts can thus be penalized alongside the errors they aim to correct. Ideal stopping conditions for failure feedback are characterized using success-probability and policy-score martingales. At these stops, the removed gradient contribution has zero conditional expectation given the retained information. Truncation therefore preserves the expectation of a reference GRPO group-gradient estimator and can reduce its covariance. One such stop occurs when the conditional probability of success is zero, motivating error and recovery cues for selecting candidate feedback boundaries. Martingale GRPO (MART-GRPO) is introduced with a vision-language model (VLM) for event-guided truncation. The VLM is fine-tuned on our annotated training set using low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The last visible error without observed recovery is localized by the frozen VLM in complete rollout videos. Failure feedback is retained through the selected error interval and removed afterward, while successful-rollout loss terms and original loss normalization are preserved. For retrospective boundaries, changes in expectation and variance are analyzed to assess departures from ideal stopping. Experiments with OpenVLA-OFT on RoboTwin 2.0 show that MART-GRPO improves success rates over full-trajectory GRPO across multiple tasks.

    视觉语言动作（VLA）轨迹执行失败，并不意味着每个动作都导致了失败。然而，在组相对策略优化（GRPO）中，单个轨迹级优势会分配给一次轨迹执行中的所有动作。因此，可能有用的恢复尝试也会和它们试图纠正的错误一起受到惩罚。我们利用成功概率鞅和策略得分鞅刻画失败反馈的理想停止条件。在这些停止点，被移除的梯度贡献在给定保留信息的条件下期望为零。因此，截断能够保持一个参考 GRPO 组梯度估计量的期望，并可能降低其协方差。当成功的条件概率为零时，就是这样一个停止点；这启发我们使用错误和恢复线索来选择候选反馈边界。我们提出 Martingale GRPO（MART-GRPO），并使用视觉语言模型（VLM）实现事件引导的截断。VLM 使用我们的标注训练集和低秩适配（LoRA）进行微调。在完整的轨迹视频中，冻结的 VLM 会定位最后一个可见且之后未观察到恢复的错误。失败反馈会保留到选定的错误区间结束，此后予以移除，同时保留成功轨迹的损失项和原始损失归一化方式。对于回溯确定的边界，我们分析期望和方差的变化，以评估其偏离理想停止条件的程度。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上使用 OpenVLA-OFT 进行的实验表明，与完整轨迹 GRPO 相比，MART-GRPO 在多个任务上提升了成功率。

From the same repository budget, Poseidon extracts nearly 10 times as many training environments as a prior approach by decomposing scientific workflows into four complementary task types: Reproduction, Subflow, Completion, and Correction, where each type targets a distinct capability for scientific research.     While large vision-language models excel at optical character recognition, it remains unclear how their underlying vision encoders process text and its meaning, and whether they support anything resembling reading comprehension. We systematically study transformer-based vision encoders, using cross-modal alignment between rendered text and visual concepts together with probing and retrieval-based analyses as a controlled window into these broader capabilities. Our layer-wise analyses span orthographic, grammatical, and semantic organization, and reveal that strong cross-modal mapping emerges only in the deepest layers, after unimodal object and text recognition have already developed, coinciding with a progression from surface-level to semantic representations.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PILOT’s main contribution is a training framework that treats reasoning traces as latent variables and uses relational evidence to explore and transfer more useful traces for multimodal retrieval. This directly advances reasoning training, while embedding composition and the use of an MLLM are incidental to the abstract’s contribution.

    PILOT 的主要贡献是一种训练框架，它将推理轨迹视为潜变量，并利用关系证据探索和转移更有用的轨迹，以进行多模态检索。这直接推动了推理训练的发展；嵌入组合以及使用 MLLM 与摘要中的主要贡献并无直接关系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have driven substantial progress in multimodal embeddings. Recent methods exploit generative capabilities by augmenting embedded inputs with self-generated reasoning to produce more informative embeddings. However, conventional retrieval supervision for training embedding models specifies pairwise relevance relations without explicitly guiding the reasoning used for input augmentation. Such reasoning is neither directly observed nor uniquely determined by the input, allowing multiple plausible traces to introduce semantic cues of varying retrieval utility. Existing approaches largely optimize reasoning conditioned on the input alone, limiting the exploration of retrieval-relevant traces. We introduce PILOT, a framework that models reasoning as a latent variable and instantiates its prior and posterior distributions as distinct reasoning modes of a shared MLLM. The prior conditions only on the input, whereas the posterior uses additional training-time relational evidence to guide reasoning exploration. To translate the posterior's broader exploration into inference-time improvements, we derive an importance-weighted variational objective and instantiate it as a prior-posterior co-evolution framework that improves both modes under a shared inference-compatible reward while selectively transferring posterior trajectories to the prior according to their utility and prior reachability. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, PILOT outperforms the primary baseline across all 12 task groups at both 2B and 7B parameters, improving overall scores by 3.2 and 3.3 points, respectively, with the largest gains in visual-document retrieval (+6.1 and +6.4 points). Our results show that relational supervision is most valuable not as a post-hoc reward but as a signal for shaping how reasoning is explored in training reasoning-enhanced embedding models.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly support long-horizon tasks by leveraging external memory and past experience. However, existing agents mainly retrieve records or summaries, lacking the ability to form and refine causal understanding of the world. Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet, an agent that develops and updates causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition. For each task, CauProphet combines relevant knowledge in Causal Cognition with current evidence to construct a Causal Belief, a structured belief capturing causal factors and the effects of possible actions. It uses this belief for decision-making and continuously updates both the belief and Causal Cognition as new observations emerge, enabling causal knowledge that persists beyond individual experiences. Evaluations demonstrate that CauProphet progressively acquires causal knowledge and transfers it to future decision-making. In financial research, CauProphet leverages prior discoveries to improve downstream analyses and outperforms all baselines in mean rank correlation with next-day returns, achieving a 25.4% improvement over a baseline agent. It also improves prediction accuracy from 21.3% to 28.6% in dynamic real-world settings. Further experiments validate its ability to perform reliable causal analysis and action selection across scientific and everyday tasks, demonstrating the potential of causal experience learning for next-generation LLM agents.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces measures for evaluating how execution harnesses interact with models and benchmarks, based on 52,168 trajectories.     本文基于 52,168 条轨迹，提出一组指标来评估执行框架如何与模型及基准交互。这对智能体和执行框架评估作出了重要贡献，而规划和工具使用只是基准中的测试场景，并非推理机制方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness's overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model-harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories. Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel. These findings support evaluating model-harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.

    Deploying Vision-Language Models for video anomaly detection confronts a fundamental constraint. Their semantic reasoning demands computational budgets incompatible with the scale of real-world video streams. We present Signal-Aware Adaptive Fusion (SAAF), a framework that achieves efficient zero-shot anomaly detection through three key innovations. First, we introduce a dual-signal adaptive sampler operating in semantic embedding space: a delta signal captures sudden events via frame-to-frame cosine distance, while a drift signal detects static and gradual anomalies through deviation from rolling temporal context. Their OR-gated combination with adaptive EMA-based thresholding provides comprehensive anomaly coverage without training data. Second, we propose a threshold-gated cascaded architecture where lightweight frame-level scoring precedes expensive video-level temporal analysis, invoking it only when confidence warrants additional context. Third, we design a signal-aware weighted fusion mechanism that dynamically adapts score combination based on which signal triggered frame selection. Across four benchmarks, SAAF delivers competitive accuracy at substantially lower cost. Among training-free zero-shot methods, SAAF sets a new state of the art on XD-Violence (92.07%), MSAD (86.70%), and ShanghaiTech (80.54%) AUC-ROC, with XD-Violence and MSAD also surpassing supervised baselines. SAAF sustains 44.95, 48.61, and 41.06 FPS on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and MSAD, a 2.43$\times$, 2.63$\times$, and 2.22$\times$ throughput improvement over the prior best zero-shot method. Code: https://github.com/kdawoud91/SAAF

    Learned representations often encode sensitive attributes, such as gender or race, that may be undesirable or unsafe to retain. Concept erasure aims to remove this information while preserving task-relevant content. Existing methods remain incomplete: linear methods provide guarantees only against linear probes, while nonlinear methods achieve stronger empirical erasure but lack formal guarantees and often sacrifice utility. In this work, we introduce a principled conditional autoencoder framework for nonlinear concept erasure. We follow the principle that erasure should remove only the sensitive attribute and nothing else, and we show that, under the stated assumptions, perfect reconstruction together with population-level independence is sufficient for perfect nonlinear guardedness, with preservation guarantees in the imperfect-reconstruction regime. Empirically, we attain a superior utility-erasure trade-off across multiple datasets, sensitive attributes, and language models, surpassing even the supervised variants of competing methods despite using no target-task labels, while being simpler to optimize and converging substantially faster. Beyond erasure, our framework yields concept conversion (representation steering) as a by-product: by changing only the target concept at inference time, it produces representations corresponding to different concept values - at no additional training cost - a capability no prior erasure method provides, and on which we likewise demonstrate strong empirical performance.

    学习得到的表征常常编码性别或种族等敏感属性，而保留这些信息可能并不可取，甚至不安全。概念擦除旨在移除这类信息，同时保留与任务相关的内容。现有方法仍不完善：线性方法仅能针对线性探针提供保证，而非线性方法虽能在实证上实现更强的擦除，却缺乏形式化保证，且往往牺牲效用。在本研究中，我们提出一种有原则的条件自编码器框架，用于非线性概念擦除。我们遵循这样的原则：擦除应当只移除敏感属性，不移除其他任何内容。我们证明，在所述假设下，完美重建与总体层面的独立性足以保证完美的非线性防护；在重建不完美的情况下，该方法也具有保留保证。在多个数据集、敏感属性和语言模型上的实证结果表明，我们取得了更优的效用与擦除权衡：尽管未使用目标任务标签，效果仍超过竞争方法的监督式变体；同时，该方法更易优化，收敛速度也显著更快。除擦除之外，我们的框架还会附带产生概念转换（表征引导）能力：在推理时仅改变目标概念，即可生成对应不同概念取值的表征——无需额外训练成本。此前没有擦除方法具备这一能力，我们也展示了该能力的强劲实证表现。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    IGG measures whether GUI agents can reveal hidden or inaccessible targets before clicking, and its interventions identify interaction execution as the main bottleneck.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    GUI grounding benchmarks ask whether an agent can localize a target that is already visible in a static screenshot. Real interfaces often violate this assumption: a target may be off-screen, appear only after a state change or hover, remain occluded, or become actionable after a delay. This leaves the ability to recover target visibility unevaluated. To measure this reveal step, we introduce Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG), a benchmark in which an agent must first make the target visible through interaction and then click it. IGG contains 601 tasks across 16 controllable GUI environments and seven visibility-constraint sub-types, with a compact action space of scrolling, moving, dragging, waiting, and clicking. In our human study, participants achieve 94.6% accuracy, while GPT-5.5 reaches 79.4% and the strongest evaluated open-source VLM reaches only 31.6%. To identify the source of this gap, we conduct two controlled interventions. Telling Qwen3-VL which interaction to perform raises its accuracy only from 30.8% to 33.9%, whereas performing the interaction for the model raises it to 81.9%. The bottleneck is executing the reveal interaction, not recognizing the target once it is exposed. We further show that this capability is learnable, demonstrating that visibility recovery can be strengthened consistently across model families.

    The paper introduces a protocol-aware fault-injection method and uses it to measure tool-calling agents’ resilience to MCP failures, finding that framework error handling matters more than model scale. Agent tool use and reliability are central, while the work does not explain internal mechanisms or advance reasoning itself.

    本文提出协议感知的故障注入方法，并用它衡量工具调用智能体应对 MCP 故障的韧性；结果发现，框架的错误处理能力比模型规模更重要。智能体工具使用与可靠性是核心内容，而本文并未解释内部机制或推进推理本身。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet current benchmarks assume tools respond correctly and on time, leaving agent resilience to realistic tool failures untested. We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in, protocol-aware fault-injection middleware that interposes on the MCP tool-call path with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent) and seedable schedules. Its fault model is calibrated to the observed incident distribution (failure mode x persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories. In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, $p = 0.96$), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs. 95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI $[-0.2, 9.3]$). Agent stacks differ in how well they absorb faults, which suggests that framework-level error handling matters more than model scale. These results demonstrate that capability benchmarks alone can mask operational brittleness, motivating protocol-aware fault injection as a complementary evaluation dimension for tool-calling agents.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces trajectory matching, with a proof that it recovers the marginal flow and supports structured, prerequisite-dependent actions, enabling compositional generation and transfer across graph tasks. Its reasoning and systems connections are incidental to the generative modeling method.

    本文提出轨迹匹配，并证明它能够恢复边缘流、支持结构化且依赖前置条件的动作，从而实现组合式生成，并迁移到不同图任务。推理和系统方面的关联只是生成建模方法的附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The natural units of structured discrete generation are often not independent single-component edits but richer actions: attaching a fragment to a molecule, inserting a node together with an incident edge, or growing a hierarchy by adding a child. Yet most existing discrete flow matching methods (DFM) are restricted to independent component-wise edits over fixed-size states. This restriction stems from endpoint conditioning: endpoints fix the source and target during training but not the action sequence between them, making tractable conditional rates hard to define for complex actions that cannot be factorized component-wise. We propose trajectory matching, which conditions the flow on a full sequence of actions connecting the endpoints. This yields principled, simulation-free training targets for user-defined action spaces, including actions that change state size, modify multiple components, or depend on earlier actions. We prove that the resulting objective recovers the marginal flow and that trajectory matching strictly subsumes factorized DFM, while additionally capturing actions with prerequisite structure such as hierarchy growth or fragment-based molecule generation. Empirically, on tree and molecular graph generation, trajectory matching with domain-aligned actions matches or surpasses factorized DFM baselines (lifting MOSES validity from 92.8% to 99.2%) and transfers without retraining to substructure extension and linking. Trajectory matching enlarges the design space of discrete flow matching by turning the action vocabulary into a modeling choice. An interactive explanation of trajectory matching is available at https://niklaskemper.com/blog/trajectory-matching/.

    中文

    结构化离散生成的自然基本单元往往不是彼此独立的单组件编辑，而是更丰富的动作：将一个片段连接到分子上、插入一个节点及其相连的边，或通过添加子节点来扩展层级结构。然而，现有大多数离散流匹配（DFM）方法都局限于对固定大小状态进行彼此独立的逐组件编辑。这一限制源自端点条件化：端点在训练时固定了源状态和目标状态，却没有固定两者之间的动作序列，因此对于无法按组件分解的复杂动作，难以定义可处理的条件速率。我们提出轨迹匹配，它根据连接端点的完整动作序列对流进行条件化。这为用户定义的动作空间提供了有原则且无需模拟的训练目标，包括会改变状态大小、修改多个组件或依赖先前动作的动作。我们证明，所得目标能够恢复边缘流，且轨迹匹配严格包含因子化 DFM，同时还能表示具有前置条件结构的动作，例如层级扩展或基于片段的分子生成。在树和分子图生成任务上的实证结果表明，采用领域对齐动作的轨迹匹配达到或超过因子化 DFM 基线（将 MOSES 有效性从 92.8% 提高到 99.2%），并且无需重新训练即可迁移到子结构扩展和连接任务。轨迹匹配通过将动作词汇表变为一种建模选择，扩展了离散流匹配的设计空间。轨迹匹配的交互式说明见 https://niklaskemper.com/blog/trajectory-matching/。

    ENGLISH

    Supervised pairwise graph representations convert pairwise predictive relations into sample-specific graphs, but graph-level accuracy does not by itself show that higher-order topology carries the signal. In a controlled Transformer error-detection task, supervised pairwise graphs outperform attention-as-adjacency (ROC-AUC $0.839$ versus $0.559$; the comparable no-confidence pair is $0.687$ versus $0.559$), but their apparent advantage over model confidence disappears after controlling for sequence length, which is almost perfectly recoverable from the pooled hidden state ($R^2=0.9995$). On published HCP Emotion ensemble graphs, signed node aggregation already acts as an ensemble of supervised pairwise predictions. Edge magnitude alone is near chance; topology-aware augmentations change ROC-AUC by at most $0.004$, with only sign-separated degree showing small positive changes across all tested graph sizes, while a validation-tuned three-layer GCN provides no measurable improvement over the signed node-summary baseline. A Fisher post-hoc corrector satisfies its distribution-agnostic guarantees across the evaluated feature representations and remains stable under reduced labelled budgets; in a near-error-free fMRI calibration regime the bound correctly becomes statistically uninformative. A separate cross-attention analysis identifies a redundant reversal circuit and downstream EOS-timing and copy failures. Higher-order topology should therefore be credited only after local supervised evidence and recoverable nuisance variables have been excluded.

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as reasoning components in modern software systems, yet a model that answers a logical query correctly can contradict itself when the same problem is restated in an equivalent form. Static benchmarks evaluate queries in isolation and therefore fail to expose such inconsistencies. To address this limitation, we present LGMT, an open-source tool that detects reasoning inconsistencies through metamorphic relations grounded in first-order logic. Given a source test case in premise-conclusion form, LGMT generates logically equivalent follow-up cases and checks whether the model's entailment predictions agree across the pair, without ground-truth labels. The tool provides 20 built-in metamorphic relations, supports custom ones verified by the Z3 theorem prover, and runs from a CLI or a web studio, including an offline mock mode requiring no API key. Across six widely used LLMs on a bundled benchmark of 3,091 metamorphic groups, LGMT reveals inconsistency rates ranging from 20.84% to 29.44%. LGMT is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/MaxwelsDonc/lgmt-tool, with a demonstration video at https://youtu.be/gou4opptu1U.

    Instruction-based image editing models exhibit pronounced sample-specific performance variation: different models can produce substantially different results for the same source image and editing instruction, and the best-performing model often varies across requests. We therefore study image editing model routing, which dynamically selects an editor from a candidate pool given an input image and editing instruction. We introduce EditJev, a System One routing model that directly predicts sample-level preference scores over candidate image editing models in a single forward pass.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM inference is increasingly deployed as a core service for enterprise and interactive applications, but sovereignty, compliance, latency and resource-locality requirements can limit the suitability of centralised cloud deployments. Telco operators offer geographically distributed compute and network infrastructure for addressing these constraints. However, existing LLM serving frameworks are designed for tightly coupled data centres and provide limited support for coordinating geographically distributed and heterogeneous resources. We present InferSlice, a reference architecture for Service-Level Objective (SLO)-driven LLM inference over a telco infrastructure, integrating network slicing, GPU partitioning, elastic serving and observability. Led by BT in collaboration with the University of Bristol and NVIDIA, and realised on the JOINER UK national-scale wide-area network (WAN), InferSlice is evaluated on service differentiation across tiers, elastic scale-out, client-edge bandwidth as a bottleneck, and the reach of tensor, pipeline, data parallelism, and prefill/decode disaggregation over the WAN. Our results show that, on a general-purpose telco network, tiers yield distinct latency-throughput regimes, and weight streaming shortens scale-out time. Replication is placement-insensitive but memory-bound; pipeline parallelism tolerates near- and mid-cross-site hops, while tensor parallelism and disaggregation fail beyond a single subnet hop. We share practical insights from operating SLO-driven inference on a telco network, lessons learned and open questions, and hope to encourage further research on distributed and heterogeneous LLM inference systems.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DT-JEPA contributes a probabilistic future-representation predictor, an information-theoretic result, and a finite-sample bound for reward-free offline RL and adaptation. It substantially advances decision-making and task adaptation, while representation prediction is used for control rather than studied as an internal mechanism; compositionality and system organization are not central.

    DT-JEPA 提出了一种概率式未来表征预测器，并为无奖励离线 RL 和任务适应给出了信息论结果及有限样本界。它显著推进了决策和任务适应；不过，表征预测用于控制，而非作为内部机制研究；组合性和系统组织也并非核心内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Decision Transformer (DT) has demonstrated strong performance in various offline reinforcement learning (RL) tasks by conditioning action generation on expected future returns and historical trajectories. However, treating expected future returns as the condition provides an incomplete description of the future, as trajectories with different state transitions and behaviors may share similar returns. Moreover, expected future returns inherently depend on task-specific reward functions, which makes policy learning reliant on reward-labeled datasets and restricts its scalability to tasks with similar but unseen rewards. Recently, Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA) have emerged as a promising paradigm of self-supervised learning-based world models, which learn predictive representations of future dynamics in latent space rather than reconstructing future states in the original space. Inspired by JEPA, we propose DT-JEPA, an offline pretraining and online fine-tuning framework that learns general knowledge from reward-free offline trajectories and achieves excellent adaptation to unseen tasks. Instead of predicting a single deterministic future embedding, we design a novel probabilistic predictor to model the conditional distribution of future representations in the latent space, thereby capturing both predictive information and uncertainty about future dynamics. Theoretically, we show that 1) the JEPA objective seeks to maximize a variational lower bound on the mutual information between historical representations and future trajectories; and 2) predictive future-conditioned policy learning admits a finite-sample performance bound with an O(N-1/4) estimation term. Experiments on D4RL benchmarks demonstrate that DT-JEPA achieves efficient adaptation across varying offline RL tasks, outperforming traditional DT-based and other offline RL methods.

    决策 Transformer（DT）通过依据预期未来回报和历史轨迹来生成动作，在各种离线强化学习（RL）任务中展现出强劲表现。然而，将预期未来回报作为条件并不能完整描述未来，因为具有不同状态转移和行为的轨迹可能具有相似的回报。此外，预期未来回报本质上依赖于特定任务的奖励函数，这使策略学习依赖带有奖励标签的数据集，并限制了其扩展到奖励相似但未见过的任务。近期，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）已成为一种颇具前景的自监督学习式世界模型范式，它在潜在空间中学习未来动态的预测性表征，而不是在原始空间中重建未来状态。受 JEPA 启发，我们提出 DT-JEPA，这是一种离线预训练和在线微调框架，可从无奖励的离线轨迹中学习通用知识，并有效适应未见任务。我们不预测单一的确定性未来嵌入，而是设计了一种新的概率预测器，用于建模潜在空间中未来表征的条件分布，从而同时捕捉预测信息和对未来动态的不确定性。从理论上讲，我们证明：1）JEPA 目标旨在最大化历史表征与未来轨迹之间互信息的变分下界；2）预测式未来条件策略学习具有有限样本性能界，其估计项为 O(N-1/4)。在 D4RL 基准上的实验表明，DT-JEPA 能够高效适应不同的离线 RL 任务，其表现优于传统的基于 DT 的方法和其他离线 RL 方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) express a model's internal activations in the form of readable text. The verbalizer turns an activation into an English explanation; the reconstructor then converts that explanation back into an activation, and the explanation is considered successful if the round trip brings back the original activation. We claim that this criterion evaluates whether the information is sufficient and does not address descriptive faithfulness. A sentence can contain sufficient information to make it possible to identify an activation even if it wrongly explains what the activation does: in the case of reconstruction, the primary aim is to accurately identify the activations and not to describe them. This issue has the same structure as the chain-of-thought faithfulness problem, in which verbal output that has been trained to go with a process is taken as a report on that process, and it parallels the dissociation between an individual's introspective report and the actual governing process as documented in human psychology. Although proposed as interpretability tools for the purpose of alignment, NLAs reintroduce, through unverified explanations, the epistemic problem that they were intended to resolve.

    自然语言自编码器（NLA）将模型的内部激活以可读文本的形式表达出来。语言化器将一个激活转换成英文解释；随后，重构器再将该解释转换回激活。如果这一往返过程能够还原原始激活，该解释就被视为成功。我们认为，这一标准评估的是信息是否充分，并未涉及描述是否忠实。即便一句话错误地解释了某个激活的作用，它仍可能包含足够的信息，使人能够识别该激活：在重构场景中，首要目标是准确识别激活，而不是描述激活。这一问题与思维链忠实性问题具有相同结构：与某个过程配套训练的语言输出被当作对该过程的报告；它也与人类心理学中记录的个人内省报告和实际支配过程之间的分离相呼应。尽管 NLA 被提出作为服务于对齐目的的可解释性工具，但未经验证的解释重新引入了它们原本旨在解决的认知论问题。

    LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB's query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \$0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.

    ENGLISH

    Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic descriptions, the model synthesizes its own curriculum of queries and privileged reasoning traces without access to any human-curated prompts or answers. We find that self-distillation on fully synthetic privileged information enables a model to improve across multiple domains while retaining its capabilities on domains it is not self-trained on. We demonstrate the generality of this framework across text and multimodal domains, achieving consistent self-improvement on standard language benchmarks and Visual Question Answering. Our findings demonstrate that foundation models possess rich latent capabilities that can be amplified without external task supervision or curated problem distributions.

Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for guidance that the current student can build on. Accepted teacher responses augment ordinary distillation data, and fresh rollouts renew the frontier estimate as the policy changes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld report higher mean autonomous performance than the compared distillation baselines across the evaluated student scales and teacher configurations, with ablations indicating complementary effects of candidate selection and guidance filtering.
