    ENGLISH

    Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses.

    During joint training, backpropagation allows later layers to reshape earlier representations, a feedback mechanism absent from purely layer-wise learning. We extend Neural Low-Degree Filtering (Neural LoFi), a recently proposed layer-wise spectral surrogate for feature learning, to capture this interaction. Starting from the exact backpropagation gradients, we derive a local coupling between a neuron's incoming weights and its corresponding next-layer column. In a controlled small-initialization regime with smooth activations and fixed surroundings, these dynamics amplify singular modes of a cross-layer correlation operator. Each growing mode pairs an earlier feature with an upper-layer response through shared neuron coefficients. This motivates a backward-coupling algorithm in which upper-layer sensitivities generate sample-dependent effective labels for earlier spectral steps, while corrected features refine upward transmission. A function-space variational principle characterizes the selected feature-response pairs by maximizing the label correlation of their product under kernel-norm constraints. For three-layer networks, we derive self-consistent continuous-time dynamics for the filtered hidden-layer features, the activation kernels, and the network output under the proposed backward coupling. In a hierarchical multi-index model, we establish a feature-recovery separation: backward coupling recovers lower-layer directions invisible to the original forward label-weighted statistic. The linear specialization recovers residual-dependent singular-mode dynamics, while paired modes provide a dynamical mechanism for linked low-rank covariance components consistent with the rainbow-network picture. Experiments with fully connected and convolutional networks on binary CIFAR-10 show improved accuracy over forward Neural LoFi at matched widths.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes how covariance, observable directions, and singularities shape LoRA’s learning complexity, supported by experiments across network layers.     本文刻画了协方差、可观测方向和奇点如何影响 LoRA 的学习复杂度，并通过跨网络层实验提供支持。这为参数和表示几何带来了重要洞见；而适配这一设定本身只与系统有间接关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is now a standard approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large neural networks. Its low-rank factorization is inherently non-identifiable, making LoRA a singular statistical model whose learning complexity cannot be described by parameter dimension alone. We study this complexity using the real log canonical threshold (RLCT) from singular learning theory and how it depends on both the low-rank parameterization and the pretrained network. Under a local linearization, LoRA induces a low-rank trace regression model whose Kullback--Leibler geometry is controlled by a forward-backward covariance, constructed from activations and backpropagated sensitivities at the adapted layer. This covariance determines which low-rank perturbations are statistically observable. When it is nondegenerate along the relevant low-rank directions, we recover the classical learning complexity of reduced-rank regression; when its kernel meets these directions, additional statistically indistinguishable parameters change the singular geometry. We characterize this geometry locally through observable tangent directions and a residual singularity, and globally through affine linear sections of determinantal varieties. The global learning complexity need not be determined at a ground-truth parameter, as singularities on another rank stratum can dominate. We also introduce a curvature-corrected multi-temperature estimator of the RLCT. Experiments on multilayer perceptron and transformer architectures reveal strongly layer-dependent forward-backward geometry and show that ambient covariance degeneracy does not imply degeneracy along the low-rank directions relevant to adaptation.

    中文

    低秩适配（LoRA）如今已成为大型神经网络参数高效微调的标准方法。其低秩分解本质上不可辨识，因此 LoRA 是一种奇异统计模型，其学习复杂度无法仅用参数维度来描述。我们使用奇异学习理论中的实对数典范阈值（RLCT）研究这种复杂度，以及它如何取决于低秩参数化和预训练网络。在局部线性化下，LoRA 会诱导出一个低秩迹回归模型，其 Kullback--Leibler 几何由前向—反向协方差控制；该协方差由适配层处的激活和反向传播敏感度构造而成。这个协方差决定哪些低秩扰动在统计上可观测。当它在相关低秩方向上非退化时，我们恢复了降秩回归的经典学习复杂度；当其核与这些方向相交时，额外的统计上不可区分参数会改变奇异几何。我们通过可观测切向方向和残余奇点在局部刻画这种几何，并通过行列式簇的仿射线性截面在全局刻画。全局学习复杂度不一定由真实参数处的几何决定，因为另一个秩分层上的奇点可能占主导。我们还提出一种经曲率校正的多温度 RLCT 估计器。在多层感知机和 Transformer 架构上的实验揭示了强烈依赖层的前向—反向几何，并表明环境协方差退化并不意味着与适配相关的低秩方向也会退化。

This substantially advances reasoning and agent communication, while the representation geometry connection is limited to the interface and does not establish interpretability or a composition contribution.

    J-Comm 在智能体之间传递中间隐藏状态和雅可比线索，并通过几何重加权来支持潜在推理；基准测试结果显示，它在数学及其他多步任务上取得了提升。这显著推动了推理和智能体通信研究；表示几何仅与接口有关，并未带来可解释性或组合能力方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components. First, a training-free Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning (GEAR) reweights token candidates over existing model embeddings, which monotonically optimizes geometric consensus among candidate tokens in embedding space at each step. Second, we introduce an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) communication interface that gives the Receiver two complementary views of the Sender's reasoning. The H channel supplies continuous inputs derived from feedback distributions, while the J channel conveys intermediate-state cues in vocabulary-indexed Jacobian-lens coordinates. Intuitively, H provides inputs for the Receiver to reason from, while J offers additional guidance within its computation. The Receiver reconstructs these cues using its own dictionary and injects them into intermediate layers during prefill, enabling communication without sharing key-value caches or requiring identical model widths. In Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-4B communication, J-Comm achieves the highest mean score across seven benchmarks, including 94.80% on MATH500, 54.55% on GPQA-Diamond, 73.33% on AIME2024+2025, and 62.93% success on ALFWorld. Compared with TextMAS, it improves performance by 1.29-8.59 percentage points and reduces generated text tokens by 19.2-74.8%.

    中文

    潜在通信既需要有效的连续推理过程，也需要一个接口，使外部模型能够利用该过程的中间计算结果。我们提出 J-Comm，一个包含两个核心组件的框架。首先，无需训练的潜在推理几何一致性（GEAR）会基于模型现有嵌入对 token 候选项重新加权，从而在每一步单调优化嵌入空间中候选 token 之间的几何共识。其次，我们提出 H+J（Hidden-and-Jacobian，隐藏状态与雅可比矩阵）通信接口，为接收方提供发送方推理过程的两种互补视角。H 通道提供由反馈分布导出的连续输入，而 J 通道则以按词汇表索引的 Jacobian-lens 坐标传递中间状态线索。直观来说，H 为接收方提供推理所依据的输入，J 则在其计算过程中提供额外引导。接收方利用自身的字典重建这些线索，并在预填充期间将其注入中间层，从而无需共享键值缓存，也无需模型宽度相同即可实现通信。在 Qwen3-8B 到 Qwen3-4B 的通信中，J-Comm 在七个基准测试上的平均分最高，其中 MATH500 得分为 94.80%，GPQA-Diamond 为 54.55%，AIME2024+2025 为 73.33%，ALFWorld 成功率为 62.93%。与 TextMAS 相比，其性能提高了 1.29–8.59 个百分点，生成的文本 token 数减少了 19.2–74.8%。

    NgramRL: Accelerating RL Post-Training for Structured Generation via Rollout-Aware N-gram Speculative Decoding

    NgramRL：通过考虑 rollout 的 N 元语法推测解码加速结构化生成的 RL 后训练

    Nilesh Prasad Pandey, Jangseon Park, Jason Kong, Onat Gungor, Tajana Rosing

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NgramRL reuses recent rollouts as speculative drafts and adds adaptive prefetching to accelerate RL post-training, while target-model verification preserves the rollout distribution. It advances reasoning-training infrastructure and system efficiency, but the abstract reports no direct improvement or new account of reasoning capability itself.

    NgramRL 将近期 rollout 复用为推测草稿，并加入自适应预取来加速 RL 后训练，同时通过目标模型验证保留 rollout 分布。它推动了推理训练基础设施和系统效率的发展，但摘要没有报告推理能力本身的直接提升或新的解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but its cost is dominated by autoregressive rollout generation, which can exceed 70% of training time. Existing speculative-decoding methods are poorly suited to this setting: model-based drafters consume scarce GPU memory and may become misaligned as the policy evolves, while existing model-free methods do not explicitly exploit repetition across training epochs. We observe that recent rollouts of the same prompt provide a high-quality, self-updating draft source. Based on this insight, we propose NgramRL, a per-prompt n-gram drafter constructed from bounded recent rollout history. NgramRL requires no auxiliary model, drafter training, or persistent GPU-resident drafter state, while target-model verification preserves the rollout distribution. To hide CPU cache lookup and scheduling, we further introduce an adaptive fan-out prefetcher that predicts likely verification outcomes (j, b), consisting of the accepted draft length j and target-emitted continuation token b. A causal budget allocator concentrates prefetches on high-probability outcomes, while uncovered outcomes fall back to sequential lookup without changing committed tokens. Across two model families and three reasoning and structured-generation workloads, NgramRL commits 3.60-7.77 tokens per target-model forward in the warm-cache regime, up to 1.99x more than SuffixDecoding and 7.0x more than prompt-lookup decoding. On Spider, the prefetcher covers 96.6% of Qwen3-8B outcomes at a candidate budget of 16 and improves measured rollout throughput by 1.38x over synchronous NgramRL, approaching its 1.40x overlap ceiling.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）后训练能够提升大型语言模型的推理能力，但其成本主要来自自回归 rollout 生成，所占训练时间可能超过 70%。现有推测解码方法并不适合这一场景：基于模型的草拟器会占用稀缺的 GPU 内存，并且可能随着策略演变而逐渐失准；现有的无模型方法则没有明确利用不同训练轮次间的重复内容。我们发现，同一提示的近期 rollout 能提供高质量且会自我更新的草稿来源。基于这一发现，我们提出 NgramRL，一种针对每个提示、由有限近期 rollout 历史构建的 N 元语法草拟器。NgramRL 无需辅助模型、草拟器训练或常驻 GPU 的草拟器状态，同时通过目标模型验证来保留 rollout 分布。为了隐藏 CPU 缓存查找和调度的开销，我们进一步引入一种自适应扇出预取器，用于预测可能的验证结果 (j, b)，其中 j 是被接受的草稿长度，b 是目标模型生成的后续 token。因果预算分配器将预取集中在高概率结果上，而未覆盖的结果则回退到顺序查找，且不会改变已确认的 token。在两个模型家族和三种推理与结构化生成工作负载上，NgramRL 在热缓存情形下每次目标模型前向传播提交 3.60–7.77 个 token，最多比 SuffixDecoding 高 1.99 倍、比 prompt-lookup 解码高 7.0 倍。在 Spider 上，预取器在候选预算为 16 时覆盖了 Qwen3-8B 的 96.6% 的结果，并使测得的 rollout 吞吐量比同步 NgramRL 提高 1.38 倍，接近其 1.40 倍的重叠上限。

    Reinforcement Learning with Multi-Step Transition Predictions: A Bellman Theory

    具有多步转移预测的强化学习：贝尔曼理论

    Chenbei Lu, Zaiwei Chen, Tongxin Li, Chenye Wu, Adam Wierman

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes how multi-step transition predictions affect optimal decisions and gives a Bayesian Bellman equation, analysis, and a sample-efficient learning algorithm for finite MDPs. This strongly advances reasoning and decision-making, while its state-space and learning-efficiency results do not substantively address compositionality, internal representations, or model and agent system design.

    本文刻画了多步转移预测如何影响最优决策，并为有限 MDP 给出了贝叶斯贝尔曼方程、理论分析和样本高效的学习算法。这有力推动了推理与决策研究；其状态空间和学习效率结果并未实质性涉及组合性、内部表示或模型与智能体系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-step predictions of future transition realizations can improve reinforcement learning, but their value remains difficult to quantify. Directly including these predictions in the state can lead to exponential state-space growth, making direct dynamic programming computationally expensive. We study discounted finite MDPs under a block-feedback protocol: at the start of each K-period block, the decision maker observes $K$-step probabilistic transition predictions for a subset of actions and adapts decisions to observed states within the block. We show that the optimal value satisfies a Bayesian Bellman equation on the original state space. This representation reveals that predictive information creates value by recursively changing the local order of maximization and expectation in the Bellman expansion. We formalize this effect through a Bellman--Jensen analysis and quantify the effects of prediction horizon, error, action coverage, and within-block feedback. We propose block-feedback Bayesian offline learning with online adaptation (BF--BOLA), a model-based algorithm for learning near-optimal policies, and establish upper and lower sample-complexity bounds that match up to logarithmic factors in the stated regimes. The results show that predictions can reduce transition learning to uncovered rows and that learning a near-optimal policy can require fewer prediction samples than estimating the Bayesian value function.

    中文

    对未来转移实现值进行多步预测可以改进强化学习，但其价值仍难以量化。将这些预测直接纳入状态可能导致状态空间呈指数级增长，使直接动态规划的计算开销变得很高。我们在分块反馈协议下研究折扣有限 MDP：在每个 K 期分块开始时，决策者会观察针对一部分动作的步概率转移预测，并在该分块内根据观察到的状态调整决策。$K$我们证明，最优价值在原始状态空间上满足贝叶斯贝尔曼方程。这种表示揭示了预测信息如何创造价值：它会递归地改变贝尔曼展开中局部的最大化与期望运算顺序。我们通过贝尔曼—詹森分析将这一效应形式化，并量化预测时域、误差、动作覆盖范围和分块内反馈的影响。我们提出分块反馈贝叶斯离线学习与在线适配（BF--BOLA），这是一种用于学习近似最优策略的基于模型算法；并在所述范围内建立了上下样本复杂度界，两者仅相差对数因子。结果表明，预测可以将转移学习缩减到未覆盖的行；而学习近似最优策略所需的预测样本数可能少于估计贝叶斯价值函数所需的样本数。

    When Human Corrections Travel: Safety in Federated VLA Adaptation

    当人类纠正信息得以传递：联邦 VLA 适配中的安全性

    Vigneshwaran Subbaraju, Obaidullah Zaland, Monowar Bhuyan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    This position paper proposes safety and privacy requirements for sharing human corrections across federated VLA policies, with counterexamples and a falsifiable evaluation agenda but no experiments. Its central contribution concerns robot policy adaptation and deployment systems; multimodal corrections and diverse tasks are context, not evidence of representation mechanisms, compositional generalization, or reasoning advances.

    这篇立场论文针对联邦 VLA 策略间的人类纠正信息共享提出了安全和隐私要求，并提供反例及可证伪的评估议程，但没有实验。其核心贡献涉及机器人策略适配和部署系统；多模态纠正信息和多样化任务只是讨论背景，并不构成表示机制、组合泛化或推理进展的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can adapt to local human intervention, while federated learning can combine distributed robot experience without pooling raw records. We examine their prospective intersection: sharing adaptations derived from diverse human corrections across tasks, environments, people, and robot embodiments. Corrections differ in modality, safety semantics(urgency, behavioral scope, etc.), and privacy sensitivity. A shared update that improves mean task success may suppress a rare safety intervention or produce an unsafe response on another robot. We argue for three requirements: preserve the context and uncertainty of multimodal corrections when deciding what to share; assess candidate updates in each receiving robot's closed loop before deployment; and evaluate leakage alongside retention of safety-critical evidence. Immediate, legible defensive behavior remains necessary during human interaction. We offer counterexamples and a falsifiable evaluation agenda, not experimental results.

    中文

    视觉—语言—动作（VLA）策略可以根据本地的人类干预进行适配，而联邦学习能够在不汇集原始记录的情况下整合分布式机器人经验。我们考察二者可能的交汇点：跨任务、环境、人员和机器人形态共享由多样化人类纠正所产生的适配结果。纠正信息在模态、安全语义（紧迫性、行为范围等）和隐私敏感程度上各不相同。能够提高平均任务成功率的共享更新，可能会抑制罕见的安全干预，或导致另一台机器人产生不安全响应。我们提出三项要求：在决定共享什么时保留多模态纠正信息的上下文和不确定性；部署前在每台接收更新的机器人的闭环中评估候选更新；并在评估泄露的同时，评估安全关键证据的保留情况。与人类交互期间，仍有必要采取及时且清晰的防御行为。本文给出反例和可证伪的评估议程，不包含实验结果。

    通过推荐器后悔改进基于 bandit 和 MCTS 的正则化 RL 估计

    Danilo Vucetic, Alexandre Larouche, Mohammad Pedramfar, Audrey Durand, Gauthier Gidel

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes recommendation quality for regularized RL estimation, derives regret bounds, and unifies bandit and search-based target improvement under recommender MCTS, with downstream experiments. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to training and improving decision-making; search is a limited systems connection, while the abstract does not support claims about internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文形式化了正则化 RL 估计中的推荐质量，推导了后悔界，并在推荐器 MCTS 下统一基于 bandit 和基于搜索的目标改进，同时开展了下游实验。这是对训练和改进决策能力的重要算法贡献；搜索与系统只有有限关联，而摘要并未支持关于内部机制或组合泛化的主张。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms rely on estimators, like Monte Carlo tree search or one-step look-ahead, to provide policy, value, or Q-value estimates in training and inference. However, existing bandit-based estimation frameworks evaluate sampling efficiency, not the quality of estimates. We address this by formalising estimate generation as a recommendation process, treating bandit-based sampling as an improvement operator. To evaluate the quality of a recommendation (estimate), we define regulariser-aware recommender regrets, analysing their lower bounds, and proving that simple algorithms like uniform sampling can achieve these bounds. Finally, we unify bandit- and search-based target improvement under recommender MCTS. Across synthetic trees, arcade games, and scientific discovery tasks, recommenders often yield faster target convergence and superior downstream performance. Our experiments characterise for the first time the potential of regularised MCTS in scientific applications.

    中文

    正则化强化学习（RL）算法依赖估计器，例如蒙特卡洛树搜索或一步前瞻，以便在训练和推理时提供策略、价值或 Q 值估计。然而，现有基于 bandit 的估计框架评估的是采样效率，而非估计质量。我们通过将估计生成形式化为推荐过程来解决这一问题，并将基于 bandit 的采样视为一种改进算子。为了评估推荐（估计）的质量，我们定义了考虑正则项的推荐器后悔，分析其下界，并证明均匀采样等简单算法能够达到这些界。最后，我们在推荐器 MCTS 下统一了基于 bandit 和基于搜索的目标改进。在合成树、街机游戏和科学发现任务中，推荐器通常能更快地使目标收敛，并取得更好的下游性能。我们的实验首次刻画了正则化 MCTS 在科学应用中的潜力。

    Thomas Landeg, Thierry Tambe

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Backtrack adds a failure prediction head over a frozen VLA's internal representations and uses motion retracing for recovery, substantially advancing robot policy recovery and control organization. Reading internal representations is incidental to the method; the abstract does not investigate how those representations work or address compositional or general reasoning.

    Backtrack 在冻结 VLA 的内部表示上添加失败预测头，并通过回溯运动来恢复，大幅推进了机器人策略恢复和控制组织的发展。读取内部表示只是该方法的一环；摘要没有研究这些表示如何工作，也没有涉及组合推理或一般推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform well on robotic manipulation, yet remain brittle once their own actions carry them into states their training data barely covers. Recovering from such failures usually requires recovery demonstrations, policy retraining, or a separate model at inference time. We introduce Backtrack, a lightweight failure detection and recovery mechanism for frozen VLAs that needs none of these. A small failure prediction head, trained only on outcome-labeled rollouts of the frozen policy, reads the VLA's existing internal representations to estimate whether the current episode will fail. When the predicted failure probability exceeds a threshold, a controller pauses the policy, retraces the arm's recently achieved motion, and hands control back to the unchanged policy so it can retry from an earlier configuration. The head adds only 0.48-0.88% to the policy's parameter count. We evaluate Backtrack on LIBERO with three VLAs spanning two action-generation families: SmolVLA and $\pi$0.5, which use flow-matching action experts, and the autoregressive $\pi$0-FAST. On LIBERO-Long, the suite of long-horizon multi-step tasks and the one on which all three policies fail most often, Backtrack reduces each policy's failure rate by 19-48%, raising success by up to 7.4 percentage points; on the three shorter suites, where control success is already 85-99%, its effect is smaller. On MetaWorld, all twelve controller configurations tested with SmolVLA improve on the unassisted policy.

    中文

    视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中表现良好，但一旦自身动作将其带入训练数据覆盖很少的状态，它们仍然很脆弱。此类失败的恢复通常需要恢复示范、重新训练策略，或在推理时使用单独的模型。我们提出 Backtrack，这是一种适用于冻结 VLA 的轻量级失败检测与恢复机制，无需上述做法。一个小型失败预测头仅使用冻结策略的带结果标签 rollout 进行训练，并读取 VLA 现有的内部表示，以估计当前回合是否会失败。当预测失败概率超过阈值时，控制器会暂停策略，沿机械臂近期已完成的运动轨迹返回，然后将控制权交还给未改变的策略，使其能够从较早的配置重新尝试。该预测头仅使策略参数量增加 0.48–0.88%。我们在 LIBERO 上使用三个 VLA 评估 Backtrack，涵盖两类动作生成方式：使用流匹配动作专家的 SmolVLA 和 $\pi$0.5，以及自回归的 $\pi$0-FAST。在 LIBERO-Long 上——这一长时域多步任务套件也是三个策略失败频率最高的套件——Backtrack 将每个策略的失败率降低了 19–48%，使成功率最多提高 7.4 个百分点；在三个较短的套件上，由于控制成功率已达到 85–99%，其效果较小。在 MetaWorld 上，使用 SmolVLA 测试的全部十二种控制器配置均优于未辅助的策略。
